title: Lead / Senior Software Engineer - UI Path
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are looking for a hands-on **Intelligent Automation Developer** to join a cross-functional team delivering a Proof of Concept focused on end-to-end automation.

You will design and implement automation workflows using the UiPath Platform, combining RPA, orchestration (Maestro), and AI/agentic capabilities. The solution may evolve to include LLM-based agents, document understanding, and workflow orchestration as the scope matures.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement automation workflows using UiPath (Studio, Maestro, Orchestrator)
* Build end-to-end process automations combining RPA bots, API/service integrations, and AI/LLM-driven agentic components
* Configure process orchestration and state management using Maestro (or equivalent workflow layer)
* Integrate with external systems (SAP, APIs, internal services, etc.)
* Implement human-in-the-loop steps where required (validation, approvals, exception handling)
* Collaborate closely with Business Analysts and Architects to iterate rapidly during POC
* Support testing, deployments, and demo readiness
* Document workflows, logic, and architecture to enable future scaling into production

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with UiPath Platform (Studio, Orchestrator)
* Experience with workflow orchestration concepts (e.g., Maestro, BPMN-like thinking)
* Understanding of agentic automation / LLM integration patterns
* Experience integrating APIs, web services, and enterprise systems
* Familiarity with UiPath Document Understanding and/or AI Center is a plus
* Ability to work in fast-paced, iterative POC environments
* Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on business outcomes
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Software Engineer I
description:
We're looking for an enthusiastic, diligent Java Software Engineer to work on the global Loyalty and Benefits platform in American Express – 'R42'. The candidate should have excellent soft skills, strong technical ability with an extensive passion to learn.

R42 is a modern microservice-based Loyalty and Benefits platform, designed to be able to handle all aspects of the Loyalty and Benefits customer experience, globally. Built using modern tools such as Golang, Kafka and Docker, there is ample opportunity to drive innovation and grow knowledge and skills as an Engineer.

As a Software Engineer on an R42 Scrum team, you will be building and enhancing features in the Rewards domain. You will also coordinate and work with other Engineers across the platform to share knowledge and principals.

  

* Bachelor's Degree in computer science, computer engineering, or other technical discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience in professional software development.
* Solid understanding of test-driven development, including unit, component, functional, system integration and regression tests.
* Knowledge of software engineering methodology (Agile, incl Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Test-Driven Development (TDD), Behavior Driven Development (BDD) and Waterfall)
* Knowledge of any or all of the following technologies is desired: SpringBoot, Kafka, Postgres,, Git, Docker, GraphQL
* Experienced in continuous integration (CI), continuous deployment (CD) and continuous testing (CT), including tools such as Jenkins, Rally and/or JIRA and version control such as GIT or SVN

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Software Engineer Specialist
description:
Are you…

Interested in working for an international and diverse company?

Interested in developing your career in a leading packaging and printing industry?

Looking for a friendly and supporting team?

If so, read on!

Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our products empower teams to support and manage the packaging design and print processes for brand owners, retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to provide the most innovative, integrated platform and comprehensive portfolio of tools that intelligently digitize, connect, automate, and accelerate the concept to market processes for every packaged product.

You will be part of a flexible, family friendly organization that cares about its people just as it cares about the environment.

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence. Therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

The Software Engineer Specialist - The Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, reviewing and maintaining software, and overall system architecture, as well as providing technical feedback and sharing knowledge.

**In This Role, a Typical Day Will Include**

* Design, build, and evolve scalable cloud foundation services used across Esko products.
* Own the detailed technical design and implementation of complex capabilities, from requirements through production.
* Remain deeply hands-on, writing high-quality code and solving complex distributed systems and engineering problems.
* Partner with Architects to translate architectural direction into production software, providing implementation feedback and identifying technical trade-offs.
* Improve the reliability, performance, observability, testability, and maintainability of platform services.
* Lead code reviews, technical problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex production issues.
* Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, code quality, design practices, and operational readiness.
* Mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration, reviews, and technical guidance.

**Professional knowledge & Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of software development experience
* Full stack development experience with Experience in Java Sprint boot microservice and React as front end.
* Experience with Kafka, Redis, Akka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar distributed technologies.
* Experience building shared cloud platforms or foundation services consumed by multiple products or engineering teams.
* Experience modernizing legacy or large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience establishing or improving engineering practices within a team or across related engineering teams.

**Core Technical Skills**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, cloud-native, or large-scale SaaS applications.
* Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks.
* Strong experience designing and building REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations.
* Demonstrated ability to identify implementation trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive technical feedback during design discussions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, and fault tolerance.
* Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform.
* Strong experience with **relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB**, including data modeling, access patterns, transactions, indexing, and performance optimization
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience diagnosing complex production problems using logs, metrics, distributed tracing, profiling, and performance analysis.
* Experience with containerized environments (Docker)
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews, and sound engineering judgment.

At Esko, a Veralto Company, innovation comes in every color and never in the same package. Join Esko and see how diversity of people and thought fuels a career journey like no other. Create unique technology solutions for the packaging value chain, bring new ideas to life, make and influence decisions, and experience career growth, rewards, and recognition in our global Packaging & Color organizations.

Esko is proud to be a Product Quality & Innovation company in Veralto (NYSE: VLTO). Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto is creating today. Veralto is a $5B global leader in essential technology solutions made up of over 16,000 associates across our Water Quality and Product Identification segments all united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

**Unsolicited Assistance**

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

title: Software Engineer — Fixed Income Applications
description:
Software Engineer — Fixed Income Applications

**About Millennium**  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  
The Fixed Income Applications Development team is part of Millennium’s Information Technology organization, which develops flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems to support the firm’s active, multi-manager business model. The team builds and supports the technical infrastructure behind a pricing engine used by more than 300 portfolio teams, supporting a broad range of financial products and integrating live streaming and ETL data with downstream analytics, risk, and trading platforms.

**What You'll Do**  

* Build, enhance, and support Java-based applications and technical infrastructure for a fixed-income pricing engine used across the firm.
* Develop pricing support for a broad range of financial products, including bonds, futures, options, FX, deposits, swaps, commodities, credit products, and equities.
* Integrate live streaming and ETL data providers to enable reliable pricing dissemination to analytics, risk, and trading platforms.
* Own the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through implementation, production releases, and ongoing support.
* Partner directly with business users and technology teams to understand requirements and deliver practical technical solutions.
* Deliver high-quality, maintainable code within tight release cycles.
* Take ownership of projects and proactively identify opportunities to improve the team’s broader technical infrastructure.
* Build product and business knowledge to independently clarify requirements in the absence of dedicated business analyst support.

**What You Bring**  

* Three to five years of professional experience in the Java ecosystem.
* Experience developing applications with relational databases.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with business users and technology partners.
* A results-oriented approach and the ability to deliver high-quality code within short timelines.
* Strong critical-thinking skills, sound judgment, and a proactive ownership mindset.
* Experience with at least one of the following: event-streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ; distributed caching technologies such as Hazelcast, Redis, or Memcached; or multithreading, algorithms, and data structures.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are looking for a Software Engineer, Revenue Cycle Management AI Automation & Platform to help build the next generation of Experity’s RCM technology.

In this role, you will design, develop, deploy, and operate production-grade software that supports critical healthcare revenue cycle workflows. You will work primarily across backend services, APIs, integrations, event-driven and long-running workflows, configurable business rules, and data, supporting areas such as charge entry, claims processing, claim submission, rejection and denial resolution, payments, and other parts of the revenue cycle.

You will work closely with Product Managers, RCM Operations, Software Engineers, Architects, Data teams, and QA to translate complex healthcare business workflows into scalable, maintainable software solutions.

This is a product engineering role where success means more than delivering features. You will help increase automation, reduce unnecessary manual work, improve claim outcomes, shorten processing time, and build an RCM platform that can continue to evolve.

You will be expected to understand the business workflow behind the software you build, identify opportunities for automation, and use deterministic software, configurable rules, data, and AI agent based on what is most appropriate for the problem.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate scalable production software supporting Experity’s Revenue Cycle Management workflows.

* Build backend services and REST APIs using TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud-native technologies.

* Contribute to modern web applications when needed using technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

* Design and implement event-driven, queue-based, and asynchronous workflows with explicit state management, retries, redrive, exception handling, idempotency, and auditability.

* Design long-running RCM workflows that support state transitions, human-in-the-loop processing, exception handling, replay/recovery, workflow versioning, and compensation or reversal when appropriate.

* Build integrations with Experity applications, healthcare clearinghouses, payer systems, and third-party RCM services.

* Design reliable interfaces for claims, payment, eligibility, rejection, denial, and other healthcare transaction workflows.

* Develop configurable business rules and workflow capabilities that replace logic currently distributed across application code, spreadsheets, and operational processes.

* Build rules and workflow capabilities that are configurable, versioned, explainable, auditable, and safe to change without introducing unnecessary application dependencies.

* Work with claims, financial, and operational data to improve automation, identify exceptions, and measure business outcomes.

* Integrate Generative AI, LLMs, agents, retrieval, and machine learning capabilities where they provide measurable value, while using deterministic software and business rules where those approaches are more appropriate.

* Build AI-enabled capabilities using clearly defined tools, APIs, contracts, permissions, validation, evaluation, observability, and fallback paths rather than treating LLMs as standalone solutions.

* Use modern AI-assisted software development practices for codebase exploration, development, testing, debugging, documentation, and engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate engineering review and quality standards.

* Build observability, automated testing, security, operational controls, and failure recovery into software from the beginning.

* Design systems with healthcare security, PHI protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and safe operational logging in mind.

* Contribute to architecture, technical design, engineering standards, and platform evolution.

* Collaborate with Product, RCM Operations, Architecture, Data, QA, and other engineering teams to understand real-world workflows and translate them into reliable software.

* Investigate production issues using application behavior, logs, metrics, data, and user workflows.

* Own software through production and continuously improve it based on system behavior, operational feedback, and business results.

* Measure the impact of engineering improvements through outcomes such as automation rate, exception rate, manual touches, processing time, rejection/denial resolution time, successful resubmission, payment outcomes, and system reliability.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production applications.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application design, testing, debugging, code review, and maintainability.

* Experience building backend services, REST APIs, and distributed applications.

* Proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable modern backend technologies.

* Experience with modern web development technologies such as React, Next.js, or similar frameworks.

* Experience with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and transactional systems.

* Experience developing and operating cloud-hosted applications, preferably on AWS.

* Understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, retries, idempotency, and distributed-system failure modes.

* Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and secure software development practices.

* Ability to break complex business workflows into well-defined software components, services, and contracts.

* Ability to investigate ambiguous problems and develop solutions using production behavior, data, logs, and user workflows rather than relying only on predefined requirements.

* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, operations, architecture, and data teams.

### **Preferred**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable but not required:

* Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, medical billing, claims, rejections, denials, eligibility, or payment processing.

* Healthcare, HealthTech, or SaaS environments.

* Waystar or other healthcare clearinghouse integrations.

* High-volume transaction or workflow-processing systems.

* Event-driven architectures and distributed systems.

* Modernizing legacy systems incrementally while maintaining production continuity.

* Configurable rules engines, workflow orchestration systems, or exception-management platforms.

* Production use of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or machine learning.

* AI orchestration frameworks, structured tool use, MCP or similar tool protocols, and agentic workflows.

* Build human-in-the-loop automation where AI or software recommendations require review, approval, correction, or escalation.

* Snowflake or other cloud-native data platforms.

* Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.

* Data-intensive application development and distributed data processing.

**Technology Environment**
--------------------------

Our RCM engineering environment includes:

* **Backend:** TypeScript, Node.js, Python

* **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

* **Cloud & Platform:** AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD

* **Architecture:** REST APIs, queues, events, asynchronous workflows, distributed services

* **Data:** SQL, Snowflake, Tableau

* **AI:** AWS Bedrock, LLM APIs, retrieval, structured tool use, Generative AI, and agentic workflows

* **Integrations:** Waystar, Experity EMR and Practice Management, payer systems, and third-party RCM services

Candidates are not expected to have experience with every technology listed above. Strong engineering fundamentals, relevant production experience, and the ability to learn new technologies and domains are more important than matching every item in the stack.

**How We Work**
---------------

We want engineers who understand the problem they are solving, not just the ticket they are implementing.

You should be comfortable learning a complex healthcare domain, questioning existing processes, working through ambiguity, making practical technical tradeoffs, and taking ownership of the software you build.

Our engineers collaborate closely with business and operational teams because understanding the real workflow is essential to building the right solution. We value pragmatic engineering, measurable outcomes, incremental modernization, and choosing the right technology for the problem rather than applying technology for its own sake.

We expect engineers to think beyond individual features: understand the end-to-end RCM workflow, identify where AI and automation can eliminate unnecessary work, design for exceptions and failure from the beginning, and measure whether the software actually improves operational and financial outcomes.

We are also building an AI-native engineering culture. Engineers are expected to use modern AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery and improve quality while retaining ownership of architecture, code quality, testing, security, and production outcomes.

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role**

The Salesforce Developer is Refold’s resident Salesforce expert, responsible for architecting and owning our most complex enterprise Salesforce integrations. You bring deep, hands-on experience across the Salesforce ecosystem, with a strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, enterprise workflows, data models, APIs, and how Salesforce connects with the broader enterprise technology landscape. You define the technical approach for complex problems where established playbooks don't exist and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise customers on Salesforce architecture, integrations, and implementations.

* **Team:** Senior technical individual contributor within the Delivery organisation, owning Salesforce architecture and complex enterprise implementations.
* **Building:** Mission-critical, agentic AI integrations involving complex Salesforce environments at enterprise scale, solving problems for which no established playbook exists.
* **You'll work with:** CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Engineering, Salesforce leaders, and enterprise architecture teams at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies.

**What you'll do:**

* **Own architecture for complex Salesforce implementations.** Design and deliver solutions across Salesforce ecosystems, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Salesforce Platform, and related enterprise applications, addressing complex business workflows, data models, and cross-system dependencies.
* **Be the technical point of contact for enterprise accounts.** Serve as the senior Salesforce technical voice customers trust, taking ownership of critical implementation initiatives, solution design, and technical problem-solving.
* **Make critical technical decisions.** Drive decisions around Salesforce architecture, Apex development, Lightning Web Components (LWC), data modelling, automation, API integrations, authentication, governor limits, error handling, and performance at enterprise scale.
* **Build scalable integrations.** Design and implement robust integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, middleware, and other integration patterns.
* **Speak credibly to enterprise security teams.** Engage with customer security and compliance stakeholders on Salesforce security architecture, role-based access controls, profiles, permission sets, SSO, OAuth, data security, and enterprise deployment practices.
* **Shape product direction.** Translate recurring challenges across Salesforce implementations, customer accounts, and enterprise deals into product requirements, reusable capabilities, and architectural improvements, partnering closely with Product and Engineering.
* **Codify what works.** Build Salesforce reference architectures, implementation patterns, solution blueprints, reusable components, and technical runbooks that improve delivery efficiency and scale implementation knowledge across the team.
* **Support high-stakes enterprise deals.** Partner with pre-sales and customer-facing teams to lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, solution design discussions, proof of concepts, and technical deep dives.

**What we're looking for:**

* 3-5 years of experience in Salesforce development, Salesforce technical consulting, or enterprise solutions architecture, with a strong track record of designing and delivering complex Salesforce implementations.
* **Mandatory hands-on Salesforce development experience**, including Salesforce Platform, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce automation capabilities.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce products and architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce APIs, security models, data architecture, and enterprise implementation approaches.
* Deep expertise in Salesforce integration capabilities, including REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Bulk APIs, and middleware-based integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of enterprise application landscapes, data modelling, distributed systems, and modern cloud infrastructure.
* Ability to solve complex technical problems from first principles and design scalable solutions where established implementation patterns may not exist.
* Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Salesforce leaders, and enterprise architects.
* Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, and comfort with ambiguity and building the playbook as you go.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, and agent orchestration).
* Experience integrating Salesforce with AI-powered applications, autonomous agents, and enterprise automation platforms.
* Prior experience as a Principal/Staff Salesforce Developer, Salesforce Architect, Technical Lead, Enterprise Solutions Architect, or Founding Solutions Engineer at a high-growth enterprise startup.
* Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer II, Platform Architect, Application Architect, or System Architect.
* Experience with Salesforce products such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, and Salesforce Platform.
* Experience with integration and middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure), containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes), and modern data infrastructure.

title: Software Engineer I -Data Infrastructure
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About The Role**

The Data Infrastructure Team is a lean, high-impact group operating in a true founder mode. We are responsible for building and safeguarding all data systems, managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade resources across 10+ types of data stores. Our core mission is to build self-serve, automated platforms that ensure our systems are efficient, scalable, and continuously evolving. We don’t just operate systems—we invent them.

**What You Will Do**

We are looking for enthusiastic, innovative engineers to join our engineering team as Software Engineers (SDE-1). In this role, you’ll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to real-world projects from day one, and gain exposure to cutting-edge tools and technologies. You’ll play a key role in building and optimizing products that reach millions of users globally. you will join one of our many teams to develop robust, well-designed products, implement new updates and features, and solve complex problems that affect our business and our clients.

* Invent, design, and build self-serve, automated platforms for managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade data resources across 10+ data store types.
* Drive innovation by engineering foundational tooling for all engineering teams, such as the Database Proxy and the database replication services.
* Pioneer and execute complex projects like large-scale, zero-downtime database migrations.
* Go deep into technical architecture, distributed systems, protocol-level debugging, and performance optimization to ensure systems are reliable, scalable, and efficient at petabyte scale.
* Build and maintain the core foundations for strategic initiatives, including multi-region architecture, sandbox environments, and a comprehensive, Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code platform.
* Focus intensely on performance, observability, cost and operability to maintain infrastructure that just works, even when handling ~100 billion queries/day and 10 PB of data transfer.
* Write core libraries like middlewares, ORMs, proxies, rate limiters, shard routers (in Python and Go) to support scalability and developer experience.
* Take end-to-end ownership of projects, from initial design and planning to successful rollout and operation.

**What You Will Have**

  

* 1-2 years experience working with fast growing, top tier product companies
* Strong coding in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or Go.
* Expert understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design principles and low level design
* Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in a collaborative environment
* Understanding of system design and complex distributed systems
* Eagerness to learn new technologies and apply them to solve real-world problems.
* Bonus points for open source contributions, competitive coding experience, and a strong Computer Science background from a Tier 1 institution.

**Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
description:
**The Role**
------------

Sarvam's products produce events, model traces, evals and billing data, and need to read that data back. The Data Platform team builds and runs the central data infrastructure every product uses: ingestion, streaming, the analytical warehouse, transformations, access control and audit.

We are hiring a Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (2–5 years of experience) to own this platform end to end. You will design, build and run systems that other teams depend on in production, and make real decisions on database internals, streaming and platform design. Stack: Go/Python, ClickHouse Cloud, Kafka, Avro, Airflow, dbt, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS.

**What You'll Own & Do**
------------------------

* **Build and run the ingestion path:** the service every product sends events to, Kafka behind it, and the pipes that land data in ClickHouse within seconds. Own schema validation, rate limits, dead-letter handling and the client SDKs.
* **Own the warehouse:** ClickHouse Cloud. Design tables for the read path (sorting keys, partitions, materialized views, TTL), separate compute per workload, set per-user limits and per-tenant isolation, and attribute cost to the team that spent it.
* **Build reliable data pipelines and solve data problems:** dbt models and Airflow DAGs with the BI engineers, CDC from product databases, sync and backfill jobs that are safe to re-run, and the data problems product teams bring you, such as a late source, a number that doesn't match or a query that has slowed down.
* **Make the platform self-serve:** a registry of every dataset with its owner, schema, freshness and access; provisioning and permissions as code.
* **Run it in production:** everything as Terraform and Helm with metrics, traces and alerts; be on call; handle incidents end to end, write the RCA and fix the root cause.
* **Grow the platform:** new products keep arriving. You will help decide what the platform should do next and build it, whether that is a new source or sink, or a new way for teams to use the data.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2–5 years of experience building, shipping and running large-scale, data-intensive systems in production, ideally at a startup where you owned things and were on call for them.
* Deep expertise in at least one of: an OLAP database (ClickHouse preferred; Druid, BigQuery or Redshift also fine) or Kafka / event streaming. You understand how a columnar store writes, merges and scans data, or how a partitioned log gives ordering and delivery guarantees.
* Experience with large-scale messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ: partitions, consumer groups, delivery guarantees, backpressure.
* Good at Go, or good at Python.
* You know the usual data-system problems: schema evolution, idempotency, backpressure, partitioning, retention and TTL, CDC.
* You have built or run at least one of: an event pipeline, a transformation layer (dbt, Spark or SQL on Airflow), a provisioning or control-plane service, or a multi-tenant data service with access control.
* Comfortable with AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform in production.
* You test before shipping, debug with metrics and traces, write RCAs, and document what you build.
* Passion for data infrastructure and for enabling others by making their data easier to access.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* ClickHouse in production: MergeTree, materialized views, projections, quotas, settings profiles, row policies, ClickHouse Cloud.
* Kafka in depth: MSK, Kafka Connect, schema registry (Glue or Confluent), Avro.
* dbt and Airflow at scale.
* Audit or security data systems: append-only logs, integrity checks, tenant isolation.
* OpenTelemetry, LLM observability (Langfuse or similar), eval pipelines.
* Built an internal platform that other teams adopted.

The ideal candidate will design, implement, validate, and productionize algorithms that transform complex scientific and operational data into actionable insights. The role will work closely with domain experts, data scientists, data engineers, and platform teams to develop robust solutions for data analysis, signal and image processing, predictive analytics, and machine learning.

As our data platform evolves from the current AWS-based environment toward Databricks, the candidate will also play an important role in migrating and modernizing algorithmic and analytical workloads. This includes adapting Python-based computational workflows for distributed processing, developing reusable features for analytics and machine learning, and helping establish scalable ML development and operational practices on Databricks.

This role does **not** own core data ingestion or ETL pipelines. It focuses on the analytical and algorithmic layer that consumes curated data provided by the data engineering platform.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain algorithms for processing, analyzing, and modeling scientific and operational data.
* Develop robust Python-based computational workflows using appropriate scientific computing, data analysis, and machine learning libraries.
* Analyze complex datasets to identify patterns, derive meaningful features, and develop predictive or diagnostic insights.
* Develop and optimize algorithms for areas such as signal processing, image analysis, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and other data-driven applications.
* Evaluate algorithm performance through systematic testing, validation, benchmarking, and comparison against defined performance criteria.
* Collaborate with domain experts and data scientists to translate scientific and business problems into practical analytical and algorithmic solutions.
* Collaborate with data engineers to define data requirements and consume reliable, curated datasets without duplicating ingestion and ETL responsibilities.
* Develop reusable, modular, testable, and maintainable Python components for algorithmic and analytical workloads.
* Improve the performance and scalability of computational workloads, including the adoption of distributed processing where appropriate.
* Support the migration of existing algorithmic and analytical workloads from the current AWS-based data platform to Databricks.
* Refactor and adapt existing Python and analytical workloads to operate effectively with Databricks, Spark/PySpark, Delta-based datasets, and distributed compute where appropriate.
* Develop reusable features and feature-generation logic that can be consistently used for experimentation, model training, batch inference, and production applications.
* Contribute to the adoption of structured ML lifecycle practices including experiment tracking, reproducibility, model validation, versioning, deployment, and monitoring.
* Work with platform and ML engineering teams to productionize algorithms and machine learning models through repeatable and automated workflows.
* Participate in technical design discussions, solution reviews, estimation, and implementation planning for algorithm and ML solutions.
* Apply software engineering practices including source control, automated testing, code review, CI/CD, documentation, and observability to algorithm and ML development.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to engineering standards and reusable development practices.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

* 8–12 years of professional experience in software engineering, algorithm development, scientific computing, data science, machine learning, or related technical disciplines.
* Strong hands-on programming experience with Python and experience developing production-quality Python software.
* Strong experience with scientific computing and data analysis libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing and implementing data-processing, analytical, mathematical, or predictive algorithms.
* Experience working with complex datasets and developing data-driven models, features, or analytical workflows.
* Experience in one or more areas such as machine learning, predictive analytics, signal processing, image processing, time-series analysis, optimization, or statistical modeling.
* Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals including feature engineering, model training, validation, evaluation, and inference.
* Experience translating exploratory or prototype algorithms into maintainable and production-ready implementations.
* Good understanding of software engineering principles including modular design, object-oriented programming, testing, maintainability, and performance optimization.
* Experience working with cloud-based data and compute environments, preferably AWS.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience accessing and analyzing structured datasets.
* Understanding of scalable or distributed data-processing concepts and the considerations involved in processing large datasets.
* Experience with source control systems such as Git.
* Understanding of CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps practices, and modern software development workflows.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers, data scientists, domain experts, platform engineers, and application-development teams.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark or PySpark for distributed data processing.
* Experience developing machine learning or analytical workloads using Databricks notebooks, jobs, or equivalent managed compute environments.
* Familiarity with Delta Lake and lakehouse-based data architectures.
* Experience with MLflow or equivalent tools for experiment tracking, model management, and ML lifecycle management.
* Experience developing and managing reusable features for machine learning, including exposure to feature stores or feature engineering frameworks.
* Familiarity with Unity Catalog or similar approaches to data, feature, and model governance.
* Experience productionizing machine learning models for batch or real-time inference.
* Understanding of MLOps practices including model versioning, reproducibility, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and retraining workflows.
* Experience optimizing Python or Spark workloads for performance and scalability.
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and deployment into cloud-based environments.
* Experience integrating analytical algorithms or ML models into APIs, digital services, applications, or embedded systems.
* Experience working with scientific instrumentation, engineering data, image data, sensor data, or other complex technical datasets.
* Experience working in industrial R&D, scientific, engineering, or product-oriented development environments.

**Behavioral Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex technical and scientific problems.
* Ability to move between exploratory algorithm development and disciplined production software engineering.
* Ability to learn new technologies and adapt existing solutions as the underlying data and analytics platform evolves.
* Strong ownership and accountability for algorithm and ML deliverables from initial exploration through production use.
* Ability to make pragmatic technical choices between conventional Python processing, distributed processing, and machine learning approaches.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain analytical methods, assumptions, results, and technical trade-offs clearly.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams including software engineering, data engineering, data science, platform engineering, and domain specialists.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.
* Strong focus on software quality, reproducibility, performance, and maintainability.
* Curiosity and willingness to develop new technical capabilities as the organization transitions toward a Databricks-based data and AI platform.

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electronics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

title: ServiceNow Developer - Contract Role (6 Months)
description:

The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise across the ServiceNow platform, the ability to customise applications, develop integrations, and automate business workflows.

You will work closely with business analysts, technical teams, and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable, efficient, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions. * Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and resolve identified defects.
* Manage application changes across development, test, and production environments.
* Work with update sets and application repository practices for controlled deployments.

* Collaborate with business analysts, functional consultants, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements.
* Translate functional requirements into technical specifications and development tasks.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
* Provide regular updates on development progress, issues, and delivery timelines.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables and ensure timely completion within the contract period.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum **4+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development**.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and application development.
* Experience with JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting.
* Hands-on experience with Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, and ACLs.
* Experience with Service Catalog, Flow Designer, and workflow automation.
* Good understanding of ITSM processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management.
* Experience developing REST and SOAP API integrations.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow tables, forms, lists, and database structures.
* Experience with debugging, troubleshooting, testing, and deployment activities.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and contribute effectively in a time-bound contract engagement.

title: Director - AI Engineering
description:
GE Vernova is embracing cutting-edge technologies to streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and drive growth. As part of this vision, we are building a dedicated team to leverage Generative AI and redefine how we engage with our industry. The ultimate goal of the team is to automate prompting, develop a framework for prompting across use cases to maximize reuse as well as sharing across businesses.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating and optimizing prompts for LLMs, collaborating with domain experts and end users to develop software solutions that address both internal and external needs. This position offers a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and traditional industry, making a tangible impact on our business processes.
  
  
We are driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.
  
Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into clear and effective LLM prompts.
* Develop, test, and refine prompts for a variety of use cases, ensuring high accuracy and relevance in generated outputs.
* Work closely with software developers to integrate LLM solutions into existing or new applications.
* Contribute to the development of a scalable framework for prompt engineering, promoting reuse and knowledge sharing across different business units.
* Assist in gathering and analyzing user feedback to continually improve prompt effectiveness.
* Stay up-to-date with advancements in LLM technology and contribute to strategic decisions on tool and platform selection.
Document prompt engineering processes, best practices, and use case outcomes to build a comprehensive knowledge base.  

**Qualifications/Requirements:**

* **Master’s/ PhD degree** in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field with **15+ years' relevant experience**.
* **5+ years of experience in people management**, with demonstrated success leading and scaling software engineering organizations.
* Experience with prompt engineering and familiarity with tools such as OpenAI’s GPT models, Hugging Face, etc.
* Proficiency in Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI/ML development.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing project requirements.
Candidate must be willing to travel a minimum of 2 weeks per year  

**Ideal Candidate Characteristics:**

* PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, or related field
* Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and data processing libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
* Previous experience or internships involving NLP or machine learning projects.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Understanding of traditional industry operations and challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior Manager Software Engineering
description:
**Overview**  
**About Business Unit:**  
Platform Services specializes in the implementation, management and evolution of Custom and PeopleCloud solutions, offering end-to-end support for clients. Our team of experts handles platform setup, ongoing management, and strategic enhancements, ensuring that our solutions adapt to changing business needs. From loyalty programs to digital activation, our platforms empower clients to implement campaigns, generate insights, and streamline business activities, all with a focus on seamless integration and continuous improvement. By collaborating with client partners and strategy teams, we create impactful campaigns tailored to each client's unique objectives.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  
**What You Will Do**  
  
You will lead engineering outcomes across multiple teams and initiatives, balancing business priorities, client commitments, technical strategy, quality, talent development, and innovation. You will promote AI-assisted ways of working and enable leaders and engineers to operate effectively across traditional role boundaries.
  
**Delivery & Portfolio Leadership**  

* Own end-to-end delivery of multiple strategic software programs, ensuring predictable execution, measurable outcomes, quality, transparency, and timely management of risks and dependencies.
* Lead planning, estimation, engineering, testing, implementation, transition, and production stabilization across build, enhancement, modernization, migration, and maintenance initiatives.
* Align capacity, skills, priorities, milestones, and dependencies across teams; make informed trade-offs and call out material risks with clear mitigation options.
* Establish outcome-focused governance using delivery health, quality, productivity, customer impact, and operational measures rather than activity alone.
* Ensure alignment to engineering standards, security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, documentation, and support-readiness expectations.
* Promote continuous improvement through retrospectives, root-cause analysis, reusable practices, automation, and evidence-based decision-making.

**Client & Stakeholder Partnership**  

* Partner with clients, product leaders, business collaborators, architects, analysts, quality leaders, data teams, and operations teams to understand objectives and shape scalable solutions.
* Lead customer workshops, solution discussions, technical presentations, roadmap conversations, and executive governance forums.
* Build trusted relationships, establish clear expectations, manage issues constructively, and communicate decisions, trade-offs, risks, and mitigation plans with transparency.
* Translate business objectives into technology strategies, investment priorities, capability roadmaps, and measurable engineering outcomes.
* Communicate delivery health, key performance indicators, solution risks, quality trends, innovation progress, and strategic recommendations to senior partners.

**AI Strategy, Engineering & Innovation**  

* Architect model and framework strategy, RAG/knowledge architecture, embeddings/vector search, prompt/context management, tool integration, agent orchestration, memory, guardrails, evaluation and human oversight.
* Define and implement an AI adoption roadmap across engineering, analysis, quality, support, knowledge management, and customer-solution use cases.
* Identify high-value Generative AI and Agentic AI opportunities, prioritize use cases, sponsor prototypes, define success measures, and scale proven patterns responsibly.
* Promote effective use of frameworks and services such as LangChain, LangGraph, Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI, Amazon Q, Kiro, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent technologies.
* Apply responsible AI practices covering privacy, security, intellectual property, data handling, model limitations, accuracy, bias awareness, explainability, traceability, and accountable human oversight.
* Create an environment that supports responsible experimentation, reusable accelerators, knowledge sharing, and measurable improvement in engineering productivity and customer value.

**Technical Strategy & Engineering Leadership**  

* Provide architectural direction and technical guidance across enterprise web, API, integration, distributed, data, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Guide conversion of high-level designs into detailed designs covering components, APIs, data models, algorithms, schemas, integration contracts, security, resilience, performance, and non-functional requirements.
* Partner with architects and technical leads to evaluate solution options and ensure appropriate scalability, security, maintainability, observability, accessibility, and cost effectiveness.
* Drive engineering excellence through design reviews, code reviews, architecture governance, quality standards, technical-debt management, performance analysis, and root-cause prevention.
* Maintain sufficient hands-on technical awareness to challenge assumptions, assess feasibility, guide complex decisions, and support resolution of critical engineering issues.
* Promote modern engineering patterns for C#/.NET, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Angular, APIs, event-driven systems, distributed applications, and data-intensive workloads.

**Quality Engineering & Technical Assurance**  

* Own the quality strategy across teams, including testability, automation, code quality, data quality, performance, resilience, security validation, and production readiness.
* Ensure quality is built into discovery, design, development, and support rather than treated as a separate downstream activity.
* Establish appropriate review mechanisms, test coverage expectations, traceability, defect-prevention practices, release validations, and operational acceptance criteria.
* Use trends from defects, incidents, customer feedback, and engineering measures to direct corrective and preventive improvements.
* Promote AI-assisted test design, review, defect analysis, and knowledge discovery while requiring accountable validation of generated outputs.

**Data, Platforms & Solution Integration**  

* Guide scalable data modelling, integration, batch and real-time processing, data-quality controls, and performance strategies across enterprise solutions.
* Provide oversight for solutions using Oracle, MySQL, DynamoDB, Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent data platforms.
* Guide designs involving REST APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, integration platforms, and technologies such as SnapLogic, DataHub, or equivalents.
* Ensure data solutions address reliability, lineage, security, privacy, interoperability, and business usability.

**People Leadership & Organizational Capability**  

* Lead, coach, and mentor engineering managers, technical leads, and engineers across multiple teams.
* Build a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, inclusion, collaboration, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and customer focus.
* Drive workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, goal alignment, regular feedback, career development, succession planning, recognition, retention, and employee engagement.
* Develop future-ready capabilities across software engineering, architecture, quality, data, AI, automation, client engagement, and domain knowledge.
* Create clear ownership and decision mechanisms while empowering leaders and teams to implement effectively.
* Address performance and team-health concerns fairly, consistently, transparently, and in alignment with organizational policies.

**Flexibility, Automation & Continuous Improvement**  

* Enable teams to flex across business analysis, architecture, development, quality engineering, data, automation, documentation, and production support based on delivery priorities while preserving role depth and accountability.
* Use workflow automation and low-code tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent technologies to streamline repeatable engineering and business processes where appropriate.
* Encourage cross-skilling, communities of practice, reusable assets, structured knowledge management, and movement across adjacent responsibilities.
* Continuously improve engineering practices, operating models, collaboration, customer responsiveness, and delivery efficiency using measurable evidence.

  
**Qualifications**  
**Essential Education & Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 13+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading multiple engineering teams in customer-facing environments.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex, enterprise-scale software programs and leading multi-functional teams using Agile delivery practices.
* Experience managing engineering leaders and teams while balancing client commitments, technical strategy, delivery outcomes, quality, and people development.
* Strong leadership, communication, presentation, stakeholder management, decision-making, organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.

**Core Technical & Leadership Skills**  

* Strong technical understanding of C#, .NET/.NET Core, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, object-oriented design, design patterns, and modern web architecture.
* Working knowledge of React or Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, and responsive application design.
* Strong understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, relational and NoSQL data modelling, database performance, data integration, batch and real-time processing, and enterprise data platforms.
* Ability to guide architecture, engineering standards, application security, performance, observability, quality engineering, automated testing, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Experience with Git-based collaboration, peer review, Agile engineering, structured release management, and enterprise change governance.
* Ability to connect technology choices to business outcomes, customer experience, delivery risk, talent capability, and long-term maintainability.

**AI & Future Skills**  

* Strong AI architecture capability across RAG, agentic systems, model evaluation, guardrails, identity, data protection, observability and cost/performance trade-offs.
* Demonstrated architecture ownership for a meaningful AI solution from discovery through implementation, evaluation and operational readiness.
* Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI, or comparable AI frameworks and services.
* Ability to define AI strategy, prioritize use cases, guide prototypes, assess feasibility and risk, establish adoption measures, and scale successful practices.
* Ability to promote AI-assisted ways of working across analysis, architecture, development, testing, documentation, knowledge management, and support with appropriate controls.

**Desirable Skills & Experience**  

* Experience leading engineering for CRM, loyalty, marketing technology, customer data, high-volume transaction, or large-scale distributed platforms.
* Experience with data and integration technologies such as Redshift, Snowflake, DynamoDB, SnapLogic, DataHub, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience using Python, scripting, workflow automation, n8n, low-code/no-code platforms, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience establishing engineering communities, reusable accelerators, knowledge-management practices, or enterprise modernization programs.
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating successful experiments into governed, repeatable delivery capabilities.

**Personal Attributes**  

* Strong customer focus, business insight, critical thinking, and an ownership mapproach
* Excellent leadership, coaching, mentoring, communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management capability.
* Collaborative, adaptable, resilient, decisive, and results oriented while remaining open to challenge and new evidence.
* Passion for innovation, continuous improvement, inclusive leadership, talent development, and measurable business impact.
* Professionalism, integrity, sound judgement, transparency, and accountability in decisions affecting customers, people, and technology.

**Success in This Role**  
  
Success is demonstrated through predictable delivery of strategic outcomes, strong client trust, secure and maintainable solutions, measurable improvements in quality and productivity, growth of engineering leaders and teams, responsible AI adoption, and an organisation that can flex across adjacent capabilities without compromising accountability or technical excellence.
  
  
**Additional Information**  
Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.  
  
Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.  
  
Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.  

* **People centricity:** We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.
* **Collaboration:** We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* **Growth:** There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* **Innovation:** We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches.
* **Flexibility:** We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

  
Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

  
These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.  
  
**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
  
Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

title: Senior AI Developer, Internal Audit (Agentic Systems)
description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit’s Internal Audit (IA) team provides independent, objective assurance and advisory services that add value and improve Intuit’s operations. We are transforming the function from a traditional assurance model into an AI-enabled one, and our newly established Center of Excellence (CoE) drives our technology-enabled and data-driven initiatives.

As a Senior AI Developer in the Internal Audit Center of Excellence (CoE), you will be at the forefront of driving digital transformation by building next-generation agentic AI solutions. Unlike traditional generative AI tools that primarily respond to prompts, your focus will be on developing autonomous agents capable of planning, executing, and adapting actions to achieve complex audit objectives with minimal human intervention. By integrating cutting-edge AI and advanced data connectors into audit planning, fieldwork, and reporting, you will drive full-population testing and unlock data-driven predictive insights.

You will develop AI agents that plan, execute, and adapt to meet complex audit objectives with minimal human intervention. You will bridge gaps in data identification and usage for advanced machine learning and practical audit execution, moving the function from sample-based checks to AI-enabled, data-driven predictive insights.

**Responsibilities**

**Agentic Solution Development**
--------------------------------

* Design and code AI agents that autonomously navigate across systems to test controls, flag anomalies, and track transactions in near real-time.
* Build multi-step planning systems capable of dynamic audit planning and scoping by analyzing risk registers, operational data, and external indicators.
* Implement and manage agentic capabilities across established LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), utilizing tools like Claude Code for enterprise-grade automation.
* Develop standardized prompt libraries and internal AI-assisted reporting tools to enhance auditor productivity and coverage.

**Technical Build**

* Utilize Python, SQL, and R to build robust data pipelines (ETL) and automation scripts for full-population data testing.
* Build and extend audit tooling, including AI-powered prototypes, user-facing tools (using React, Node.js, and TypeScript), Slack bots for evidence tracking, and real-time interactive dashboards.
* Ensure all AI solutions follow rigorous Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes, including automated testing, code reviews, and secure deployment in cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP).
* Implement security guardrails for agent-to-system access and sensitive data handling such as role-based access controls and PII masking within the architecture
* Technically validate data lineage from raw database entries through transformation layers to final audit reports to prevent data corruption.

**Collaboration**

* Work with the Internal audit AI/Data systems lead on technical design and incorporate review feedback
* Partner with Technology and audit teams to translate audit and compliance requirements into automated solutions
* Share technical expertise with the broader audit team to support adoption of AI tools

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in software development, data science, or technology audit automation, including 2+ years building AI/ML solutions with a focus on agentic workflows and LLM integration
* Exposure or Experience with Internal Audit highly preferred
* Experience in deploying agentic AI solutions
* Proficiency in Python and SQL for data transformation, pipeline building, and system integration
* Experience with major LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen), and AI developer tools (Cursor)
* Working knowledge of version control (Git/GitHub/GitLab), CI/CD pipelines, and AI-assisted development workflows
* Working knowledge of front-end technologies (React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS) to build user-facing audit tools preferred
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt as AI technologies evolve
* Ability to translate complex technical agentic logic into clear business language for executive audiences

**Desired Technical skills**

* Experience with AI assurance, model risk management, or ethical AI governance frameworks
* Working knowledge of data lineage and data quality controls

**Education & Certifications**
------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* **Certifications:** Desired certifications include AWS/GCP Cloud Architect, CISA, or specialized AI/ML certifications from major providers.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. title: Security Software Engineering Technical Leader--Cisco Intersight
description:
Meet the Team
  
Cisco Intersight is a cloud-native operations platform that provides unified management, automation, visibility, and lifecycle operations for infrastructure across data center, cloud, and edge environments. As we integrate AI-driven intelligence into our platform, our SaaS, on-premises, and mobile offerings depend on secure, reliable, and high-performance software engineering to build, test, release and operate complex systems at scale.
  
  
Your Impact
  
You are a Security-Focused Software Engineer providing a dual-lens approach to our architecture: senior security guidance and hands-on software development. Partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, SRE, and Cisco’s Security and Trust Organization (STO), you build secure, resilient, and scalable platform features—including AI-powered capabilities—while maintaining thorough compliance standards. As a primary technical bridge between software development and security, you write production-grade code, assess the security impact of feature designs (including AI services), and build automation to improve our security posture.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Use Go or Java to implement platform security features and core infrastructure.
* Partner with engineering teams to design secure patterns for AI/ML model deployment, data protection, and inference security within the Intersight ecosystem.
* Automate security tooling, vulnerability remediation, and continuous compliance checks using Python.
* Interpret Cisco-level mandates and security procedures into actionable code, control expectations, and automated remediation workflows.
* Review new feature designs, AI architectures and infrastructure changes, identifying security gaps early and recommending mitigations that balance usability, performance, and security.
* Guide remediation priorities across automated scans, penetration tests, and security reviews, ensuring issues are triaged, assigned, and supervised to closure.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors' degree in and 8 years of experience designing and maintaining production quality backend systems to include:
* 5 years using Go or Java within a Microservices architecture.
* 3 years focused on DevSecOps or application security.
* Experience using Python for security automation and tooling.
* Experience with secure development lifecycle (SDLC) requirements and translating security findings into practical code-based remediation plans.
* Knowledge of vulnerability triage, automated security scan findings, and SLA-based remediation workflows.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience developing or securing AI/ML workloads, including familiarity with common AI security frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs) and MLOps security.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native platforms, including AWS, Docker and Kubernetes, and how to secure them via Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible).
* Proven ability to balance deep-dive technical software development tasks with broad-scope security policy and compliance mandates.
* Experience with Cisco security mandates, policies, or product security processes.
* Familiarity with compliance audits such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or GDPR/privacy regulations.
* Security or cloud certifications such as CISSP, CCSP or cloud-provider-specific developer certifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to facilitate technical discussions regarding security trade-offs in software design.

description:
