With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

 **Job Description**

**Hardware Design Engineer – LV/HV Power Electronics & Inverters**

**Role Summary**

Responsible for the end-to-end design and development of low-voltage and high-voltage power electronics hardware, including DC/DC converters and low-power inverter systems, covering analog/digital circuitry, simulations, PCB design support, testing, and compliance with automotive standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design analog and digital circuits using microcontrollers, op-amps, transistor families, and mixed-signal interfaces.
* Develop low-voltage DC/DC converters and high-voltage wide-input flyback converters (multiple outputs, isolation, transformer design, feedback).
* Design B6 bridge HV inverter (1200V) using SiC MOSFETs, gate drivers, HV filter protection, thermal design, PCB stack-up and insulation.
* Perform worst-case design calculations, derating, stress and power-loss analysis.
* Conduct PSpice/LTspice simulations (time-domain, frequency-domain, Monte Carlo).
* Create schematics in Zuken CR8000/OrCAD and support PCB layout (Allegro/PADS) with considerations for EMC, PCB stack-up, PCB track characteristics, and manufacturability.
* Capture/analyze customer requirements using IBM DOORS NG and follow ASPICE processes.
* Support hardware testing, debugging (Design of experiments), and validation.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 16750, ISO 7637, CISPR 25, ISO 11452, and reinforced insulation standards (12V/24V/400-800V).

Required Skills

* Analog & mixed‑signal circuit design using MCUs, op‑amps, BJTs/MOSFETs, ADC/DAC interfaces, and standard communication interfaces (SPI, I²C, UART, CAN).
* Power electronics design experience with low‑voltage DC/DC converters and wide‑input isolated flyback converters, including magnetics, feedback, and multi‑output regulation.
* High‑voltage inverter design expertise (up to 1200 V) with SiC MOSFETs, isolated gate drivers, protection concepts, thermal design, and reinforced insulation.
* Strong analytical capability in worst‑case design, derating, stress analysis, and power‑loss/thermal calculations.
* Proficiency in circuit simulation using PSpice/LTspice for transient, AC (loop stability), and Monte‑Carlo/worst‑case analysis.
* Schematic design and PCB layout support using Zuken CR8000/OrCAD and Allegro/PADS, with focus on EMC, high‑voltage spacing, stack‑up, and manufacturability.
* Requirements engineering experience using IBM DOORS NG with adherence to ASPICE development and change‑management processes.
* Hands‑on hardware debugging and validation skills, including structured root cause analysis (DoE) and lab‑based troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of automotive standards and compliance, including ISO 16750, ISO 7637, CISPR 25, ISO 11452, and insulation requirements for 12 V/24 V/400–800 V systems.

  
**Qualifications**

Electronics (BE/ME)

 **Additional Information**

> 6yrs

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Everyday Essentials Experience Org delivers a world-class shopping experience for everyday essentials that is efficient, habitual, and economical for customers and selling partners. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with strong ownership and a drive to solve complex, large-scale problems through creative solutions.  
  
The Everyday Essential Cost to Serve team drives multi-million dollar cost savings for Amazon through its multipack programs. The team owns how Amazon represents, prices, and fulfills multipack products worldwide, and is currently executing a ground-up re-architecture of the multipack platform as a leadership-priority initiative, promoting multipacks to first-class purchasable products. This work changes how millions of customers discover, purchase, and receive multipacks, and how selling partners manage their multipack catalog.  
  
What makes this role unique is the breadth. Your work will span the entire retail funnel: ASIN creation, catalog ingestion, pricing determination, selection and ranking, and customer-facing experiences on Search, Detail Page, Cart, Checkout,  
and the multipacks storefront. You will work closely with the science team and have the opportunity to develop and influence the models that drive multipack selection and personalization. Few teams at Amazon offer this combination of  
end-to-end systems exposure.  
  
You will build systems that separate what a customer buys from how it is fulfilled, enabling seamless multipack experiences from online multipacks fulfilled with individual units to physical products shipped as a single item. You will have the freedom to experiment, propose new multipack experiences, and ship them worldwide. Your ideas move from whiteboard to production, visible to hundreds of millions of customers. Design, build, and own end-to-end software solutions that are scalable, reliable, and maintainable across the full software development lifecycle.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, AI Trust and Innovation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking an exceptional Software Development Engineer III to build the foundational systems and consumer-facing features that enable trustworthy, accessible AI experiences at scale. You will partner closely with our Product Manager-Technical to design and implement AI-driven operational tooling, provable data-governance frameworks, and accessibility features that set the standard for consumer AI products.  
  
This is a high-impact role where you'll tackle complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer trust—reducing operational burden through automation, making data classified, controlled and provably compliant, and ensuring the experiences we ship work for every customer.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
What You'll Build  
  
Data Governance — Classified, Controlled & Provably Compliant:  
  

* Build data-classification and tagging systems that identify and label sensitive data at scale without linear headcount growth

  

* Design redaction, filtering, and crypto-shredding / delete-by-key pipelines that enforce data-handling restrictions provably and at runtime

  

* Create data-minimization and access-control frameworks that let the business demonstrate compliance on demand

  

* Operate and harden live production governance systems, instrumenting them so compliance posture is measurable and auditable

  
AI Enablement Systems:  
  

* Build AI-powered metrics and conversational agents that give the org self-serve program health, root-cause analysis, and LLM-generated summaries across trust, privacy, and OE metrics

  

* Design config-driven agent frameworks (tool-calling, action groups, investigation protocols) so new capabilities and metrics onboard without code changes

  

* Develop debugging and log-traceability agents that trace an interaction end-to-end across every service component, so engineers debug in minutes instead of hunting logs per system

  

* Architect agent authentication and token-propagation (e.g. user-identity / Midway into agent tool calls) that is secure by design

  
Inclusive Experience — Accessibility by Design:  
  

* Develop accessibility features for AI experiences that work across diverse abilities, contexts, and modalities from the start rather than as an afterthought

  

* Build the instrumentation that measures accessibility coverage and adoption so inclusive experiences are tracked like any other first-class metric

  

* Create cross-device, multimodal interfaces (text, voice, visual) that preserve a consistent, inclusive experience across surfaces

  

* Partner with UX and research to turn inclusive-design principles into shipped, measurable product capabilities

  
Key Technical Challenges  
  

* Automation vs. Accuracy: Drive operational burden down through AI automation while keeping leadership-facing metrics and root-cause output correct and trustworthy

  

* Governance at Scale: Classify and control sensitive data across high scale volume without linear headcount growth, and prove compliance rather than assert it

  

* End-to-End Observability: Trace interactions across many distributed service components with low latency, surfacing the right context for fast debugging

  

* Multimodal & Inclusive Systems: Architect systems that handle text, voice, and visual inputs while delivering an accessible experience across modalities and devices

  
What Makes You Successful  
  
Customer Obsession for Trust: You deeply understand that trust is earned through consistent, transparent, and privacy-respecting experiences. You make technical decisions that prioritize customer trust even when it means additional complexity.  
  
Technical Excellence: You have strong computer science fundamentals and practical experience building distributed systems. You write clean, maintainable code and establish best practices that enable your team to move fast without breaking things.  
  
AI & Privacy Expertise: You understand both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems. You know how to implement privacy-preserving techniques without sacrificing user experience.  
  
Bias for Action: You thrive in ambiguous environments where you need to make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation and safety. You ship iteratively and learn from customer feedback.  
  
Collaboration & Communication: You partner effectively with product managers, UX designers, data scientists, and other engineers. You can explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and influence architectural decisions across teams.  
  
Inclusive Mindset: You design systems that work for all customers, considering diverse abilities, contexts, and use cases from the start rather than as an afterthought.  
  
Why Join Us  
  

* Work on generative AI technology that impacts millions of customers daily

  

* Shape the future of responsible AI and set industry standards for privacy and trust

  

* Partner with world-class product, design, and research teams

  

* Solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer protection

  

* Build systems that make AI accessible and trustworthy for everyone

  
A day in the life  
You will be working with a group of talented engineers and scientists on running experiments to test scientific proposal/solutions to improve our trust-preserving experiences. This will involve collaboration with partner teams including engineering, PMs, data annotators, and other scientists to discuss data quality, policy, and model development. You work closely with partner teams across Alexa to deliver platform features that require cross-team leadership.  
  
About the team  
Who We Are:  
Trust CX Innovations is a strategic innovation team within Amazon Devices & Services that focuses on advancing AI technology while prioritizing customer trust and experience. Our team operates at the intersection of artificial intelligence, privacy engineering and customer-centric design.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Software Principal Engineer - System Test & Customer Solutions Validation
description:
**Principal Software Engineer – System Test & Customer Solutions Validation (SONiC AI & Enterprise Networking)**

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for enabling customer adoption of SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions, from POCs and deployment validation to complex escalations. You will work with customers, support, pre-sales, solution architects, and engineering teams on fabric orchestration, deployment readiness, and resolution of customer issues. As a successful candidate, you will be a technically savvy, customer-focused engineer who bridges customers and engineering, resolves critical issues, and accelerates adoption of reliable, scalable, customer-ready SONiC-based networking and AI fabric solutions.

**You will:**

* Serve as the first line of escalation into engineering for support and pre-sales, troubleshooting customer issues and driving workarounds and planned resolutions.
* Define and drive system-level validation strategies for complex SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions, aligned with spec-driven and test-driven development (SDD/TDD), validating customer use cases, POCs, and end-to-end workflows across network infrastructure, fabric orchestration, servers, storage, and telemetry.
* Investigate complex customer-reported issues across SONiC software, networking protocols, platform components, and orchestration systems, including link-level errors and retransmit behavior, closing field escapes through triage, debugging, and closure.
* Provide technical leadership across customer engineering, system test, product management, and software development organizations.
* Drive architectural reviews, identify solution gaps, and influence product engineering roadmaps based on customer deployment requirements, translating customer feedback and field learnings into engineering improvements using Python, SpyTest automation, and AI agents that improve execution efficiency, impact, and value.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* Customer and solution experience: working with customers, solution architects, support, and engineering teams on POCs, deployments, and escalations, and system testing complex AI, data center, and enterprise networks, including scale-up, scale-across, scale-out, rack-scale, and fabric-scale environments.
* Networking technologies: VXLAN-EVPN, MLAG, EVPN-MH, ECMP, VRF, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, SRv6, BFD, Layer 2, multicast, RoCE, QoS, DCB (PFC/ECN), lossless Ethernet, link-level retransmission, and enterprise services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X).
* Integrated solutions: validation of networking, compute, storage, GPU cluster, and fabric orchestration solutions, including Ansible, Kubernetes integrations, and lifecycle workflows.
* Automation and telemetry: strong Python and test automation skills, with telemetry and northbound interfaces (CLI, REST, gNMI, NETCONF/YANG), traffic generator testing (for example IXIA), and packet analysis.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with SONiC and SpyTest, network test automation, deployment validation, and customer-focused solution demonstrations.
* Experience building or using AI agents and AI-assisted workflows (AI models and tools, for example Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot) for troubleshooting, solution analysis, automation, and customer issue investigation.

**Who we are**

title: Data Integration Developer (Informatica CDI)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive Data Integration Developer with practical, hands-on experience in

Informatica Cloud Data Integration (CDI). In this role, you will design, build, test, and maintain cloud-native data pipelines, ingesting and transforming data across diverse cloud and on-premise platforms to support our enterprise analytics and reporting ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

* Pipeline Development: Design, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines using Informatica CDI (mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and synchronization tasks).
* Source/Target Integration: Establish connections and ingest data from heterogeneous sources, including relational databases, cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Data Lake, GCP), APIs, and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Amazon Redshift).
* Data Transformation: Implement business logic using standard and advanced transformations (e.g., Expression, Router, Aggregator, Joiner, Lookup, Normalizer, and SQL ELT pushdown).
* Scheduling & Automation: Schedule and orchestrate workflows via CDI Taskflows and integrate with external job schedulers or CI/CD deployment pipelines where applicable.
* Testing & Debugging: Perform unit testing, resolve pipeline bottlenecks, and debug run-time errors or session logs.
* Maintenance & Monitoring: Monitor production execution runs, optimize execution runtimes, and assist in root-cause analysis for failed jobs.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Informatica Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience building, deploying, and troubleshooting mappings and taskflows in Informatica CDI (IDMC).
* SQL Proficiency: Strong practical knowledge of SQL (writing complex joins, aggregations, window functions, and query performance tuning).
* Data Warehousing Foundations: Solid understanding of dimensional modeling (Star and Snowflake schemas), slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), and incremental load strategies.
* Cloud & Platform Experience: Working familiarity with at least one major cloud data

warehouse (Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift) and cloud object stores (S3, ADLS).

* Problem Solving: Ability to read data mapping specifications, translate functional requirements into technical workflows, and debug mapping issues independently.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

* Hands-on experience with Informatica CAI (Cloud Application Integration) for API-led or real-time workflows.
* Familiarity with Unix/Linux shell scripting or basic Python for pre/post-processing tasks.
* Experience configuring Informatica Secure Agents on Linux/Windows environments.
* Official Informatica certification (e.g., Informatica IDMC Cloud Data Integration Specialist).

title: Senior Principal Architect - AI ML and Cloud Security - AI Architecture
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Domain focus: AI Architecture (agentic framework, LLM orchestration and RAG design) as a senior individual contributor at enterprise scale.**

**Job Purpose:**

Senior individual contributor designing the AI solution architectures that AI Engineering builds. You own LLM orchestration patterns, agent design, RAG and retrieval boundary patterns, embedding security and API security for AI services, and you validate the agentic framework design before it is handed to Engineering.

**About the team.**

  

AI ML and Cloud Security is the function through which GSK is transforming security itself. The team designs and builds the agentic framework, a multi-agent platform moving security services across the Chief Security Office from rule-based to AI-driven operation. It owns AI architecture and AI engineering end to end: the agent layer, LLM orchestration, the AI and ML platform, and the data fabric pipeline that Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs, builds and tests before a managed service vendor operates it. The team also governs AI tool security posture, advises on cloud security across the Azure and GCP estate, and is the front door between GSK's business units and R&D and the technical AI function. AI security standards set here are binding on every AI initiative in GSK. Seventeen roles across the UK, India and the US.

**What makes this role different.**

  

A pure architecture role with no line management and real design authority: your specifications are what Engineering builds from, and if they are ambiguous the build is wrong. You will be asked to whiteboard an agentic or RAG architecture you designed, including how you handled prompt injection and data classification across a retrieval boundary. Familiarity with reference architectures, without designs that were actually built and operated, will not get through that conversation.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

* Design AI solution architectures: LLM orchestration patterns, agent design, RAG and retrieval boundary patterns, embedding security, and API security for AI services.
* Validate the agentic framework design before handoff to Engineering and confirm it is buildable, testable and operable.
* Author the pattern library entries for LLM orchestration, retrieval boundaries and tool-calling scopes that engineering teams build from.
* Lead architecture reviews for new AI tool proposals and assess them against Cyber Architecture and Solutions standards.
* Contribute to the data fabric architecture and the controls applied at each classification boundary.
* Produce specifications detailed enough that Engineering builds without reinterpretation.
* Apply the binding AI security standards and threat models to every design, escalating where a design cannot meet them rather than diluting them.
* Support use-case feasibility assessment for business and R&D proposals.
* Sit in the agentic framework build stand-ups and answer design questions the same day, so the build never stalls on an absent architect.
* Review the agent and RAG designs produced by the other architects and sign them off or send them back; you are the technical second opinion in a team with no line management.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Own the AI architecture target state and the roadmap towards it for the domain, keeping it current as the agentic framework and the data fabric evolve.
* Apply GxP and data integrity requirements to AI designs, so validated systems and the evidence they depend on are not disturbed by an AI capability.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 15+ years in security or solution architecture with a recognised architecture certification8-12 years in security or solution architecture — domain focus: AI Architecture (agentic framework, LLM orchestration and RAG design) as a senior individual contributor at enterprise scale
* Agentic framework architecture — agent design patterns, LLM orchestration, RAG and retrieval boundaries, trust boundaries, tool-calling scopes and human-in-the-loop controls, validated as buildable, testable and operable before handoff
* AI threat modelling and secure AI data flow design — vector store access control, classification, and AI-specific threats (indirect prompt injection, training-data poisoning, model extraction, insecure output handling, excessive agency; OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS)
* Assessing new AI tool proposals from the business use-case pipeline against binding AI security standards — model provenance, data residency, classification and third-party risk
* Producing architecture specifications detailed enough that engineering builds without rework or reinterpretation — design authority only, with build and assurance owned elsewhere

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* AI architecture reference pattern library and architecture governance, with Engineering and the vendor building against it
* EU AI Act alignment and AI regulatory requirements in a regulated industry
* Azure OpenAI and Vertex AI private endpoint and customer-managed-key patterns, and the network designs that keep an inference call inside the EU.
* Experience of designs handed to a third party to operate
* Cloud AI services architecture — Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI and private model hosting patterns

* Recognised architecture certification such as SABSA or TOGAF
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: LLM orchestration patterns in LangChain, LangGraph and LlamaIndex, RAG and retrieval boundary design, embedding and vector store security across pgvector, Pinecone and Weaviate, API security for AI services, model gateways such as LiteLLM, prompt and context isolation patterns, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, architecture specification and pattern libraries.

**Skills**

AI Agent Security, AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Architecture Governance, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Cybersecurity, Data Security, Governance Framework, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Threat Modeling for AI Systems, Vulnerability Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Starburst**
-------------------

Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai.

#### **About the role**

As a Senior Systems Software Engineer on the Build & Delivery team, you'll own the systems that every team at Starburst ships through — the backend services and infrastructure of one trusted, self-service, increasingly autonomous delivery platform. You will help design and build the core delivery infrastructure, as well as build "the machine that builds the machine" that is used to ship across Starburst Enterprise, Galaxy, and customer-managed deployments at scale. Daily tasks will include developing backend services and infrastructure, building operational tooling, supporting our platform in production, and driving the reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency of how we deliver software.

The problems are concrete: keep the mainline green by construction, so a red build always means a real defect; provision production-like environments on demand instead of a shared staging bottleneck; deliver testing as a service across every repo; and treat AI as a first responder for test maintenance, failure triage, and remediation.

* Design and build the core services and infrastructure of the delivery platform, following the immutable cloud infrastructure paradigm, consistent across Starburst Enterprise, Galaxy, and customer-managed deployments

* Build the service that provisions production-like environments on demand, so every change is proven and dogfooded before customers see it
* Design the AI workflows in the delivery loop — test maintenance, failure triage, and remediation — validated before rollout
* Own the reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency of the platform in production
* Continuously improve our engineering processes, tests, and systems that allow us to scale the code base and productivity of the team

#### **Some of the things we look for:**

* Passion for software engineering, with an interest in build, delivery, and infrastructure engineering in particular
* Experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend systems in production
* Experience building for reliability, scalability, and efficiency at scale
* Experience developing software in Java and Typescript
* Cloud infrastructure architecture and orchestration experience

* Interest in applying AI and agentic workflows to engineering problems, with a validate-then-deploy discipline

The team designs and builds the agentic framework, a multi-agent platform moving security services across the Chief Security Office from rule-based to AI-driven operation. It owns AI architecture and AI engineering end to end: the agent layer, LLM orchestration, the AI and ML platform, and the data fabric pipeline that Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs, builds and tests before a managed service vendor operates it. The team also governs AI tool security posture, advises on cloud security across the Azure and GCP estate, and is the front door between GSK's business units and R&D and the technical AI function. AI security standards set here are binding on every AI initiative in GSK. Seventeen roles across the UK, India and the US.

**What makes this role different. Hands-on analytical work in a team that advises and flags but does not remediate — the Azure and GCP platform teams own every fix you identify, so your influence comes from the quality of the finding and your persistence in chasing it, not from authority. You will run CSPM analysis in Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind, maintain the shadow AI register, and apply agent risk-tiering to AI deployments that are moving faster than the governance around them. Comfort with being the person who raises the problem and cannot close it is essential.**

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Run CSPM analysis across Azure and GCP in Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind, and produce findings clear enough for a platform team to act on without a follow-up meeting.
* Maintain the shadow AI register and run the discovery scans that populate it, across sanctioned and unsanctioned AI tooling.
* Apply agent and model risk-tiering to AI deployments and track each assessment through to a governance decision.
* Support LLM and API exposure risk assessments with analysis and evidence, referencing MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Support cloud IAM and entitlement review packs, including CIEM analysis of over-permissioned identities, and track outcomes to closure.
* Track remediation owned by the Azure and GCP platform teams and business units, and escalate where it stalls — this team advises and flags, it does not remediate.
* Produce KPI data and build Power BI dashboards for cloud and AI security posture, including drift against configuration baselines.
* Improve the team's analysis and reporting through automation in Python rather than only running it.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Design and build the automation and tooling that produces the posture, shadow AI and agent risk picture, documenting the trade-offs made rather than only operating what others built.
* Mentor junior analysts and engineers on cloud and AI posture work, and review their output before it is relied on.
* Apply GxP and data integrity expectations to posture reporting that covers validated systems.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 10+ years in cloud or platform security in a regulated environment — domain focus: AI Platform & Cloud Security (CSPM, shadow AI and agent risk tiering across Azure and GCP)
* CSPM analysis across Azure and GCP using Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind — findings platform teams can act on, with remediation they own chased and escalated
* Maintaining the shadow AI register populated by discovery programmes — classifying AI tools, copilots and LLM APIs by data exposure and risk — and tracking agent risk-tiering to decision
* Analysing LLM and AI API exposure across Azure and GCP — Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, model endpoints, keys and network exposure — and supporting cloud IAM review packs
* Python, SQL or scripting for posture data, producing AI and cloud security KPIs and dashboards with audit-ready accuracy

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Cloud security certification such as CCSP, AZ-500 or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* AI security posture management (AI-SPM) tooling and LLM API risk assessment
* Power BI or equivalent dashboarding
* Cloud IAM and AI/LLM security awareness

* Clear written findings and stakeholder communication with platform engineering teams
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: CSPM platforms including Prisma Cloud, Wiz and Upwind, Azure and GCP native security services, cloud infrastructure entitlement management, container and Kubernetes security, shadow AI discovery tooling, model and agent risk tiering, LLM and API exposure assessment, Python for analysis and automation.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, AI Platforms, Application Security, Cloud Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, LLM Orchestration, Microsoft Azure, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Sonrai CSPM, Vulnerability Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

* Strong understanding of automated testing, observability, secure coding, and production support practices

  , Angular

title: Director, Data Systems Software Engineering
description:
DB Fleet Central is an OCI native cloud service for database fleet management and observability. It gives enterprise customers a way to monitor fleet health and availability, understand performance and capacity trends, manage databases, and investigate operational issues across cloud, hybrid, and multicloud environments. Its roadmap includes AI-assisted SQL and AWR insights, diagnostic assistance, fleet-wide anomaly and regression detection, and the AI Agent Observability platform.

As Director, you will set the engineering direction and lead the organization responsible for delivering these customer capabilities as reliable cloud services.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Systems Software Development**

**• Set engineering strategy for DB Fleet Central capabilities that help customers monitor fleet health and availability, understand performance and capacity, and manage database operations.**

**• Establish portfolio standards for data models, APIs, performance budgets, experimentation, and outcome measurement across service areas.**

**• Align multiple teams on roadmap priorities, dependencies, resourcing, quality standards, and customer outcomes.**

**• Lead and develop engineering managers and senior technical contributors; build the organization and technical leadership needed to deliver the service roadmap.**

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization**

**• Direct teams through the full lifecycle of cloud services and data systems: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, release, and production operation.**

**• Set expectations for design and code reviews, automated functional and non-functional testing, performance profiling, API lifecycle, logging, metrics, and observability.**

**• Use product, adoption, performance, and service-health measures to steer delivery and continuous optimization.**

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design**

**• Set the architecture and technical direction for secure, highly available, scalable services that meet enterprise fleet needs.**

**• Lead the strategy and phased delivery of the AI Agent Observability platform as a core DB Fleet Central capability.**

**• Sponsor AI-assisted database performance and capacity insights, SQL and AWR analysis, diagnostic assistance, fleet-wide anomaly and regression detection, and root-cause analysis as these roadmap capabilities mature.**

**• Establish responsible AI standards for data protection, evaluation, traceability, monitoring, and human review of recommendations or actions.**

**• Guide architecture reviews and technology research across connected service areas.**

**Issue and Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support**

**• Direct cross-team response to complex customer issues and service incidents; ensure timely communication, prioritization, and durable resolution.**

**• Use customer feedback and support trends to shape product improvements and issue-handling practices.**

**• Partner with customer-facing leaders to maintain trust and align short-term mitigation with long-term fixes.**

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance**

**• Set and enforce service-wide standards for secure development, tenant isolation, privacy, data governance, and AI use.**

**• Ensure teams follow architecture, API, testing, and operational quality standards.**

**Development Operations - System Maintenance**

**• Own operational plans and outcomes for an always-on cloud service, including availability, capacity, performance, reliability, and customer SLOs and SLAs.**

**• Establish a sustainable on-call and escalation model; ensure teams are prepared for production support and incident leadership.**

**• Direct improvements to automation, deployment safety, monitoring, runbooks, patching, and root-cause follow-through.**

**Core Responsibilities**

**Planning and Execution: Oversee cross-team roadmaps, dependencies, resources, and milestones; adjust plans to maintain strategic outcomes.**

title: Principal Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
description:
Overview:

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. Responsibilities:

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and hands-on contributor, designing and optimizing high-scale, distributed storage systems built on AWS storage technologies. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture, performance, and reliability of backend storage solutions that power critical applications at scale.

Your primary responsibilities will include designing, implementing, and optimizing backend storage services that support high throughput, low latency, and fault tolerance. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to drive scalability, availability, and efficiency improvements in large-scale storage solutions. You will also lead technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and root cause analyses to resolve complex production issues related to storage performance, consistency, and durability.

As a thought leader, you will drive best practices in distributed system design, security, and cloud cost optimization. You will also mentor senior engineers, contribute to technical roadmaps, and help shape the long-term storage strategy. Your expertise in storage consistency models, data partitioning, indexing, and caching strategies will be instrumental in improving system performance and reliability.

Additionally, you will collaborate with Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to implement observability, monitoring, and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring high availability and compliance with industry standards. You will advocate for automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and DevOps best practices, leveraging tools like Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes (EKS), and CI/CD pipelines to enable scalable deployments and operational excellence.

Qualifications:

**Basic Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of experience in backend software development, focusing on distributed systems and storage solutions.
* 5+ years of experience working with AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier).
* Strong expertise in system design, architecture, and scalability for large-scale storage solutions.
* Proficiency in at least one major backend programming language (Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python).
* Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant, and cost-efficient storage architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, replication strategies, sharding, and caching.
* Knowledge of data security, encryption best practices, and compliance requirements (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Experience leading engineering teams, mentoring senior engineers, and driving technical roadmaps.
* Proficiency with observability tools, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting at scale.

**Core Requirements**

**Expertise in Large-Scale Storage Systems**

* Deep knowledge of AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier) and their performance characteristics.
* Experience designing and optimizing object storage, block storage, and file storage solutions at scale.
* Strong understanding of storage durability, consistency models, replication, and erasure coding for fault tolerance.
* Experience implementing tiered storage solutions and cost-optimized data retention strategies.

**Distributed Systems & Scalability**

* Deep understanding of distributed storage architectures, CAP theorem, and consistency models.
* Expertise in partitioning, sharding, and replication strategies for low-latency, high-throughput storage.
* Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems using consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos, Gossip Protocol).
* Hands-on experience with high-performance NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Cassandra, RocksDB).

**High-Performance Backend Engineering**

* Strong programming skills in Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python for backend storage development.
* Experience building event-driven, microservices-based architectures using gRPC, REST, or WebSockets.
* Expertise in data serialization formats (Parquet, Avro, ORC) for optimized storage access.
* Experience implementing data compression, deduplication, and indexing strategies to improve storage efficiency.

**Cloud-Native & Infrastructure Automation**

* Strong hands-on experience with AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud storage best practices.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
* Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), serverless architectures (Lambda, Fargate), and containerized storage workloads.
* Expertise in CI/CD automation for storage services, leveraging GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.

**Performance Optimization & Observability**

* Experience with benchmarking, profiling, and optimizing storage workloads.
* Proficiency in performance monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana) for storage systems.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for latency bottlenecks, memory leaks, and concurrency issues.
* Experience designing observability strategies (tracing, metrics, structured logging) for large-scale storage systems.

**Security, Compliance, and Data Protection**

* Deep knowledge of data security, encryption at rest/in transit, and IAM policies in AWS.
* Experience implementing fine-grained access controls (IAM, KMS, STS, VPC Security Groups) for multi-tenant storage solutions.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP) and best practices for secure data storage.
* Expertise in disaster recovery, backup strategies, and multi-region failover solutions.

**Leadership & Architectural Strategy**

* Proven ability to design, document, and drive large-scale storage architectures from concept to production.
* Experience leading technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices.
* Strong ability to mentor senior and mid-level engineers, fostering growth in distributed storage expertise.
* Ability to influence technical roadmaps, long-term vision, and cost optimization strategies for backend storage.

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------

As a Senior Application Developer, you will build, maintain, integrate and implement software applications supporting the Supply Chain Planning functional domain within the organization. In this role, you will be a senior member of a product team and will discover and deliver solutions for problems to enable the company’s digital future. You will apply knowledge of software configuration and integrations to ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, and robust. You will also contribute knowledge and hands-on experience with modern practices and technologies to the Digital Technology & Data (DT&D) community.

This role is expected to perform with minimal supervision and involve complex software application testing, quality assurance, configuration, installation and support to ensure smooth, stable and timely implementation of new of new requirements and enhancements. This role will be focused primarily on the SAP IBP solution and will be part of a supply chain planning product team dedicated to this overall solution across Cargill’s enterprises.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* APPLICATION CONFIGURATION MANAGEMENT: Builds complex SAP IBP application configurations and integration configurations to meet user and business requirements while identifying improvements to complex application support processes and procedures.
* APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT: Performs advanced design, analysis, configuration, testing and deployment of new configurations, enhancements, integrations and at times fixes for the SAP IBP application as required.
* USER COMMUNICATION & SUPPORT: Plays a key role and keeps an open channel of communication with users to respond to complex application support requests and needs.
* APPLICATION SUPPORT: Conducts complex technical application support activities to deliver business outcomes, in conjunction with support team members.

* APPLICATION DOCUMENTATION: Ensures configuration and business processes, settings, rules, filters, etc. are documented and continually updated.
* KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT: Maintains and shares relevant functional and technical approaches and modern skills with SAP IBP and its modeling options and evolving capabilities.
* PROBLEM SOLVING: Independently solve complex issues with minimal supervision and serve as a lead or key resource in large initiatives.
* RELEASE MANAGEMENT: Leads prioritization of incoming user requests and offers solution options, approaches, and estimation efforts as required.
* VENDOR MANAGEMENT: Handles positive relationships with software vendors, collaborating as required on new capabilities, beta-testing, and problem solving.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
* Confirmed experience working with SAP IBP, knowledge of architecture, data model, and integration technologies.
* Proven track record of successfully implementing, enhancing, and supporting SAP IBP integrations in complex business environments. This includes multiple full life-cycle deployment experiences across multiple companies, businesses, or multi-wave deployment engagements.
* Expertise with multiple SAP IBP modules (e.g., Demand, Response & Supply, Inventory, Sales & Operations Planning) is desirable.
* Minimum of eight years of related work experience.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent documentation skills.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
### **About Omnidian**

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience.

We are a certified B Corp that formed in the US in 2016 and have been growing globally since then. We expanded to Australia in 2022, acquired Solar Service Guys in Australia in 2025, and have opened up a new talent hub in India in 2026. Be part of the "First Wave" experience! You would be a founding member of our India team, helping us build a brand-new hub from the ground up.

### **The Job**

As a Staff Software Engineer on Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM), you will build the systems that define the data models and life cycle of every solar and battery asset under Omnidian's purview. The ALM team is at the center of managing the core data object our systems monitor, defining what an asset is, onboarding and offboarding of assets, hardware definitions, and validation checks. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager ofALM and work alongside a product manager, operations teams, client integration partners and peer engineering teams. You'll help design and ship our client-facing onboarding API and our configurable onboarding check engine, which clients use to onboard thousands of assets at a time, while leveraging AI for coding and testing.

Our stack: Kotlin and Spring Boot services on AWS (EKS), MySQL, SQS, React and TypeScript for internal tools, Databricks for analytics, and Grafana and Sentry for observability.

### **What You'll Do**

At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of some of the things you'll be doing:

**Onboarding and Asset Management Platform Design and Delivery (45%)**

* Design and ship Kotlin and Spring Boot services behind our client-facing onboarding  
  API
* Evolve the onboarding check engine so all assets are verified against external data  
  sources
* Build React and TypeScript front ends for onboarding and asset management  
  workflows
* Turn requirements into clear technical specs, APIs and success criteria
* Drive testing for your areas, using Claude for unit, integration and end-to-end tests

**Asset Data Integrity (25%)**

* Keep downstream data sources such as Resolv (our Operations platform), Salesforce and our data platform in sync through standardized mechanisms and practices
* Build and review safe bulk corrections, migrations and backfills

**Operate What You Build (15%)**

* Take part in the team's support rotation for operational support
* Participate in monitoring, alerting and on-call readiness forALM services
* Diagnose onboarding failures with clients' integration engineers

**Collaboration and Mentorship (15%)**

* Lead technical design discussions and give thoughtful code reviews
* Mentor engineers and share effective Claude usage patterns
* Partner with product, operations and other engineering teams on shared work

### **Who You Are**

* You are a seasoned full stack engineer who resolves ambiguity instead of escalating it
* You care about data correctness, because a wrong asset record costs clients money
* You see Claude as an essential accelerator for both velocity and quality
* You balance shipping fast with keeping systems maintainable and well-tested
* You explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers, operators and clients alike
* You coach others and treat colleagues with empathy and respect
* You deliver consistently and are an expert at using AI harnesses to code, verify and  
  review your work

### **Experience You'll Need**

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong Kotlin or Java with Spring Boot, building production services and APIs
* Experience designing external or partner-facing APIs, including versioning and validation
* Solid SQL and relational database design (MySQL or similar), including safe data migrations
* Experience with AWS, Kubernetes and CI/CD, and with observability tools such as Grafana or Sentry
* Proven ability to ship complex features with high-quality automated tests
* Hands-on use of Claude or similarAI tools for coding and testing, and helping others adopt them
* Experience leading technical design discussions and mentoring engineers

### **Experience That's a Plus**

* Rules engines, validation pipelines or workflow systems where behavior is driven by configuration
* Event-driven or asynchronous architectures (SQS or similar)
* React and TypeScript for internal operations tools
* Databricks, Python or other data-platform work
* Integrating with Salesforce or other CRM systems
* Solar, battery storage, IoT device or energy asset data
* Familiarity with SOC 2 requirements and security-minded engineering practices

### **Culture & Benefits**

* We offer a competitive total compensation package bonuses and long-term stock options so you can share in the long-term value you help create as we shape the future together..
* We offer a competitive benefits program for our employees and their dependents, including medical, dental, vision
* We are a passionate, mission driven team that believes in collaboration, mutual respect and trust. For examples, come Discover our Story!

$48,000 - $81,000 a year

**Our Philosophy on Pay:** The range listed above reflects the starting base salary for most new hires in this role. However, your financial growth doesn't stop at the offer letter. We invest deeply in our people and reward results; annual merit increases can bring your total compensation above this initial range. Our goal is for you to continue growing within the pay band as you sharpen your skills and drive meaningful outcomes.

* **Committed to Parity:** We eliminate the "negotiation tax" by placing candidates within the band based on verified professional experience and skill set, not bartering ability, and by giving our best offer up front. This is a core part of our mission to ensure gender pay equity and fairness across the board.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** Your well-being is our priority. We cover 100% of health insurance monthly premiums for employees and 50% for your dependents.
* **Performance Bonus:** Exceptional work deserves exceptional rewards. You’ll be eligible for bonuses that reflect your contributions to our collective success.
* **Equity Stake:** We offer stock options so you can share in the long-term value you help create as we shape the future together.
* **Continuous Growth:** We are a learning organization. To support your evolution, we provide up to $500 in annual learning reimbursement for courses, certifications, or conferences.

**Diversity and Inclusion**

*We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our customers. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value diversity and inclusion and are committed to ensuring our hiring and retention practices, as well as our office culture, reflects this value.*

* Solid grasp of SOLID principles, design patterns, and microservices architecture

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
#JLLTechAmbitions
  
JLL, an international real estate management company, is building AI into the way its teams work with enterprise data. As an AI Engineer you will turn proofs of concept into reliable, governed, production services: agents that can call tools, remember context, respect user permissions, and be traced, evaluated, and costed.
  
You will work across both technology tracks as project priorities shift: agent engineering on AWS (Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore) and data and AI engineering on Oracle (AI Data Platform and AI Database). The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder with a “Get it done” attitude, strong engineering discipline, and a habit of asking the right questions before building.
  
**ResponsibilitiesBuild agents on AWS:** design, deploy, and operate AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using AgentCore Runtime for hosting, Gateway to expose APIs and Lambda functions as tools (including MCP), Memory for short- and long-term context, Identity for secure agent access, and Observability for tracing and debugging.
  
**Build RAG and agent solutions with Amazon Bedrock:** implement foundation-model integrations, Knowledge Bases, Agents, and Guardrails, and manage prompts and model selection for cost, latency, and quality.
  
**Build on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP):** develop in the AIDP Workbench using Master Catalog assets, Spark notebooks, and workflows; apply medallion (bronze, silver, gold) data patterns; and build knowledge bases and agent flows on governed enterprise data.
  
**Build on Oracle AI Database:** implement AI Vector Search, hybrid (vector + relational) retrieval, Select AI natural-language-to-SQL interfaces, and in-database ML, with embedding pipelines and PL/SQL where needed.
  
**Integrate across platforms:** connect Oracle data services with AWS-hosted AI applications through secure, well-defined APIs and swappable service interfaces.
  
**Engineer retrieval quality:** own chunking and embedding strategy, metadata filtering, reranking, and retrieval tuning, and measure results with repeatable evaluations.
  
**Secure and govern AI:** apply IAM least privilege, database-enforced access control (such as role-based access and data redaction), PII handling, and guardrails that screen for prompt injection and unsafe output. Keep audit trails of agent actions and outcomes.
  
**Test and evaluate:** build evaluation and regression suites for LLM output, track hallucination and accuracy, and verify behavior end to end against real services, not only with unit tests.
  
**Deploy and operate:** ship Python services (for example FastAPI) to production on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, and Secrets Manager. Monitor latency, quality, and cost with CloudWatch and AgentCore Observability.
  
**Collaborate and document:** take part in sprint ceremonies and code and design reviews, and maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer material.
  
Experience & Education4-8 years of software, data, or AI/ML engineering experience, with hands-on delivery of generative AI or LLM-based applications in production or near-production.
  
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is preferred.
  
Proven experience building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows, including tool calling and multi-step orchestration.
  
Experience with Amazon Bedrock and AWS-native deployment. Hands-on AgentCore experience is strongly preferred.
  
Experience with Oracle Database or Oracle AI Database. Experience with the Oracle AI Data Platform is strongly preferred.
  
Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, including tracing non-deterministic model behavior.
  
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently in a distributed team.
  
**Technical Skills & CompetenciesGenerative AI on AWS:** Amazon Bedrock foundation models, Knowledge Bases, Agents, Guardrails, prompt engineering, and model evaluation; Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Observability, and built-in tools such as Code Interpreter).
  
**Oracle data and AI:** Oracle AI Database (AI Vector Search, Select AI, in-database ML, PL/SQL) and Oracle AI Data Platform (Master Catalog, notebooks, workflows, knowledge bases, agent flows, OCI Generative AI integration).
  
**AI application engineering:** RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), embedding strategy, chunking, reranking, and structured LLM output.
  
**AWS cloud:** Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager.
  
**Programming:** Python (primary), REST APIs, and SQL; FastAPI or similar async frameworks.
  
**Security and governance:** IAM least privilege, data privacy controls, PII handling, and responsible-AI guardrails.
  
**Delivery:** Agile/Scrum, Git and CI/CD, Docker, Jira and Confluence, and clear documentation.
  
Preferred (Nice to Have)Experience with AgentCore Identity and Gateway for secure, tool-enabled agents.
  
Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Apache Spark, or medallion-architecture data pipelines.
  
Infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) and Kubernetes experience.
  
Experience with agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, or with migrating Bedrock Agents to a code-first framework.
  
Experience with LLM gateways, token and cost tracking, and usage analytics.
  
Relevant certifications, such as AWS or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI certifications.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:
#### **About us**

At Person Centred Software (PCS), our mission is simple: to help care providers deliver outstanding care through technology.  
  
Our platforms are used by thousands of care professionals every day, supporting better outcomes for residents, improving compliance, and helping teams focus on what matters most people.

#### **The Opportunity**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build and maintain high-quality software for our mCare products. You will own features and technical improvements from design through to production, contribute to system design, and help ensure our solutions are scalable, maintainable and secure.

You will work with a high degree of autonomy as part of a cross-functional squad, partnering with Product, QA and engineering colleagues to deliver outcomes. We use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate delivery; sound engineering judgement, quality and compliance remain essential.

* Write and maintain automated tests for new and changed code, including unit, integration and end-to-end coverage where appropriate

* Collaborate across teams, articulate technical decisions, document relevant context and share learnings from delivery and retrospectives
* Mentor and support less-experienced engineers, encourage collaborative problem-solving and contribute to an inclusive, positive team culture
* Use AI-assisted tools to support analysis and development, validate their outputs, and share useful practices while safeguarding quality, security and compliance
* Propose practical improvements to code, tools and team workflows, and help evaluate their impact

#### **What we're looking for**

* Strong commercial experience developing software using C# and .NET Framework and/or modern .NET (including .NET 8+)
* Experience building and maintaining web-based applications across backend and frontend layer
* Experience designing and delivering features or systems, with an understanding of scalability, performance and maintainability trade-offs
* Strong understanding of software quality, including clean code, testability, maintainability and secure design
* Experience writing automated tests as a standard part of development and contributing to code reviews
* Experience working in an Agile product development environment and using source control, CI/CD pipelines and work-tracking tools
* Confidence using AI-assisted developer tools in day-to-day work and applying judgement to verify outputs for correctness, quality, security and compliance.

#### **Bonus points**

* Experience with Blazor or another modern UI framework
* Experience with SQL databases, including schema design and optimisation
* Experience building or supporting SaaS or multi-tenant systems
* Familiarity with Azure or other cloud platforms, including containerised workloads such as Kubernetes
* Experience designing and consuming APIs
* Understanding of authentication and authorisation concepts such as OAuth2 and OIDC
* Experience in healthcare, care management, pharmacy technology or another compliance-driven domain
* Experience with high-availability or business-critical systems.

title: ServiceNow Software Engineer Manager
description:
Software Engineering Manager, Associate Portal

Information Technology

As the Software Engineering Manager for our Associate Portal, you will lead the engineering team responsible for building and operating Ecolab's enterprise digital front door on ServiceNow Employee Center Pro within HR Service Delivery. You will own the quality, reliability, and technical delivery of an experience that helps associates find information, access services, complete tasks, and connect to enterprise workflows from one place.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will lead the team and stay close to the work: shaping solutions, reviewing designs and code, removing delivery barriers, and ensuring what reaches production is secure, scalable, accessible, and supportable. You will establish the engineering practices that make quality repeatable rather than dependent on individual projects or implementation partners.

You will partner closely with product, UX, architecture, Enterprise AI, HR, Communications, and business teams. You will translate the Associate Portal vision into an executable engineering roadmap and build the internal capability needed to operate and continuously improve the product after implementation.

**What you will do**
====================

**Engineering Leadership and Team Development**
-----------------------------------------------

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of ServiceNow engineers and technical leads responsible for the Associate Portal and related employee experience capabilities.
* Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, development plans, and engineering objectives for the team.
* Build a culture of accountability, technical excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, and strong customer focus.
* Manage work across employees, contingent resources, and implementation partners while retaining clear internal accountability for engineering outcomes.
* Develop the internal knowledge and capability required to own, operate, and enhance the portal following implementation and knowledge transfer.

**Associate Portal Engineering**
--------------------------------

* Own engineering delivery for the Associate Portal built on ServiceNow Employee Center Pro and HR Service Delivery.
* Lead the configuration, development, testing, deployment, and enhancement of portal pages, widgets, microsites, application launchers, navigation, taxonomy, and responsive experiences.
* Ensure a consistent, intuitive, and consumer-grade experience across desktop, mobile, manufacturing, field, and corporate environments.
* Guide the use of audience groups, user criteria, HR criteria, personas, roles, regions, and language preferences to deliver relevant and personalized experiences.
* Oversee capabilities including enterprise search, knowledge, content, services, requests, approvals, tasks, communications, and conversational assistance.
* Partner with UX leaders to ensure implemented experiences match approved designs and meet accessibility, usability, and performance expectations.

**Architecture and Technical Governance**
-----------------------------------------

* Partner with ServiceNow platform architecture and enterprise architecture to define and enforce technical standards for the Associate Portal.
* Translate complex business and experience requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly ServiceNow solutions.
* Apply a configuration-first approach and ensure custom development is used only where it creates clear business or experience value.
