title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

**About Us**

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.  
  
Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

  

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer for our data pipeline service to build and work on data pipelines that moves data from various sources to data warehouses. The work is very diverse — all the way from patching software to building warehouse data writers, to optimizing the behavior of sync services operating on our global Kubernetes compute cluster.

You will be responsible for ensuring the technical excellence for your team and owned services, by contributing to the code, reviewing code, designing features and mentoring our junior colleagues.

You will understand the key values that make our product great, and implement those values in the many small decisions you make every day as a product designer.

**Technologies You'll Use**

* Java, PostgreSQL, Cloud Data Warehouses, AWS, GCP, Azure, Temporal, Grafana, Kubernetes, Docker

**What You'll Do**

* Work on core features of the product, systematic enhancements, and bug fixes
* Write new or optimize the existing data writer platform to load data to warehouses
* You'll be working with Cloud APIs, Datawriters, SQL DBs, SQL Warehouses, etc
* You'll be working on the core data pipeline that moves terabytes of data from all our customer sources to data warehouses by processing data, splitting it into files formats like CSV/AVRO/Parquet, merging and loading to warehouses.
* As a senior engineer in the team, you will own and drive features within the technology team, pitch design ideas, work closely with leads in the team to perform design reviews, and contribute directly to code.

**Skills We're Looking For**

* Strong technical and problem-solving skills with 5+ years of professional experience writing Java code in the distributed production environment
* Experience in reliable data intensive distributed systems, with an emphasis on high-volume data management platforms that operate under strict SLAs
* Understanding complex SQL merge queries, plans, and their best practices
* Robust and reliable system design skills to satisfy project feature requirements and optimise the existing systems
* Strong troubleshooting skill to debug problems with in existing code, connect the dots, come up with detailed RCA
* Understand how to use AI code assist and coding agents to automatically generate code for features, bugs, testing, and investigation
* Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals

**Bonus Skills**

* Experience with Data Warehouses like BigQuery, Databricks, SQL Like with exposure to their internals
* Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT)
* Experienced working in a cloud environment utilizing AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, BuildKite, or similar technologies.

title: Senior AI/ML Software Engineer
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Senior AI/ML Software Engineer**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is looking for a skilled and motivated software engineer to join the Machine Learning and Frameworks Org. As part of this team, you’ll build and maintain tools and infrastructure that automate functional and performance validation of deep learning libraries & models across ROCm and GPU platforms. Your contributions will directly impact developer confidence, model portability, and transparent benchmarking for internal teams and the open-source community. You will be a member of a core team of incredibly talented industry specialists and will work with the very latest hardware and software technology

**THE PERSON:**

We are seeking a software developer with strong technical expertise in Python and Linux-based systems, who is passionate about quality assurance, benchmarking, and automation in the AI/ML space. The ideal candidate thrives in both collaborative and independent environments, demonstrates excellent problem-solving skills, and takes ownership in defining goals and delivering impactful solutions. Experience working with machine learning frameworks, performance dashboards, or automation platforms is a strong plus.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Software Engineering Excellence:** Proficiency in Python with experience in performance tuning, debugging, and robust test design, ensuring reliable, maintainable, high-performance codebases.
* **CI/CD Pipeline Development:** Design, implement, and manage efficient continuous integration and delivery pipelines using GitHub Actions and Buildkite to enable rapid and reliable software deployment.
* **Quality Assurance Enablement:** Integrate automated testing frameworks into CI pipelines to ensure code quality, stability, and performance across development cycles.
* **Model Testing & Validation:** Automate functional and performance testing of AI libraries & models across ROCm-supported hardware (AMD and NVIDIA) using scalable tools and pipelines.
* **Benchmarking Infrastructure:** Develop tools for continuous benchmarking and regression tracking across hardware generations and ROCm releases.
* **Dashboard & Metrics Development:** Build and maintain real-time dashboards that report relevant performance, accuracy, and reliability metrics for both internal and public users.
* **Ecosystem Integration:** Collaborate with teams like DeepLearningModels (DLM) and MADengine to support a wide range of models, including public and private/NDA workloads.
* **Client Enablement:** Ensure out-of-box confidence for ROCm clients by validating model performance and functionality in standardized and reproducible environments.
* **Scalable Tooling:** Contribute to the design of portable, easy-to-use Python interfaces that support multi-node profiling, distributed workloads, and containerized deployments.
* **Open-Source Contributions:** Support public-facing AMD GitHub repositories and Docker releases, enabling the community to run and validate models on ROCm.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* **Programming & Tooling:** Strong Python development skills, with experience in test automation, CI/CD, and Linux scripting.
* **Machine Learning Workflow Understanding:** Familiarity with AI frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow), model benchmarking, and ML model lifecycles.
* **DevOps:** Familiarity with clusters and orchestration software (SLURM, K8s). Experience with GitHub, Jenkins or similar and development workflows

* **Software Engineering Practices**: Proficiency with version control (GitHub), testing strategies, code reviews, and collaborative software development.
* **Performance Analysis:** Strong experience with profiling tools, system monitoring, or regression tracking systems for deep learning models.
* **Communication & Ownership:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proactive approach to defining and driving development efforts.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* Master’s or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field

When you work for John Crane, you join a community driven by pioneering spirit and a legacy of innovation. Our engineered solutions drive reliability, uptime and energy efficiency, empowering the world’s largest energy service providers to achieve sustainability goals that shape the future of our world. If you’re ready to accelerate the new energy transition through technology leadership, innovative solutions and service excellence, you'll fit right in.

 **Job Description**

**Key Activities:**

* **Programming & Data Management -** Interpret engineering data and import solid models from Teamcenter for CNC programming. Develop CNC programs using Edgecam, applying standardised manufacturing strategies and templates. Maintain a centralised CNC Program Register with final, proved-out programs and revision control. Prepare stage drawings and setup sheets for all programmed operations.
* **Tooling & Postprocessing -** Select tools and holders from approved global libraries; apply standard feeds and speeds. Use correct post-processors for machine controllers.
* **Simulation & Prove-Out -** Perform offline simulation and collision checks before posting NC code. Capture edits and update CAM templates.
* **Production Support -** Prepare CNC programs according to production schedules on a shift-support basis. Provide troubleshooting and optimisation support to shop-floor teams.
* **Continuous Improvement -** Standardise programming strategies globally and update templates based on lessons learned.
* Monitor KPIs such as programming lead time, first-pass yield, and cycle time improvements.
* **Compliance & Safety -** Adhere to ISO standards for CNC programming and quality requirements. Follow safety protocols during prove-out and machine setup.
* **Collaboration & Training -** Work closely with manufacturing engineers, machinists, and quality teams to resolve issues.

  
**Qualifications**

**Skills & Experience:**

* BE/ DME with 6 -12 years overall related experience and min 02-03 years in Edgecam programming for turning and milling.
* Proven experience in CNC programming for milling, turning, and multi-axis machines.
* Proficiency in Edgecam CAM software and knowledge of ISO G-code standards.
* Familiarity with PLM systems (Teamcenter preferred) and CAM–machine integration.
* Strong understanding of tooling, feeds/speeds, and machining strategies.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills; ability to work across global teams.

  
**Additional Information**

title: Software Engineer, Low-Level Driver Development
description:
**Description**

  
**Invent the future with us.**  
  
  
  
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.  
  
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.  
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!

**About the role:**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Software Engineer, CAN Firmware and Low-Level Driver Development** to lead the architecture, development, integration, and validation of production-grade CAN/CAN FD software for Arm-based SoCs.

This role requires strong hands-on experience in embedded C, low-level driver development, Arm processor architecture, communication protocols, real-time software, and hardware/software integration. The successful candidate will be a technical leader who can independently drive complex CAN controller bring-up and driver development, resolve difficult silicon/firmware issues, influence hardware and software architecture, and mentor engineers across the firmware organization.

This is a **hands-on technical role**, where the candidate is expected to review specifications, write and review code, debug on target hardware, analyse protocol traces, define software architecture, establish validation strategy, and guide engineers working on CAN firmware and associated software components.

**What you’ll achieve:**

**CAN and CAN FD Driver**

* Define the firmware architecture and technical roadmap for low-level **CAN and CAN FD controller drivers** on Arm-based SoCs.
* Develop scalable driver designs for Classical CAN and CAN FD; bit-rate switching (BRS); dedicated TX buffers, TX FIFOs, TX queues, mailboxes, and RX FIFOs; hardware acceptance filters; interrupt-driven and polling operation; timestamping where supported; error handling, diagnostics, and recovery.
* Define robust software state machines for controller initialization, start/stop, sleep/wakeup, error-active, error-passive, bus-off, recovery, reset, and degraded operation.
* Develop and maintain production-quality embedded C code for CAN controller initialization, transmit, receive, interrupt handling, error handling, and recovery.
* Design for multi-core, ISR/task, and concurrent access scenarios where applicable.

**Arm SoC and Hardware/Software Integration**

* Drive CAN controller bring-up on Arm-based SoCs and evaluate hardware behavior against specifications and expected protocol behavior.
* Analyze hardware/software interface specifications and identify ambiguous, incomplete, unsafe, or untestable requirements.
* Influence early SoC and IP architecture decisions related to CAN controller capabilities, memory sizing, interrupt architecture, diagnostics, and performance.
* Partner with post-silicon validation teams to develop bring-up plans, debug methodologies, register tests, stress tests, and protocol conformance tests.

**Integration**

* Define and support CAN driver integration within a Platform stack, including CanDrv; CanIf; PduR; COM; CanSM; CanTrcv; Dem; E2E; BswM, EcuM, and WdgM, as applicable.
* Ensure clear separation of responsibilities between low-level driver, CAN interface layer, communication stack, diagnostics, and application software.
* Contribute to customer-facing integration guides, application notes, reference drivers, and debug documentation.

**Reliability, and Diagnostics**

* Design CAN firmware behavior aligned with industry standard development practices.
* Define software mechanisms to detect and report bus-off; error passive and error warning conditions; protocol errors; ACK errors; RX FIFO overflow; RX buffer/message loss; TX timeout; message RAM ECC/parity errors; controller clock/reset faults; transceiver fault/status conditions; configuration corruption; interrupt failures or abnormal interrupt load.
* Develop diagnostic strategies, persistent error capture, health monitoring, and recovery policies suitable for production environment.

* Establish high standards for embedded software quality, maintainability, robustness, and testability.
* Drive adoption of secure coding practices, including MISRA C, CERT C, static analysis, defensive programming, and code review discipline.
* Define unit, integration, system, and hardware-in-the-loop validation strategies for CAN drivers.
* Analyze field, customer, and lab failures; develop reproducible test cases and permanent corrective actions.

**Technical Leadership and Mentoring**

* Serve as the technical authority for CAN firmware and low-level CAN driver architecture.
* Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and technical debugging sessions.
* Mentor firmware engineers in embedded C, CAN/CAN FD protocol behavior, Arm architecture, driver design, debugging, and quality practices.
* Create reusable design patterns, driver templates, checklists, debug guides, and validation frameworks.
* Lead technical discussions with hardware design, verification, validation, systems, cybersecurity, product, field applications, and customer teams.
* Drive technical risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalation for critical CAN firmware deliverables.

**About you:**

* Bachelor's degree with 5 years or Master’s degree with 3 years of experience in embedded firmware or low-level driver development experience, with significant experience in real-time embedded systems
* Demonstrated experience owning complex firmware subsystems from architecture through bring-up, validation, customer integration, and maintenance.
* Experience working in a semiconductor company or embedded platform in a product environment is strongly preferred.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Classical CAN; CAN FD; bit-rate switching; arbitration; error frames and error counters; error-active, error-passive, and bus-off states; acceptance filtering; RX FIFO and TX mailbox/FIFO/queue management; controller/transceiver interaction; nominal and data-phase bit timing.
* Expert-level embedded C programming skills with Arm Cortex-M, Cortex-R, Cortex-A, or equivalent embedded processor architectures.
* Strong understanding of register programming; interrupt handling; interrupt latency and priority; ISR/task concurrency; synchronization, atomics, critical sections, and race conditions; boot and initialization ordering; linker sections, alignment, and memory layout.
* Ability to debug issues using JTAG/SWD, GDB, vendor debuggers, trace tools, register viewers, crash dumps, and low-level instrumentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cybersecurity, including secure diagnostics, secure boot, HSM integration, secure communication, or ISO/SAE 21434 concepts.
* Experience with Ethernet, TSN, PTP, MACsec, or gateway communication architectures.
* Experience with RTOS environments such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, SafeRTOS, Integrity, QNX, or embedded Linux.

 **What we’ll offer:**  
  
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.  
  
Benefits highlights include:

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Principal Engineer – AI Security Developer
description:
Overview:

**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  
  
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Business Segment Overview**

**Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

**Position Purpose:** At StoneX, defending a global financial services organization increasingly means building capabilities ourselves rather than waiting for the market to provide them. As a **Principal Engineer – AI Security Developer**, you’ll serve as the senior technical authority for how StoneX applies AI to cybersecurity, setting the technical vision, architecture, and engineering standards for our AI security platform while personally building the hardest and highest-leverage parts of it.

Your mission is to define how AI becomes a secure, scalable, and trusted capability across the security organization. You’ll establish the reference architecture for GenAI applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platforms, advanced analytics, shared services, and the guardrails and engineering patterns that allow multiple teams to build consistently and safely.

**This is a senior individual contributor role with enterprise-wide influence, not a role removed from the technology.** You’ll remain a hands-on engineer while shaping technical direction across multiple security and engineering teams. You’ll make the difficult architectural decisions, build shared platform capabilities, prototype new approaches, solve the hardest technical problems, and raise the engineering bar for how AI capabilities are designed and delivered across StoneX.

From **Day 1**, you’ll begin shaping the technical direction of StoneX’s AI security capabilities while getting hands-on with the platform and the problems our teams are trying to solve. You’ll work across security, engineering, infrastructure, data, risk, and other partners to identify where AI creates meaningful value, establish the architecture and standards teams can build upon, and help turn that direction into trusted production capabilities at scale.

Responsibilities:

**Primary duties will include:**

* **AI Security Strategy:** Define and own the multi-year technical strategy and roadmap for AI-powered security capabilities, translating business and risk priorities into a sequenced engineering direction.
* **Reference Architecture:** Design and govern the target architecture for StoneX’s AI security platform, including LLM services and orchestration, agent frameworks, RAG and knowledge pipelines, evaluation infrastructure, data access patterns, and integrations across the security environment.
* **Platform Engineering:** Architect and build shared platform capabilities including secure LLM services, agent runtimes, tool and connector frameworks, retrieval services, prompt and model management, and observability that allow teams to deliver AI solutions quickly, consistently, and securely.
* **Hands-On Engineering:** Remain deeply technical by personally designing and building complex and critical components, prototyping new approaches, and helping teams solve difficult engineering problems across the full stack.
* **Technical Decision-Making:** Lead evaluation of models, frameworks, vendors, and open-source technologies and make recommendations based on security, performance, cost, maintainability, and long-term strategic value.
* **Portfolio Prioritization:** Partner with security leadership to identify, size, and prioritize high-impact AI opportunities across detection, response, vulnerability management, identity, cloud, application security, and other security domains while challenging work that does not demonstrate meaningful value.
* **Secure Integration:** Establish patterns for integrating AI services and agentic workflows with security technologies including source-code repositories, threat models, cloud platforms, SIEM, SOAR, IAM, CMDB, and vulnerability management systems while enforcing appropriate least privilege, auditability, and human oversight.
* **Production Excellence:** Establish expectations for reliability, scalability, latency, monitoring, operational readiness, and cost management across production AI workloads.
* **AI Security & Assurance:** Serve as a technical authority on securing AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, model and supply-chain risk, agent tool misuse, adversarial manipulation, and other emerging threats.
* **Evaluation & Quality:** Establish how StoneX evaluates LLM and agent performance through benchmark datasets, automated evaluation pipelines, red teaming, regression testing, and measures of accuracy, hallucination, reliability, and analyst trust.
* **Responsible AI:** Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data Governance, and Architecture to ensure AI capabilities meet regulatory, model risk management, privacy, and data residency expectations.
* **Engineering Standards:** Set and champion standards for AI engineering, including architecture, code quality, design review, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production readiness.
* **Technical Leadership:** Influence technical direction across security, infrastructure, data, and application engineering teams, building consensus and resolving complex cross-team technical challenges without relying on direct authority.
* **Developing Engineers:** Mentor senior and staff-level engineers, strengthen AI engineering capability across the security organization, and help shape technical hiring standards and career development.
* **Executive Advisory:** Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the CISO, security leadership, and executive stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, trade-offs, risks, and measurable outcomes.
* **Industry Leadership:** Represent StoneX within the broader security and AI community through industry engagement, working groups, conferences, publications, or open-source contributions and bring relevant external thinking back into the organization.

**A typical week might include the following:**

* Spending at least four days in the office engaging directly with engineers, security teams, architects, and other stakeholders.
* Designing and building critical components of StoneX’s AI security platform, particularly where the technical complexity or organizational leverage is highest.
* Working with security leadership and engineering teams to identify and prioritize AI use cases based on measurable security value, feasibility, and strategic importance.
* Leading architecture and design reviews for AI capabilities that span teams, security domains, or enterprise technologies.
* Evaluating emerging models, agent frameworks, development approaches, vendors, and open-source technologies against StoneX’s security, performance, cost, and maintainability requirements.
* Prototyping new AI capabilities to validate difficult technical concepts before establishing reusable patterns that other engineers can build upon.
* Working with engineering teams to solve difficult integration, architecture, scalability, reliability, or security challenges.
* Reviewing production AI performance, evaluations, model behavior, observability, reliability, and cost to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Threat modeling AI systems and ensuring appropriate protections exist around data access, agent actions, tool execution, model behavior, and other AI-specific risks.
* Mentoring engineers through architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and complex technical challenges.
* Advising security and executive leadership on AI strategy, technical trade-offs, emerging risks, and the practical implications of changes in AI technology.

**This job might be for you if:**

* You’re **a technical leader who still builds** – you enjoy setting architecture and direction, but you still want to write production code and personally tackle the problems where your involvement creates the greatest leverage.
* You think **beyond individual applications** – you naturally look for the shared platforms, patterns, services, and standards that allow many teams to build better and faster.
* You’re **practical about AI** – you can separate meaningful technological change from hype and focus teams on where AI can produce measurable security outcomes.
* You’re **comfortable making hard technical decisions** – you can evaluate competing technologies and approaches, make a recommendation, explain the trade-offs, and stand behind the decision.
* You’re **security-minded by design** – you treat AI as both a defensive capability and an attack surface and consider adversarial behavior from the beginning.
* You’re **a multiplier** – you want the engineers and teams around you to become stronger because of the architecture, standards, mentorship, and technical guidance you provide.
* You **lead through influence** – you can establish technical direction and build alignment across teams and stakeholders even when they don’t report to you.
* You’re **willing to challenge the premise** – if a use case is vague, a vendor claim doesn’t hold up, or AI isn’t the right solution, you’ll say so and redirect attention toward measurable value.
* You’re **continuously learning** – you follow AI and security research closely, evaluate emerging technologies critically, and bring back what can genuinely improve StoneX’s capabilities.
* You’re **a versatile communicator** – you can explain complex AI concepts and strategic trade-offs to executive audiences while still being able to go deeply technical with engineers and researchers.

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need**:

* 12+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and operating production systems, including 5+ years focused on AI/ML, security engineering, or both, with experience across tools and frameworks such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Datadog, and Azure.
* Proven experience operating as a Principal, Staff, or equivalent senior technical leader with responsibility for architecture and technical direction spanning multiple teams or an organization.
* Demonstrated experience architecting, deploying, and operating GenAI applications, RAG solutions, or AI agents in production at scale, including evaluation, monitoring, and cost management.
* Deep expertise with large language models, prompt and context engineering, embeddings and vector databases, agent frameworks and tool orchestration, and model evaluation techniques.
* Expert proficiency in Python and strong experience with at least one additional production language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, or C#.
* Full-stack technical credibility spanning back-end services and APIs, front-end interfaces, integrations, and data pipelines.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including experience scaling and containerizing workloads in Azure, and infrastructure as code.
* Deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, technologies, and workflows including SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability management, IAM, cloud security, and application security.
* Strong working knowledge of AI-specific security risks and relevant frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATT&CK, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and executives and drive technical change across organizational boundaries.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical strategy, architecture, trade-offs, and risk across both deeply technical and executive audiences.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with model risk management, responsible AI, AI governance, or similar regulatory and governance requirements.
* Industry contributions such as publications, conference presentations, patents, standards participation, or open-source leadership.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience and non-traditional paths are welcomed.

**Working environment:**

* 4 days' work from office.

title: Sr Software Engineer - Implementations
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Implementations

**Team:** Engineering, building tooling for the Implementation team

**About Machinify**
-------------------

Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention.

**Our Culture**
---------------

We embrace complex challenges with curiosity, having genuine interest and drive to understand the hard problems at hand and how to move the needle forward. Our engineers empower each other to take action, learn deeply about our customers' needs, and unlock innovation with a strong sense of product ownership. We build with our users in mind, thoughtfully shipping outcomes, not just features. The technology we build shapes real healthcare decisions, demanding a high bar for engineering excellence and what we ship carries real weight. We pressure-test new AI tools, shape how they're used, and set the example for what disciplined, AI-driven engineering looks like: fast, but always under structured human oversight.

**About the Role**
------------------

In this role, you'll build the tools and applications that help our Implementation team bring new health plan clients onto Machinify quickly and reliably. You'll create tooling that lets teams set up and launch implementations on their own. Where no tool exists yet, you'll do the configuration directly through our APIs, then turn what you learn into new features that remove that manual work over time.

You'll also build and maintain the internal applications the Implementation team relies on every day, working directly with the people who use them and seeing your work in use quickly.

You'll work alongside AI coding agents as a core part of how you deliver, directing and reviewing their output while holding the bar on quality.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

* Build tools and automation that let the Implementation team configure and launch client implementations on their own.
* Configure the platform directly through our APIs when no tooling exists yet, and capture each repeatable step so it can be automated.
* Turn recurring manual configuration work into new tools and features that reduce manual effort over time.
* Build and maintain the internal applications the Implementation team relies on every day.
* Partner with implementation managers and specialists to understand their workflows and turn their needs into clear technical designs.
* Review your peers' designs and code, and write automated tests that keep tooling reliable as clients and requirements change.
* Write runbooks and documentation so the Implementation team can use what you ship without coming back to engineering.
* Support what you ship by triaging issues and fixing defects.
* Deepen your understanding of the healthcare claims and payments domain.
* Lead the design of larger tools, set patterns for implementation tooling, and mentor teammates.

**How the Levels Differ**
-------------------------

Software Engineer

* **Experience:** 2 years building and shipping software tools, automation, or services.
* **Scope:** builds tools, automation, and internal applications; configures through APIs where no tool exists and automates the repeatable steps.
* **Team:** reviews peers' designs and code.

Senior Software Engineer

* **Experience:** 5 years building and shipping software tools, automation, or services.
* **Scope:** all of that, plus leads the design of larger tools and sets patterns for implementation tooling.
* **Team:** reviews peers' designs and code, and mentors teammates.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Required

* 5 years of experience building and shipping software tools, automation, or services.
* Proficiency in at least one backend or scripting language (Rust, Java or Scala, Go, or Python) with the confidence to work across the others.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience building against and integrating with REST APIs.
* Experience automating complex, repeatable configuration or deployment tasks, such as with scripts, command-line tools, or infrastructure as code.
* Clear written communication, including technical designs, documentation, and runbooks.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools in a real production setting.
* A service mindset. You treat the teams who use your tools as your customers, and you care about the outcome, not just the implementation.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with your engineering peers, implementation teams, and support teams.
* BS or MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).

Preferred

* Experience with TypeScript and frontend development, since some of our tools have web interfaces.
* Experience with Rust.
* Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with healthcare claims, payments, data migration, or client onboarding.

**Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify**
---------------------------------------------

*Machinify is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination on any status protected under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiting team know.*

title: Embedded Software Engineer - Zephyr RTOS
description:
Embedded Software Engineer - Zephyr RTOS

**About GlobalFoundries**

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com

  

**Join the RISC-V Revolution!**

We are looking for hands-on embedded software engineers to develop and enable Zephyr RTOS on MIPS RISC-V based MCU and embedded compute platforms. You will work across board and SoC bring-up, kernel and driver integration, SDK content, testing, and upstream ecosystem contribution.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Port and enable Zephyr RTOS on new MIPS RISC-V processors, SoCs, FPGA platforms, and virtual development platforms.

* Develop and maintain board support packages, device-tree descriptions, startup code, interrupt and timer support, and SoC integration layers.

* Develop or integrate Zephyr device drivers for interfaces and peripherals such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, timers, watchdogs, Ethernet, CAN, and storage.

* Create reference applications, samples, tests, and SDK documentation that help internal teams and customers adopt the platform.

* Debug kernel, driver, boot, memory, interrupt, concurrency, and performance issues using emulators, FPGA or silicon platforms.

* Contribute automated tests to Zephyr test infrastructure and integrate builds and regression execution into CI pipelines.

* Collaborate with CPU architecture, SoC, FPGA, tools, validation, and customer-facing teams to align software with hardware capabilities.

Contribute fixes and features upstream to Zephyr and related open-source projects where appropriate.  

  

**You Should Have**

* 4-6 years of hands-on embedded software development experience.

* Strong C programming skills, with working knowledge of C++ and embedded assembly.

* Practical Zephyr RTOS development experience, including kernel configuration, Kconfig, devicetree, west/CMake builds, boards, SoCs, and device drivers.

* Solid understanding of RTOS concepts: threads, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization, timers, memory management, and inter-process communication.

* Experience with bare-metal firmware, memory-mapped I/O, low-level drivers, BSPs, and hardware bring-up.

* Experience using Git and debugging tools such as GDB, OpenOCD, Segger J-Link, or Lauterbach.

* Python or shell scripting experience for build, test, and validation automation.

Ability to read processor, SoC, and peripheral technical documentation and translate it into reliable software.  

  

**Good to Have**

* RISC-V architecture, privilege levels, interrupts, timers, and toolchains.

* Zephyr upstream contribution or open-source community participation.

* Experience with networking stacks, Ethernet, TCP/IP, device management, secure boot, firmware update, or MCUboot.

* Experience with FPGA, pre-silicon models, post-silicon bring-up, or embedded validation.

Exposure to functional safety, security, or automotive/industrial embedded systems.  

  

**What You'll Get**

* Direct impact on a new RISC-V software platform and its Zephyr ecosystem.

* Close collaboration with CPU architects, SoC teams, toolchain engineers, and experienced embedded developers.

* End-to-end ownership spanning platform bring-up, SDK delivery, validation, and open-source enablement.

A flexible growth path toward deep technical specialization or technical leadership.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**

As a Staff Software Engineer will be part of the engineering team at ServiceTitan to help improve our products and build new ones. This is an exciting role for an engineer to come in and lead the major feature development in the rapidly growing startup. We build for perfection, use the most modern tools on Microsoft .NET platform, have an amazing culture, and love to solve complex problems. If you share the same values, you might find yourself in a perfect company.

We’re building the first end-to-end solution to transform the trades, a trillion-dollar global industry that’s been underserved by technology for far too long. Recognized by Forbes as one of the top cloud companies, we use our deep industry knowledge and technical expertise to develop solutions that empower everyday entrepreneurs to grow and scale their businesses. While our vision is bold, we always stay humble. Join us. We’re just getting started.

**What You'll Do**

  

* Define and drive frontend architecture strategy across multiple product teams, including micro-frontend design and integration patterns
* Lead complex, cross-functional technical initiatives from design through delivery
* Architect and evolve Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities — offline support, service workers, installability, and performance
* Set technical standards for code quality, performance, accessibility, and testing
* Mentor junior/senior engineers and help develop the next generation of technical leaders
* Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to align technical roadmaps with business goals
* Identify and resolve systemic issues in scalability, performance, and developer experience
* Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and best practices where they add clear value
* Represent frontend engineering in org-wide architecture and planning discussions

**What We're Looking For**

  

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant focus on frontend development
* Deep expertise in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks such as ReactJs, and Next.js (SSR, SSG, ISR, routing, and rendering strategies)
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation, single-spa, or similar)
* Proven experience architecting and scaling complex, high-traffic web applications
* Strong understanding of web performance, accessibility (WCAG), and browser fundamentals
* Track record of leading technical projects that span multiple teams or the broader organization
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical culture without direct management authority
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical tradeoffs for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

**Nice to Have**

* Experience Node.js experience, including building and scaling backend-for-frontend (BFF) services and APIs
* Experience building Progressive Web Apps, including service workers, caching strategies, offline-first design, and web app manifests
* Experience with design systems and component libraries at scale
* Familiarity with server-side rendering or edge computing
* Contributions to open-source projects or technical writing/speaking experience
* Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into product features (even at a basic, API-consumption level)
* Familiarity with prompt engineering basics for coding or productivity use cases
* Experience establishing or improving AI-tool usage guidelines/policies on an engineering team

‌

**Be Human With Us:**

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
  
  
**Use of AI Technology:**

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Software Engineer : Data & AI
description:

* Track record of brainstorming and shipping POCs using AI/ML/GenAI services to solve new or existing enterprise problems, with the ability to manage partner communications and ambiguity in a fast-changing, matrixed environment
* Full-stack application development experience — able to design and ship end-to-end data/AI products spanning backend APIs, data services, and front-end/UI layers
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable technical designs, and take solutions from prototype to production with attention to governance, reliability, and observability

title: Senior Software Engineer – Content Management Systems
description:
Summary
  
  
Marcom is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences. Marcom's Interactive Engineering team works on many high-impact projects that serve various Apple lines of business. We use the latest in open source technologies and continue to evolve and deliver solutions on a worldwide scale. Working with a variety of multi-functional teams, the Interactive Engineering group brings it all together to deliver the interactive experiences with an excellent group of software engineers while having fun along the way. This team is exciting and fast-paced; it’s a great place for people with exacting standards who want their work to matter. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience to design, architect, develop, and evolve modern, distributed, scalable, and high-performance Content Management Systems (CMS) using Java, open-source technologies, and modern software engineering practices. This role is critical to the evolution of Apple’s brand as you will be working with the teams taking apple.com to the next phase of its evolution. The role is primarily focused on CMS engineering, content architecture, content modeling, workflows, versioning, localization, publishing, APIs, integrations, search, and large-scale content delivery. The engineer will provide technical leadership in designing and delivering complex CMS capabilities and will drive solutions across the end-to-end content lifecycle. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building modern CMS platforms, solving complex content management problems at scale, and leveraging AI-assisted engineering and agentic workflows to improve both CMS capabilities and software development productivity.
  
  
Description
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to provide technical leadership while building modern, distributed, and large-scale Content Management Systems that power apple.com and enable content to be created, managed, governed, localized, and delivered across multiple digital experiences. You will work across Java backend services, CMS platforms, content architecture, content modeling, workflows, APIs, integrations, search, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and AI-powered engineering workflows. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be expected to lead the technical design of complex CMS capabilities, influence architectural direction, mentor engineers, and remain hands-on in implementation. The role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex CMS and distributed-systems problems at scale and is excited about the evolution of CMS platforms through headless architectures, open-source technologies, automation, and AI agents. The primary focus of this role is CMS engineering, technical design leadership, and end-to-end ownership of complex CMS capabilities.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 10+ years of professional software development experience designing and developing complex, highly available, and scalable enterprise web applications using Java and the JVM ecosystem.
* Expertise in Java (Java 11 or later) and the Spring / Spring Boot ecosystem, including Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, and reactive or asynchronous programming models.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience, with a focus on fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
* Experience architecting and delivering distributed Java microservices and RESTful or GraphQL web services at scale.
* Experience designing and architecting SQL and NoSQL data models for large content repositories.
* Expertise in JVM performance tuning, profiling, concurrency, and memory management in production systems.
* Experience with Java build and CI/CD tooling such as Maven or Gradle, Git, and Jenkins, and with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong testing discipline with JUnit, Mockito, and integration/contract testing frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical design, mentor engineers, and build consensus across creative, technical, and business partners.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Deep hands-on experience with Java-based CMS or content platforms, including custom component, workflow, and API development.
* Experience with CMS, DAM, and PIM solutions and integrations supporting content-as-a-service at scale with high security standards.
* Experience with multi-tier caching and search technologies for real-time content delivery (Redis, Memcached, CDN, Elasticsearch, Solr).
* Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming platforms such as Kafka.
* Experience with distributed logging and monitoring tools such as Splunk and Grafana.
* Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React / Vue / Angular) for CMS authoring interfaces.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML models and AI coding assistants into applications and engineering workflows to drive automation and operational excellence.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. The team is securing the next generation of generative AI and agentic applications with a deny-by-default security perimeter for Artificial Intelligence (AI). It automatically enforces dynamic ingress and egress guardrails on every interaction between agents, models, tools and data across the enterprise. Building on Google Cloud's identity and policy stack (e.g., Identity and Access Management (IAM) Unified Access Policies, Principal Access Boundaries, Identity-Aware Proxy, Agent Gateway and Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Service Controls), we turn intent such as "this agent may read tickets but never delete records" into context-aware boundaries that are enforced at runtime.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, build, and deploy data-plane and control-plane components enforcing deny-by-default AI policies. Own features from design through launch, and help shape your roadmap.
* Build low-latency services that evaluate identity, context, and policy at Google Cloud scale. Author design docs and weigh performance, reliability, and maintenance trade-offs with senior engineers.
* Partner with Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Run, IAM, and Agent Platform to integrate your features. Help define API agreements and integration details, and flag cross-team blockers early.
* Find and fix component risks, from policy correctness to failure modes and abuse paths. Join on-call response, resolve production incidents, and ensure fixes land.
* Turn requirements into clear milestones, estimate reliably, and deliver on schedule. Steer features through launch, including dry-runs and safe enforcement. Write clean, tested, documented code. Conduct thorough code reviews, and mentor Level3 engineers and interns.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in **Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Middleware/Integration technologies, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** . The role requires a combination of **technical leadership, architecture/design ownership, hands-on development, troubleshooting, and mentoring** .

The engineer will work closely with architects, product owners, engineering teams, DevOps/SRE, and dependent systems to deliver reliable cloud-native solutions.

* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable technical solutions using AI
* Define service boundaries, API contracts, integration patterns, and application architecture.

* Evaluate technical trade-offs around scalability, performance, resiliency, maintainability, and cost.

Drive technical discussions across dependent application and platform teams.

* Design and develop production-grade applications using **Java 17/21, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Spring Cloud** .

  + API Gateway
  + Circuit Breaker
  + Retry/Timeout
  + Service Discovery
  + Distributed configuration
  + Event-driven architecture
  + Idempotency
  + Caching
  + Distributed tracing
* Apply appropriate design patterns and SOLID principles.
* Develop effective unit, integration, component, and contract tests using tools such as **JUnit, Mockito, WireMock, and Testcontainers** .

**Middleware & Integration**

* Design integrations between enterprise applications using **REST, JSON, XML, messaging, and event-driven patterns** .
* Develop middleware services that transform, route, validate, and orchestrate requests across multiple systems.
* Work with technologies such as **Kafka, Pub/Sub, JMS, API gateways, and service-to-service integrations** .
* Handle high-volume synchronous and asynchronous transaction flows.
* Design appropriate error handling, retry, dead-letter, timeout, and recovery mechanisms.
Troubleshoot complex issues across multiple applications and integration layers.  

**GCP & Cloud-Native Engineering**

* Design and deploy services on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** .
* Hands-on experience with relevant GCP services such as:
  + **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**
  + **Cloud Run**
  + **Pub/Sub**
  + **Cloud Storage**
  + **Cloud SQL**
  + **Secret Manager**
  + **IAM**
  + **Cloud Logging and Monitoring**
* Build containerized applications using **Docker and Kubernetes** .
* Implement secure workload identity, secrets management, and IAM-based access control.
* Design applications considering **high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and observability** .

**DevOps, CI/CD & Observability**

* Work with CI/CD pipelines using technologies such as **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent** .
* Implement automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment pipelines.
* Work with Infrastructure-as-Code solutions such as **Terraform** .
* Establish monitoring and observability using technologies such as **OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or GCP Cloud Monitoring** .
Diagnose production problems using logs, metrics, traces, thread dumps, heap analysis, and application performance data.  

**Engineering Quality & Security**

* Ensure applications meet enterprise security and coding standards.
* Apply secure coding practices for APIs and microservices.
* Implement authentication and authorization using technologies such as **OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and mTLS** .
* Identify performance bottlenecks and drive application optimization.
* Ensure adequate automated test coverage and quality gates.
Participate in production incident analysis and root-cause analysis.  

**Experience**

* **6+ years** of software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on Java development.
* **4+ years** working with Spring Boot and microservices architectures.
* Strong experience designing and developing enterprise middleware/integration solutions.
* Practical experience delivering applications on **GCP or a comparable public-cloud platform** , with hands-on GCP experience strongly preferred.
* Experience with **distributed, high-volume, highly available systems** .
* Prior experience functioning as a **Technical Lead or Lead Engineer** , including design/code reviews and mentoring.
* Experience taking services from **design through development, testing, deployment, and production support** .

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience modernizing monolithic or legacy middleware applications into cloud-native microservices.
* Experience with **API gateways and service mesh technologies such as Istio** .
* Knowledge of asynchronous/event-driven architectures using **Kafka or GCP Pub/Sub** .
* Experience with performance engineering and JVM troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with **12-factor application principles** and cloud-native application design.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum engineering environments.
* GCP certification such as **Professional Cloud Developer** or **Professional Cloud Architect** is an advantage.

**Leadership Expectations**

The Lead Software Engineer should remain **strongly hands-on** , rather than functioning only as a people or project lead. A reasonable expectation for the role is roughly **80% technical design/coding/review** and **20% technical leadership, mentoring, cross-team coordination, and delivery ownership** , depending on project phase.

The successful candidate should be able to:

* Own a complex service or integration end-to-end.
* Break large requirements into implementable technical components.
* Guide engineers through complex design and production issues.
* Challenge designs constructively and propose practical alternatives.
* Communicate architectural decisions clearly to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
* Drive technical issues to closure across multiple teams.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: Technical Application Developer
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Application Developer to design, build, test, and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions. You will independently deliver medium-complexity features, contribute to technical design, troubleshoot production issues, and guide junior developers while working within enterprise architecture and platform standards.

The role supports Commercial and Marketing organizations across Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, and Field Service; authenticated customer and partner portals built on Power Pages; and integrations with Eloqua and Oracle ERP.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Dynamics 365 technical design and development

* Design and deliver medium-complexity Dynamics 365 solutions across data models, forms, views, business process flows, automation, integrations, and security.
* Build plug-ins, custom APIs, JavaScript form scripting, Dataverse Web API integrations, and selected PCF controls using maintainable patterns.
* Evaluate standard functionality, configuration, low-code automation, and custom code; recommend an approach based on maintainability, performance, security, and supportability.
* Implement and review Dataverse security configurations, including business units, roles, teams, field-level security, and record sharing.
* Diagnose production issues involving plug-ins, transactions, performance, security, access, and integrations using trace logs and platform diagnostics.
* Contribute to solution management and ALM, including solution layering, managed solutions, environment strategy, automated deployments, and release-wave readiness.
* Build model-driven and canvas Power Apps and Power Automate flows with robust validation, error handling, monitoring, and operational documentation.
* Document design decisions and raise significant architectural trade-offs to senior developers, platform owners, or enterprise architects.

Power Pages and integrations

* Design, develop, and support authenticated customer and partner experiences using Power Pages, Liquid, web templates, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, forms, lists, and the Power Pages Web API.

Delivery, mentoring, and business collaboration

* Review code and configuration, reinforce development standards, and coach junior developers through implementation questions and defects.

DYNAMICS 365 APPLICATION SCOPE

**Sales:** Accounts and contacts, account hierarchies, lead qualification, opportunities, product catalogs, price lists, quotes, orders, forecasting, seller productivity, and Oracle ERP connections.

**Customer Service:** Case management, queues, routing, service-level agreements, entitlements, knowledge management, and representative productivity.

**Field Service:** Work orders, incident types, customer assets, service agreements, scheduling, dispatch, case-to-work-order handoffs, and technician mobile experiences.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 4+ years of hands-on experience developing Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement and Power Platform solutions.
* Strong Dynamics 365 development skills, including C# plug-ins, custom APIs, JavaScript form scripting, Dataverse Web API integrations, and exposure to PCF controls.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, and Field Service, including configuration, data models, and extensibility.
* Working knowledge of Dataverse security, solution management, ALM, source control, deployment automation, and production troubleshooting.
* Hands-on Power Pages or Power Apps portals experience, including Liquid, web templates, web roles, table permissions, and external authentication concepts.
* Strong Power Platform skills across model-driven apps, canvas apps, and Power Automate, plus working knowledge of Azure integration patterns.
* Experience delivering work in Agile teams, estimating features, reviewing code, coordinating dependencies, and supporting releases across distributed teams.
* Ability to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions and explain options clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Exposure to Copilot Studio and Dynamics 365 AI or Copilot capabilities, with the ability to build or contribute to working prototypes.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Microsoft certification related to Power Platform development or Dynamics 365 applications.
* Experience leading a small feature team or mentoring junior developers without formal people-management responsibility.
* Experience with Eloqua integration, Oracle ERP integration, Azure services, or automated Dynamics 365 deployments.
* Experience building Copilot Studio agents or Dynamics 365 AI prototypes that reached pilot or production use.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Within the first 90 days, learn the CRM and portal landscape, begin owning medium-complexity enhancements, and become a dependable technical partner for assigned business areas.
* Deliver features end to end, support code and design reviews, resolve production issues effectively, and improve development or release practices.

Over the first year, lead selected workstreams, mentor junior developers, and help move at least one Dynamics 365 AI or Copilot Studio use case from prototype toward adoption.

title: Software Engineer-1
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the HRIS Product Team at Rippling:**
--------------------------------------------

Rippling is rapidly expanding its customer base, supporting larger enterprise customers, and launching new lines of business across its 20+ products, all while scaling globally. At the hear of this ecosystem is Employee Records, a foundational element that powers not only HR products but also integrates seamlessly with every product to deliver a unified, cohesive experience.

The HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) team plays a critical role in managing all aspects of employee data, including hiring, onboarding, offboarding, and transitions. The team's mission is to ensure the correctness and completeness of employee records, which serve as the backbone of Rippling’s ecosystem.

HRIS operates at the forefront of Rippling’s growth, building new products at high velocity to support expansion into new verticals and customer segments while maintaining the integrity of data. As the entry point for any new customer or product integration, the HRIS team is pivotal to delivering Rippling’s vision of a unified platform for modern workforce management.

**HRIS Product Verticals**

**HRIS Flows Experience**: Focused on creating simple, intuitive workflows that empower Rippling's customers to manage employee data seamlessly.

**HRIS Flows Infrastructure:** Provides the scalable backbone for all flow products, prioritizing reliability, data integrity, and performance at scale.

**HR Applications:** Develops essential tools and interfaces for customers to view, manage, and interact with employee data effectively.

**Org Management**: Enables the creation and maintenance of company structures tailored to organizations of all sizes and complexities.

### **The Role**

As a Software Engineer (L5), you are a core driver of our platform’s execution. You will contribute to a technical ecosystem that powers the entire software development lifecycle, ensuring that every integration and API built on Rippling is consistent, reliable, and high-performing.

### **What You Will Do**

* **Power the SDLC:** Build and maintain the core features of our integration and API frameworks, helping teams deploy new capabilities with high velocity and standardized patterns.
* **Marketplace Innovation:** Contribute to the logic that powers the App Shop, improving how customers discover, purchase, and install the tools they need to run their businesses.
* **AI-Driven Tooling:** Work on integrating AI into our developer workflows to simplify third-party connectivity and make the integration process more intelligent.
* **Automation-First Mindset:** Support our "Zero KTLO" mission by identifying and automating manual processes, ensuring our platform is resilient and easier for everyone to maintain.
* **Execution Excellence:** Take ownership of platform features—from building the standardized paths for API V2 endpoints to enhancing the consistency of how customers interact with third-party apps.

### **What You Will Need**

* **0-2 years of professional experience** in backend engineering.
* **Strong Foundations:** A solid grasp of CS fundamentals and proficiency in at least one backend language (Python or Go preferred).
* **Execution Excellence:** You take pride in shipping clean, well-tested code and documentation that other developers can rely on.
* **Curiosity & Drive:** You are eager to work on high-leverage platform problems and have a passion for creating great experiences for both developers and end-users.

**Why Join the Integration Platform Team?**
-------------------------------------------

* **Massive Leverage:** You aren't building a feature for one user; you're building the infrastructure that acts as a multiplier for thousands of developers and millions of employees.
* **AI as a Core Pillar:** We are at the forefront of using AI to revolutionize the entire integration lifecycle.
* **End-to-End Ownership:** You will own the entire journey—from how a developer builds an API to how a customer discovers and installs it in the Marketplace.
* **Engineering Excellence:** We prioritize "Zero KTLO" automation and clean, reusable architecture. You’ll build things the right way, for the long term.

title: Software Engineer
description:
At SolarWinds, we're a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We're looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you're looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you've come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

**Overview:**  
We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Database Engineering organization. This team develops and maintains a suite of database performance monitoring and related applications that help database professionals improve performance and productivity across multiple database platforms.

This role is a good fit for an engineer who enjoys building reliable, secure, and performant enterprise software, working across application layers, and solving customer problems with a collaborative team. You will contribute to product development from understanding requirements through implementation, testing, and delivery, while continuing to grow your technical skills across our products and platforms.

You will help develop and enhance our Database Performance Analyzer solutions, working with experienced engineers, product managers, and other partners to deliver useful capabilities for customers.

**Responsibilities:**  

* Implement, test, and maintain product features across the application stack, with guidance from senior engineers when needed.
* Translate product requirements and technical designs into clear, maintainable code and contribute to design discussions for your areas of work.
* Apply engineering quality practices, including unit and integration testing, thoughtful coding patterns, and appropriate observability.
* Investigate and resolve software defects, participate in code reviews, and help improve the reliability and performance of the product.
* Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, peers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Collaborate with teammates across products and platforms, share knowledge, and take increasing ownership of features from implementation through release.
* Use AI agents and AI-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to support software development, while reviewing and validating generated work for correctness, security, and quality.
* Participate in spec-driven development by helping turn requirements into clear specifications, using those specifications to guide implementation and tests, and updating them as solutions evolve.

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field and 3+ years of software development experience, or a Master's degree and 2+ years of experience, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience developing software with Java 11+ and the Spring Framework.

**Working knowledge of**

* JavaScript
* jQuery
* Angular (Nova Framework)
* SQL, and the Tomcat Application Server.

* Ability to contribute to features across frontend and backend layers, with support from the team as appropriate.
* Familiarity with software development fundamentals, including debugging, testing, code review, and source control.
* Exposure to DevOps practices and continuous integration/deployment is a plus.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents in software development is preferred; curiosity and willingness to learn are important.
* Familiarity with spec-driven development—or experience working from written requirements, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria—is preferred.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders.
