title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**
----------------

Are you an early-career software engineer who cares about writing good code and wants to learn from experienced engineers while building systems that matter?

Join us at FTSE Russell! We’re building a team of engineers passionate about software craftsmanship, quality, and continuous improvement. As an Associate Software Engineer, you’ll contribute to the software that powers indices trusted by financial institutions worldwide, working alongside experienced engineers who will help you develop your technical skills and engineering judgement.

We build primarily in Python, so experience with Python is valuable — but we’re equally interested in strong programming fundamentals and your ability to learn. If you’ve worked with Java, C#, C, C++, Scala, Go, Rust, or another modern programming language and are motivated to develop your Python skills, we’d like to hear from you.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll write, test, review, and improve production software as part of an experienced engineering team. You’ll learn how well-designed software is built and operated in practice — from clean code and automated testing to APIs, databases, cloud services, observability, and production support.

You won’t be expected to know everything from day one. We’re looking for engineers with solid foundations, curiosity, and the willingness to learn, ask questions, take feedback, and gradually take ownership of increasingly complex work.

If you’re excited about developing as a software engineer while building systems used in global financial markets, we’d love to meet you.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**
------------------------

We’re building the next-generation index data platform at FTSE Russell — and you’ll help us build it:

* Writing clean, maintainable production code, primarily in Python, with guidance and support from more experienced engineers
* Building and enhancing software components, services, APIs, and shared libraries as part of a collaborative engineering team
* Writing automated tests and learning how to build software that is reliable, secure, and easy to maintain
* Participating in code reviews — learning from feedback on your own code and gradually developing the skills to review the work of others
* Investigating bugs and production issues, understanding root causes, and implementing well-tested fixes
* Working with relational databases such as Aurora PostgreSQL, learning good practices around data modelling, queries, and schema evolution
* Developing software running on AWS using technologies such as Lambda, containerised services, object storage, and other managed AWS services
* Contributing to data-intensive applications that process significant volumes of financial and index data
* Using CI/CD pipelines and development tooling to build, test, and deploy software safely
* Learning how observability, logging, monitoring, and quality controls help us operate reliable production systems
* Working closely with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver useful solutions
* Taking part in design discussions and learning how experienced engineers evaluate technical options and trade-offs
* Building knowledge of financial indices and understanding how the software you develop supports our customers
* Continuously developing your engineering skills through hands-on work, feedback, pairing, and knowledge sharing
  

  

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**
---------------------

Essential — we’re looking for strong foundations and potential:

* A foundation in software development gained through professional experience, internships, graduate programmes, university projects, open-source contributions, or substantial personal projects
* Programming experience in Python or another modern language such as Java, C#, C, C++, Scala, Go, or Rust, together with a willingness to develop strong Python skills
* Understanding of core software engineering concepts such as functions, classes, data structures, APIs, error handling, and automated testing
* An interest in writing readable, maintainable code rather than simply making something work
* Basic understanding of software development practices such as version control, code review, testing, and debugging
* Familiarity with Git or another source control system
* Basic knowledge of relational databases and SQL
* An analytical approach to problem solving and the ability to break problems into smaller, manageable pieces
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and engineering practices
* Openness to feedback and an interest in learning from more experienced engineers
* Good communication skills and the confidence to ask questions when something is unclear
* A collaborative mindset — you enjoy solving problems with others and contributing to a supportive engineering environment

We don’t expect Associate Engineers to arrive knowing our entire technology stack. Strong programming fundamentals, evidence that you enjoy building software, and the ability to learn are more important than having used every technology listed in this description.

  
  

**NICE TO HAVES**
-----------------

Beneficial, but definitely not required:

* Experience building applications, APIs, services, or libraries in Python
* Familiarity with Python development practices such as type hints, pytest, linters, and dependency management
* Exposure to AWS or another public cloud platform
* Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database
* Understanding of REST APIs and distributed or service-based architectures
* Experience with Docker or containerised applications
* Familiarity with CI/CD tooling such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Exposure to infrastructure as code such as Terraform or AWS CDK
* Experience with data processing, ETL, or data-intensive applications
* Exposure to Pandas, Apache Spark / PySpark, or similar data-processing technologies
* Familiarity with object storage, data lakes, or technologies such as Apache Iceberg
* Contributions to open-source projects or personal software projects you can talk us through
* Experience in financial markets, financial data, or investment analytics
* An interest in financial markets and a willingness to learn the index domain

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. This role is an opportunity to build strong software engineering foundations, learn from experienced engineers, and gradually take on greater technical responsibility while contributing to software used across global financial markets.

  
  
  
  

**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**

**Career Stage:**

Associate

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

title: Software Engineer-2 (AIX)
description:
**About Us**
------------

Exotel is a leading provider of AI transformation to enterprises for customer engagement and experience. With over 20 billion annual conversations across Omni channel, voice, agents and bots, Exotel is trusted by more than 7000 clients worldwide, spanning industries such as BFSI, Logistics, Consumer Durables, E-commerce, Healthcare and Education.

Customer expectations are evolving and businesses face the challenge of balancing the need for increased revenue, optimized costs, and exceptional customer experience (CX). Exotel steps forward as your transformative partner, offering an AI-powered communication solution to address all three!

  

**Tech @ Exotel**
-----------------

Exotel engineering solves some really cool infrastructure level problems with the goal of ensuring no one misses a call or an SMS.

* Our focus is on building very fault-tolerant, loosely coupled, scalable and real-time distributed systems
* We emphasize a lot on clean abstractions of code, loosely coupled services and good coding practices
* We are very strong believers in "you built it, you own it!". And running a distributed system is very different from just building one!
* We are crazy about high availability

  

**The Role**
------------

You'll be part of the team building Exotel's AI and speech platform, powering products like Conversation Quality Analysis, AI Voice Agents, and AI Chat Agents. This means working across large language models, speech processing, and distributed backend systems to process and understand millions of enterprise conversations at scale.

This is an engineering role first. You'll design, build, deploy, and operate production services, and own them end-to-end.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and optimize LLM-powered pipelines for analyzing conversations at scale, managing cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs across model providers.
* Work on speech processing: improving transcription accuracy, handling multilingual audio, and solving real-world audio quality challenges.
* Design and build AI agents that reason over enterprise data and deliver actionable answers with appropriate guardrails.
* Develop and scale high-throughput, multi-tenant backend services with focus on reliability and performance.
* Own cost and observability for AI workloads: usage tracking, cost attribution, and quality monitoring. Model optimization and self-hosting are active areas of investment.
* Take end-to-end ownership of the software development lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.

  

**What You Bring**
------------------

### **Must-have**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
* 3-5 years of software engineering experience.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python, Java, Go, or similar). Ability to pick up new languages quickly; the language matters less than the engineering thinking behind it.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, multi-threading, and concurrency.
* Good understanding of software engineering concepts: design patterns, modularity, scalability.
* Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems: designing, building, and operating them.
* Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and async job-processing architectures.
* Production experience with databases, caching layers, message brokers, and search/analytics systems, including data modeling and scaling.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Azure, or similar): prompt engineering, structured output, cost management. If you haven't worked with LLMs yet but have strong engineering fundamentals and a willingness to learn, that works too.
* Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Team player, comfortable working across teams (product, data, infrastructure) in a fast-paced environment.

### **Good-to-have**

  

* Understanding of RAG patterns: embeddings, vector stores, retrieval strategies.
* Comfortable with Linux, shell scripting, and developing Linux-based applications.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Kibana, Elasticsearch.
* Strong networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, proxies, firewalls.
* Experience with ASR/TTS engines: Whisper-family models, VAD, speaker diarization, alignment, and common failure modes.
* Experience working with audio pipelines: IP streaming, format handling, noise reduction, streaming vs. batch processing.
* Experience with graph databases and graph query languages.
* Familiarity with columnar analytics stores for large-scale analytical queries.
* Experience building multi-tenant SaaS with tenant isolation and per-tenant configuration.
* Exposure to LLM observability and cost tracking tooling.
* Experience self-hosting or fine-tuning open-weight models.

  

**How We Work**
---------------

* You own it. Design, code, deploy, monitor. DevOps is a culture, not a separate team.
* You lead. Mentor and own the output of a team of 4-6 engineers. Code reviews, design reviews, and growing people are part of the job.
* You collaborate. You'll work closely with product, data, and platform teams. Good ideas win, regardless of where they come from.
* You stay curious. New models, tools, and techniques emerge constantly. We expect you to evaluate and benchmark; staying ahead is part of the role.

  

**Why Exotel**
--------------

* Work on AI problems at real scale: billions of conversations, thousands of enterprise clients.
* High autonomy and ownership. Your decisions shape the product.
* A team that values engineering depth, not just shipping fast.
* Opportunity to work across the full AI stack: LLMs, speech, agents, infrastructure.

title: Mainframe z/OS System Programmer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

  

As a Mainframe z/OS System Programmer, you’ll apply your expertise to the systems at the heart of customers’ mission-critical IT environments. You’ll be solving complex technical challenges, maintaining reliable z/OS platforms and helping customers evolve their mainframe environments as part of a changing hybrid IT landscape.

Your work will span both day-to-day platform operations and longer-term improvement. You’ll maintain and upgrade z/OS environments, diagnose system and performance issues, support disaster recovery activities and make recommendations that improve resilience and performance. When an issue occurs, you’ll investigate the root cause and work with technical teams to put the right solution in place.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Run z/OS environments: Install, configure, maintain and support z/OS systems, applying maintenance and patches to keep environments reliable and current

* Maintain the platform: Complete SYSRES builds, apply PTFs, update licence keys and manage third-party software and product maintenance

* Find and fix: Diagnose system failures, freezes, job abends and other technical issues, identifying root causes and implementing appropriate resolutions

* Optimise performance: Monitor system behaviour and recommend improvements that support performance, stability and efficient operation

* Strengthen resilience: Support GDPS environments and disaster recovery drills, including flip-and-stay recovery approaches

* Support modernisation: Contribute technical expertise to mainframe migration and modernisation initiatives, helping customers evolve and integrate their mainframe environments

Protect production: Participate in 24/7 on-call support and respond to system issues affecting production environments  



**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 10+ years of hands-on Mainframe z/OS system programming experience, including installation, configuration, maintenance and production support

* Experience applying z/OS maintenance and patches, managing third-party software and supporting system reliability

* Hands-on experience with SYSRES builds, PTF application, disaster recovery drills and license-key updates

* Experience performing product maintenance, upgrades and compatibility checks, including work with z/OS 3.1 and IBM z16 environments

* Proven ability to diagnose and resolve system failures, freezes, job abends and performance issues

* Working knowledge of GDPS and disaster recovery approaches, including the flip-and-stay model

* Experience contributing to mainframe migration or modernization initiatives and recommending system performance improvements

Ability to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation supporting production systems  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Additional experience in z/OS administration

* Experience contributing to mainframe modernization initiatives

* Experience supporting IBM z16 or IBM z17 mainframe systems

Experience guiding or mentoring other technical professionals  



**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
description:
Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet—investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure.

As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI’s server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery.

Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention.

You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs.

As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team’s engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Own firmware development and integration.** Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services.

* **Resolve complex fleet issues.** Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes.
* **Provide operational support.** Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly.
* **Build automation and preventive controls.** Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention.
* **Drive software quality and security.** Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation.
* **Contribute to platform bring-up.** Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior.
* **Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners.** Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness.
* **Provide technical leadership.** Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement.

**Required qualifications**

* Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations:
  + 11 years of software development experience; or
  + A bachelor’s degree/B.Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or
  + A master’s degree/M.Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or
  + A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience.
* At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools.
* Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in **BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI** , with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform.
* Strong understanding of server architecture, embedded systems, hardware/software interfaces, and Linux fundamentals.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, using evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes.
* Experience owning software components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing support.
* Experience developing automated tests, diagnostics, or operational tooling and improving reliability, observability, or performance.
* Ability to lead technical investigations, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners.
Willingness to participate in the India daytime on-call rotation.  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with OpenBMC or other server BMC stacks, or with server BIOS/UEFI implementations such as EDK II or commercial firmware platforms.
* Familiarity with relevant platform interfaces and protocols, such as Redfish, IPMI, PLDM/MCTP, SMBus/I²C, SPI, PCIe, or ACPI.
* Experience with server or GPU platform bring-up, hardware initialization, power and thermal management, or reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) features.
* Experience using JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or emulators, and interpreting schematics and board documentation.
* Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, update and recovery mechanisms, or firmware security remediation.
* Experience supporting production infrastructure at cloud or hyperscale environments, including controlled firmware rollouts and incident response.
* Experience collaborating with silicon suppliers, BIOS/BMC vendors, or ODM/JDM engineering teams.

title: Staff Software Engineer I
description:
**Job Description**

Are you a hands-on engineer who wants to build AI agents that do real work? Not demos, but agents that provision infrastructure, investigate incidents, answer the questions engineers would otherwise file a ticket for, and take action safely on production systems?

Our technology organization runs the cloud, compute, and network platforms that thousands of engineers across Thomson Reuters build on, spanning AWS, Azure, and our own data centers. We are rethinking how that platform is built and operated, with AI agents and automation taking on work that used to require tickets, runbooks, and manual toil. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead that work.

We are a software engineering team within Thomson Reuters’ technology organization. We design and build AI agents, agent tooling, and infrastructure automation that change how technology teams across the company work. We also own and evolve internal platform and developer tools used by engineers across the company.

We place a high degree of trust in our engineers and expect them to deliver. We move quickly, ship to production, and learn from what our users actually do. In return, you will have interesting problems, the resources to solve them, and real room to shape how a large enterprise adopts AI.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* We build for production, so a prototype is a starting point, not a deliverable. We eliminate toil by design, asking whether software, automation, or an agent should handle repetitive work. We use AI in our own development workflow and apply engineering judgment to everything it produces. We reuse before we build, and we value aptitude and judgment over experience with any specific toolset.
* Design and build AI agents that reason over context, call tools, and take action on real systems, from single-purpose assistants to multi-step workflows with human approval where it matters.
* Build the APIs, MCP servers, and integrations that give agents safe, well-scoped access to cloud providers, source control, service management, observability, and internal platforms.
* Build infrastructure-as-code, pipelines, and self-service capabilities that let engineers get what they need without waiting on a person.
* Own production-grade concerns for agents, including evaluation and regression testing, observability, cost and latency management, guardrails, least-privilege access, defenses against prompt injection, and auditability.
* Lead technically by owning the design of major systems, writing clear design documents, leading design and code reviews, establishing reusable patterns and standards, and mentoring engineers across the team.
* Apply judgment about when AI fits, recognizing when a deterministic script, a better API, or a process change is the right answer and making that case clearly.
Partner with platform, cloud, security, and SRE teams, and with the stakeholders whose work is being automated, to turn ambiguous problems into well-defined solutions.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and operating production systems.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language. Python is the primary language and experience with it is a plus, but strong engineers from Go, TypeScript, C#, Java, or similar backgrounds who are ready to work in Python are welcome.
* Hands-on experience building applications or agents on large language models, including tool and function calling, context management, retrieval (RAG), and structured outputs, with a practical understanding of failure modes such as hallucination, non-determinism, and prompt injection.
* Experience with AWS and/or Azure and with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
* Experience with modern delivery practices, including Git-based workflows, CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines), automated testing, and containers.
* A secure-by-design mindset, especially when giving software the ability to act on production systems.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to write a strong design document and explain complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* A track record of technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, leading through influence, and raising the quality of a team’s work.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent frameworks and SDKs such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, or Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Understanding of what these frameworks abstract is valued more than experience with any one of them.
* Experience designing evaluation suites for LLM systems, or with LLM observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, LangSmith).
* Experience with Kubernetes, serverless architectures, or event-driven systems.
* Background in platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps, including on-call and incident response.
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals (DNS, firewalls, cloud networking) or IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow.
Experience working in large, regulated, or compliance-conscious enterprise environments.  

  

#LI-VGA1

  

**What’s in it For You?**

* **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* **Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* **Culture:** Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* **Social Impact:** Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* **Making a Real-World Impact:** We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here .

title: Software Development Engineer II, AFT Sortation, AFT Mansort
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale.  
  
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them.  
  
About the Mansort Team  
  
The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers.  
  
We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises.  
  
Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs.  
  
Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation.  
  
As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments.  
  
Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements.  
  
Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation.  
  
Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies.  
  
Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions.  
  
Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience.  
  
Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization.  
  
Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability.  
  
Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance to strengthen team capabilities.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

methodology (SDLC)

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**Position Summary**

**Build Distributed Systems at Global Scale — Join Harness Feature Management & Experimentation (FME)**

Last year, the Harness FME platform evaluated **4 trillion feature flags**. For most people, that’s just an impressive number. For a scale-minded builder and engineering leader, it represents one of the most demanding challenges in distributed systems.

To power this scale, we’ve built:

* **Massive global concurrency** supporting millions of real-time decisions.
* **Millisecond-level latency** through a globally distributed feature flag delivery network.
* **Tier-one enterprise reliability** trusted by the world’s most sophisticated companies.

**About the Role:**

* Design and develop scalable backend services using Java/Golang
* Architect and maintain distributed microservices-based systems.
* Build reliable APIs and internal platform services using REST(gorilla.mux, alice.chains) and gRPC.
* Optimize system performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking layers.
* Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, S3, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Deploy and manage cloud-native applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Troubleshoot complex production and infrastructure-level issues.
* Drive engineering best practices, code quality, and system reliability.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership across teams.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver scalable and resilient solutions.

**About you**

* 8-11 years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Go, C++ and Java.
* Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, memory management, CPU/process architecture, containers, cgroups, and filesystems.
* Strong experience designing and building scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Hands-on expertise with PostgreSQL (including pgx driver), Redis, and object storage systems such as S3.
* Solid experience working within AWS environments and familiarity with core cloud infrastructure concepts including VPCs, load balancers, auto scaling, and compute instances. Exposure to Azure or GCP is a plus.
* Experience building and operating cloud-native applications using Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and related orchestration tooling.
* Strong understanding of API design and backend communication patterns, including
* REST APIs, gRPC, and middleware frameworks such as gorilla/mux and alice.
* Proficient with Git-based development workflows and modern software delivery practices.
* Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose infrastructure, networking, and system-level issues beyond application code.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to operate independently in fast-paced engineering environments.
* Proven experience mentoring engineers, driving technical discussions, and leading initiatives across teams

**Nice-to-have :**

* Prior experience writing security policies for API gateways or load balancers.
* Contributions to open-source projects.

**What you will have at Harness**

* Experience building a transformative product
* End-to-end ownership of your projects
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefit
* Flexible work schedule
* Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
* Monthly internet reimbursement

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Staff Software Engineer - SDE 3
description:
**About Us:**
-------------

Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc.). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators’ data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators’ data in a simple yet impactful way.

More info at: Our website: https://www.getphyllo.com/

**About the role:**
-------------------

As a Staff Software Engineer (SDE3) at Phyllo, you will shape the technical direction of key backend systems and lead complex initiatives across services and teams. This is an individual contributor role combining deep Python and distributed systems expertise with fluency in agentic development. You will turn ambiguous problems into practical designs and guide delivery through production. Your balance of implementation, agent direction, review and architecture work will vary. You must remain able to independently write, understand and debug production code, while taking responsibility for the quality and impact of the software you ship.

**What you'll be expected to do:**
----------------------------------

* Lead backend and platform initiatives from problem definition through design, rollout and operation. Coordinate dependencies, sequence work across teams, and resolve technical risks early.
* Design resilient distributed services, data pipelines and APIs. Account for external platform rate limits, partial failures, schema changes and data freshness as you improve scalability and data correctness.
* Write technical proposals and participate actively in architecture reviews. Challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, build agreements and guide designs within your area through implementation and migration.
* Raise engineering quality through substantive code reviews of human-written and agent-generated changes, checking correctness, maintainability, tests, performance, security and failure handling. Implement or debug critical paths when needed.
* Use coding agents extensively across development, testing, refactoring and debugging. Establish effective team practices through clear repository context, reusable workflows and meaningful verification, while retaining engineering ownership.
* Own the production health of your systems through observability, safe releases, incident investigation and preventive improvements. Track reliability, latency, data quality and operating cost to guide decisions.
* Partner with product, design and engineering colleagues to clarify customer needs and shape technical roadmaps. Balance delivery speed, system longevity and infrastructure cost when prioritizing work and technical debt.
* Mentor engineers, including senior engineers, through pairing, reviews and feedback. Help them grow their technical judgment and ownership, and unblock delivery beyond your own tasks.
* Provide technical thought leadership through design discussions, prototypes, technical writing and knowledge sharing. Evaluate emerging approaches with evidence and help the team decide what to adopt.

**You’ll be a good fit if:**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 8-9 years of experience in backend development.
* A track record of leading complex backend initiatives across services or teams, sustaining ownership in production, and improving outcomes for customers or other engineers.
* Strong production Python expertise is required. You can design, implement, test, profile and debug backend services, including concurrent or asynchronous code, and explain the behavior of code written by you or an agent.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, modular design and automated testing. You can diagnose difficult problems and improve unfamiliar codebases.
* Deep practical understanding of distributed systems, including messaging, delivery guarantees, consistency, idempotency, retries and backoff, backpressure, caching and failure isolation. You can explain tradeoffs using systems you have operated.
* Experience designing APIs and data models, maintaining backward compatibility, and evolving production databases safely. Strong SQL and relational database fundamentals, with sound judgment about when other storage models are appropriate.
* Substantial hands-on experience using coding agents for multi-step software changes, with tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent. You can supply context, define acceptance criteria, delegate bounded tasks, redirect poor approaches, and independently verify code and tests against requirements.
* Experience operating backend systems in the cloud, using CI/CD, observability and safe rollout practices. Sound security judgment around authentication, authorization, secrets and sensitive data, including when using coding agents.
* Clear technical writing and communication. You can lead constructive code and design reviews, explain tradeoffs to different audiences, influence decisions without formal authority, and mentor experienced engineers.

**Preferred Experiences:**
--------------------------

* Front-end development with React and JavaScript or TypeScript, including integrating interfaces with backend APIs and collaborating on complete product experiences.
* Social data platforms, developer-facing APIs, third-party integrations or data ingestion systems with demanding freshness and reliability requirements.
* Reusable agent workflows, repository instructions or developer tooling adopted by a team, with demonstrated improvements in delivery or quality.
* Scaling products or platforms in a growing startup, including migrations, performance tuning or reducing operational overhead.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* Hybrid Working Environment: Work both from the office and remotely as needed for a better work-life balance.
* Flexible Hours: Choose to work in the hours you feel the most productive.
* Innovate and Evolve: We’re building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact and less by title.

In this role, you will **lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities spanning multiple RCM workflows** , including backend services, APIs, integrations, event-driven and long-running workflows, configurable business rules, data, and AI-enabled automation supporting charge entry, claims processing, claim submission, rejection and denial resolution, payments, and other parts of the revenue cycle.

**As a Staff Engineer, your impact will extend beyond the software you personally build. You will provide technical direction across initiatives, establish reusable architecture and engineering patterns, solve high-ambiguity and cross-system problems, mentor engineers, and help teams make sound technical tradeoffs as the RCM platform evolves.**

Success means more than delivering features. You will help increase automation, reduce unnecessary manual work, improve claim outcomes, shorten processing time, and build an RCM platform that can continue to evolve.

You will be expected to understand the business workflow behind the software, identify opportunities for automation, and determine when **deterministic software, configurable rules, data, machine learning, or AI agents** are most appropriate for the problem.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* **Define and evolve the technical architecture for RCM automation capabilities spanning multiple products, services, workflows, and integrations.**

* **Lead technical design for complex, high-impact initiatives where requirements, system boundaries, or implementation approaches may initially be ambiguous.**

* **Establish reusable patterns for workflow orchestration, state management, business rules, integrations, event processing, AI-enabled automation, observability, and failure recovery.**

* **Identify where capabilities should become reusable platform services versus remaining workflow- or product-specific implementations.**

* **Drive technical decisions across service boundaries and work with architects and engineering teams to ensure solutions fit Experity's broader platform architecture.**

* **Evaluate architectural tradeoffs involving scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, speed of delivery, and operational complexity.**

* **Reduce unnecessary technical complexity and prevent one-off solutions from becoming long-term platform liabilities.**

### **RCM Platform Engineering**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate scalable production software supporting Experity’s Revenue Cycle Management workflows.

* Build backend services and REST APIs using TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud-native technologies.

* Contribute to modern web applications when needed using technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

* Design and implement event-driven, queue-based, and asynchronous workflows with explicit state management, retries, redrive, exception handling, idempotency, and auditability.

* Design long-running RCM workflows that support state transitions, human-in-the-loop processing, exception handling, replay/recovery, workflow versioning, and compensation or reversal when appropriate.

* **Ensure workflow designs can evolve across multiple RCM use cases without creating tightly coupled or duplicated implementations.**

* Build integrations with Experity applications, healthcare clearinghouses, payer systems, and third-party RCM services.

* Design reliable interfaces for claims, payment, eligibility, rejection, denial, and other healthcare transaction workflows.

* **Define integration patterns and contracts that improve consistency, resilience, traceability, and reuse across RCM systems.**

### **Rules, Data & Automation**

* Develop configurable business rules and workflow capabilities that replace logic currently distributed across application code, spreadsheets, and operational processes.

* Build rules and workflow capabilities that are configurable, versioned, explainable, auditable, and safe to change without introducing unnecessary application dependencies.

* **Guide the architecture of reusable rules, workflow, and exception-management capabilities rather than embedding business logic independently within individual services.**

* Work with claims, financial, and operational data to improve automation, identify exceptions, and measure business outcomes.

### **AI & Agentic Engineering**

* Integrate Generative AI, LLMs, agents, retrieval, and machine learning capabilities where they provide measurable value, while using deterministic software and business rules where those approaches are more appropriate.

* Build AI-enabled capabilities using clearly defined tools, APIs, contracts, permissions, validation, evaluation, observability, and fallback paths rather than treating LLMs as standalone solutions.

* **Define architectural patterns for safely incorporating AI agents into production RCM workflows, including tool boundaries, authorization, human-in-the-loop controls, deterministic guardrails, evaluation, fallback behavior, and auditability.**

* **Help teams determine where AI adds measurable value and where conventional software, workflow orchestration, rules, or machine learning are more appropriate.**

* **Drive reusable AI integration patterns so individual teams do not independently create incompatible agent, tool, retrieval, or evaluation architectures.**

* Use modern AI-assisted software development practices for codebase exploration, development, testing, debugging, documentation, and engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate engineering review and quality standards.

### **Reliability, Security & Operations**

* Build observability, automated testing, security, operational controls, and failure recovery into software from the beginning.

* Design systems with healthcare security, PHI protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and safe operational logging in mind.

* **Define reliability and observability standards across RCM services and workflows, including traceability across asynchronous and distributed processing.**

* **Lead technical investigation of complex production issues that cross application, integration, data, infrastructure, or workflow boundaries.**

* **Identify systemic causes behind recurring incidents and drive platform-level improvements rather than repeatedly addressing symptoms.**

### **Engineering Leadership & Influence**

* **Serve as a technical leader and trusted engineering partner across RCM initiatives without requiring direct people-management responsibility.**

* **Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and complex technical decisions.**

* **Raise engineering quality by establishing practical standards, reusable patterns, reference implementations, and technical guidance.**

* **Influence engineering roadmaps by identifying foundational technical investments, architectural risks, scalability constraints, and modernization opportunities.**

* **Partner with Product and RCM Operations to challenge assumptions, simplify workflows, and ensure technology decisions address the underlying business problem rather than simply automating existing processes.**

* Own critical software through production and continuously improve it based on system behavior, operational feedback, and business results.

* Measure the impact of engineering improvements through outcomes such as automation rate, exception rate, manual touches, processing time, rejection/denial resolution time, successful resubmission, payment outcomes, and system reliability.

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* **8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience designing and operating complex production systems.**

* **Demonstrated experience operating at a senior technical leadership level—leading architecture and technical direction across multiple engineers, services, or initiatives.**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application design, testing, debugging, code review, and maintainability.

* Deep experience building backend services, REST APIs, distributed applications, and transaction-processing systems.

* Proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable modern backend technologies.

* Experience with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and transactional systems.

* Strong experience developing and operating cloud-hosted applications, preferably on AWS.

* **Deep understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, distributed-system failure modes, retries, idempotency, consistency, and resilient system design.**

* **Experience architecting long-running workflow or orchestration systems involving state management, exceptions, retries, recovery, and human intervention.**

* Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and secure software development practices.

* **Ability to design systems and technical contracts that remain maintainable as teams, workflows, integrations, and transaction volumes grow.**

* **Ability to reason across application, platform, integration, data, security, and operational boundaries rather than optimizing a single service in isolation.**

* Ability to investigate highly ambiguous problems using production behavior, data, logs, architecture, and user workflows.

* **Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions across teams through technical credibility, communication, design artifacts, and collaboration rather than organizational authority.**

* **Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical capability of a broader engineering team.**

* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, operations, architecture, data, and executive stakeholders.

* Experience using modern AI-assisted software development tools and workflows while maintaining engineering quality, security, and accountability.

  

### **Preferred**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable:

* Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, medical billing, claims, rejections, denials, eligibility, remittance, payment processing, or claim remediation.

* Healthcare claims transactions and standards such as 837, 835, CARC/RARC, or related payer/clearinghouse workflows.

* Waystar or other healthcare clearinghouse integrations.

* Healthcare, HealthTech, FinTech, insurance, payments, or other high-volume transactional environments.

* **Architecture of workflow orchestration, rules engines, state machines, or exception-management platforms used across multiple products or business processes.**

* Event-driven architectures and large-scale distributed systems.

* **Incremental modernization of legacy platforms while maintaining production continuity and avoiding high-risk rewrites.**

* Production use of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or machine learning.

* AI orchestration frameworks, structured tool use, MCP or similar tool protocols, and agentic workflows.

* Human-in-the-loop automation where AI or software recommendations require review, approval, correction, or escalation.

* **Architecture and governance of production AI/agent systems, including evaluation, guardrails, tool authorization, observability, and fallback strategies.**

* Snowflake or other cloud-native data platforms.

* Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.

* Data-intensive application development and distributed data processing.

* Experience working with HIPAA-regulated systems, PHI, audit requirements, or other highly regulated environments.

  

**Technology Environment**
--------------------------

Our RCM engineering environment includes:

* **Backend:** TypeScript, Node.js, Python

* **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

* **Cloud & Platform:** AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD

* **Architecture:** REST APIs, queues, events, asynchronous workflows, distributed services

* **Data:** SQL, Snowflake

* **AI:** AWS Bedrock, LLM APIs, retrieval, structured tool use, Generative AI, and agentic workflows

* **Integrations:** Waystar, Experity EMR and Practice Management, payer systems, and third-party RCM services

Candidates are not expected to have experience with every technology listed above. At the Staff level, **depth of engineering judgment, experience solving complex cross-system problems, and ability to establish scalable technical patterns are more important than matching every technology in the stack.**

  

**How We Work**
---------------

We want engineers who understand the problem they are solving, not just the ticket they are implementing.

At the Staff level, we expect you to **look beyond an individual feature or service and understand how technical decisions affect the broader RCM platform.**

You should be comfortable learning a complex healthcare domain, questioning existing processes, working through ambiguity, making practical technical tradeoffs, and taking ownership of difficult problems.

Our engineers collaborate closely with business and operational teams because understanding the real workflow is essential to building the right solution. We value pragmatic engineering, measurable outcomes, incremental modernization, and choosing the right technology for the problem rather than applying technology for its own sake.

**Staff Engineers help turn repeated solutions into platform capabilities, repeated problems into engineering standards, and ambiguous business challenges into clear technical direction.**

We expect engineers to understand the end-to-end RCM workflow, identify where AI and automation can eliminate unnecessary work, design for exceptions and failure from the beginning, and measure whether the software actually improves operational and financial outcomes.

We are building an AI-native engineering culture. Engineers are expected to use modern AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery and improve quality while retaining ownership of architecture, code quality, testing, security, and production outcomes.

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

At Cisco Meraki, we know that technology can connect, empower, and drive us. Our mission is to simplify technology so our customers can focus on what's most meaningful to them: their students, patients, customers, and businesses. We’re making networking easier, faster, and smarter with technology that simply works.
  
The modern world runs on the internet, and the internet cannot exist without its underlying infrastructure. Meraki makes setting up, managing, and maintaining that infrastructure easier than it has ever been before. Meraki enables connectivity everywhere from neighborhood cafes to education institutions to global hospitality groups operating thousands of sites.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As a member of the Core Product team, you will be responsible for crafting and implementing features that improve the reliability, simplicity, security, and performance of our products. Our projects are driven by technological innovation and developer creativity in addition to market demands, giving you the structure and freedom to pursue projects you are most passionate about. With millions of people using Meraki products around the world, your work will have a significant impact from the day it is deployed.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with the Product Security team to continually improve the security of our products
* Work closely with the Hardware Engineering team to add support for new Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs)
* Create/update/maintain bootloaders and device drivers that interact with TPMs
* Participate and lead in the design and development of platform and system level software/firmware for Meraki products
* Collaborate with engineers across product teams to architect features that delight our customers
* Participate in code reviews and mentor junior engineers
* Drive debugging of issues when things don't go as planned

* 4+ years of software engineering experience
* 4+ years of experience writing production code in C/C++
* Experience with embedded security technologies such as Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs), Secure Boot, Cryptography

* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related degree

Nice to have
  
  

* Expertise in networking, especially with SSL/TLS
* Experience with security-related aspects of systems design, hardening, and vulnerability patch management
* Experience with embedded systems development such as Yocto and buildroot
* Experience with BSPs, U-Boot, and Linux integration
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitLab, and Jenkins
* Passion to improve code, implement reusable design patterns, and use industry best coding practices

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Who we are**

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**Job summary**

We are building the trust layer for the agentic future. As AI agents move from simple chatbots to autonomous workloads with access to sensitive enterprise data, the industry lacks a standard for **Identity, Authentication, and Governance.**

This role will own the automation strategy that gives the team confidence to ship the AI Agent Trust without breaking critical trust and enforcement behavior.

This is not a manual QA coordinator role. It is an engineering role focused on automated validation across backend, infrastructure, runtime, and end-to-end operator workflows.

  

**What you will do**

* Build and maintain automated test coverage across control-plane services, API contracts, UI workflows, identity flows, policy enforcement, and deployment lifecycle paths.
* Develop integration and end-to-end tests for Kubernetes-based enforcement.
* Build test strategies for Agents based in cloud: Kubernetes and serverless, and agents running as SaaS. The tests will include identity exchange, attestation, hosted proxy or external policy flows, and negative-path enforcement cases.
* Improve CI pipelines so the right levels of testing run automatically for backend, frontend, and infrastructure-sensitive changes.
* Create repeatable test fixtures, seeded environments, mock services, and data setup patterns that reduce test brittleness and increase developer velocity.
* Partner with backend, frontend, and platform engineers to define testable interfaces, improve diagnosability, and prevent regressions before release.
* Contribute to non-functional validation such as resiliency checks, failure-path validation, and targeted performance regression tests where needed.

  

**What you will have**

* Strong experience writing automated tests for APIs, distributed systems, or cloud-native platforms.
* Experience with integration and end-to-end testing for systems that involve multiple services, infrastructure dependencies, or asynchronous workflows.
* Comfort working in at least one strong automation language such as TypeScript, Python, Go, or Java.
* Practical knowledge of CI systems, test reporting, flaky test reduction, and debugging failures in complex pipelines.
* Experience testing security-sensitive or identity-sensitive flows is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes-based test environments, containerized services, or infrastructure-assisted testing is highly valuable.
* A mindset focused on engineering quality, signal over noise, and building sustainable test coverage rather than check-box QA.
* Startup Mindset: Comfortable operating in ambiguity. Bias toward shipping and iterative improvement
* Experience owning complete test infrastructure and toolsets.

  

**Benefits**

* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support

  

To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.
