We're seeking a Product Owner , AI, Agentic Capabilities & Customer Experience to define and execute the strategy for bringing advanced and proactive AI capabilities, including Agentic AI, to the Lumen Customer Portal and enterprise digital experiences. This critical role is about building the next generation of digital service, moving the customer experience from interaction-first to resolution-first, by leveraging AI and autonomous (agentic) capabilities to solve complex B2B customer issues end-to-end and drive significant operational efficiency. This individual will own the Generative AI and Agentic Roadmap and its required foundational platform components, ensuring seamless integration into the enterprise customer portal, developer portal, and underlying API products. The individual in this role collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to drive development and integration, establish and maintain alignment between the customer experience and development roadmaps, and serve as a champion for safe, reliable, and high-quality autonomous experiences.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Architecting the AI Future: Work collaboratively and cross-functionally to define the vision for the Lumen Platform's Generative AI strategy, specifically focusing on how Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous/agentic systems can resolve complex B2B customer issues end-to-end, aligned with organizational goals and strategic priorities.

Define and track key performance indicators including Task Success Rate, Hallucination Rate, Cost Per Interaction (CPI), and Agent Latency, ensuring solutions are robust, and changes are vetted against these metrics before release.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and experience in a relevant technical discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering); master's degree is a plus.

title: Senior System Software Engineer, GPU Firmware
description:
Do you enjoy hacking and tinkering at the lowest levels of software? Are you capable of designing and implementing clever firmware solutions in heavily resource-constrained environments? We are searching for a top-notch software engineer to fill a challenging, yet fun role on our GPU Firmware team. You will be joining a team whose primary mission is solving the intricate enigma of securing and innovating the boot process for our GPUs, while dealing with the formidable constraints of boot-time and storage space. Every. Byte. Counts.

  

This is your chance to create waves in the industry while directly working with and alongside some of the most top-valued diverse minds in the GPU business. Your goal will be to shape the future of GPU technologies doing exactly what you enjoy: solving puzzles. If this sounds interesting and you’re up for the task, we’d certainly like to hear from you!

* Collaborate with hardware, software, and business teams to transform new firmware features from idea to reality.
* Interact with leading OS and PC vendors to improve and innovate on the startup experience.
* Improve team software process and core infrastructure via projects dealing with build systems and regression farms.
* Continuously evaluate and improve security for firmware that functions as a root of trust for flash and boot security.
* Evaluate and improve control-plane and management interfaces of the GPU
Work with hardware teams to improve NVIDIA’s GPU hardware security, manageability, etc.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* BS or MS degree or equivalent experience in EE/CS/CE.
* 5+ years’ experience in developing device BIOS, firmware, or other low-level software.
* Strong C skills.
* Even stronger communication skills.
* Sense of humor heavily encouraged, but not required.
* Deep understanding of software process.
* Secure software fundamentals including cryptography, authentication/attestation, chains of trust, and understanding of common SW security vulnerabilities.
Easy to work with, as you’ll constantly work closely with both hardware designers and other software engineers to design, develop, and debug functional (and non-functional!) aspects of GPU subsystems.

* Experience in x86 assembly and in-depth knowledge of the PC architecture.

title: Advanced Engineer - Product Development
description:

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced **EM - Product Development Advanced Engineer** to join our Product Development team and contribute to the design, development, validation, and integration of embedded electronics and software solutions for automotive applications.

This role requires strong expertise in microcontroller-based embedded systems, low-level driver development, hardware-software integration, embedded troubleshooting, proof-of-concept development, and automotive communication protocols. The successful candidate will collaborate with global teams to develop innovative, reliable, and safety-focused automotive products.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Embedded Software Development**

* Design and develop embedded software using **Embedded C/C++** for automotive applications.
* Develop software solutions for **ARM Cortex, STM32, NXP, and Infineon microcontroller platforms**.
* Design, implement, and validate low-level drivers, including:

  + CAN
  + LIN
  + SPI
  + I2C
  + UART
  + ADC
  + PWM
* Develop and optimize embedded applications for automotive systems and safety products.

### **Hardware-Software Integration**

* Perform software-hardware integration and board bring-up activities.
* Interface and integrate sensors, displays, and motor control systems including:

  + Brushed Motors
  + BLDC Motors
  + Sensor-Based Embedded Systems
  + Display-Based Applications
* Conduct embedded system debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

### **Innovation & Rapid Prototyping**

* Build Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) and prototype solutions to demonstrate innovative product ideas.
* Utilize platforms such as:

  + Arduino
  + Raspberry Pi
  + ESP-Based Controllers
* Support new product development initiatives through rapid prototyping and concept validation.

### **Communication & Diagnostics**

* Work extensively with automotive communication protocols and diagnostics.
* Use CAN development and validation tools including:

  + CANoe
  + CANalyzer
* Develop and execute basic CAPL scripts for simulation and testing.
* Troubleshoot communication and system-level integration issues.

### **System Validation & Testing**

* Perform system-level validation and integration activities.
* Utilize laboratory tools including:

  + Oscilloscope
  + Logic Analyzer
  + Signal Generator
  + Spectrum Analyzer
  + Network Analyzer
* Ensure robust functionality and reliability of embedded systems through structured testing and validation.

### **Product Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with system engineering, hardware, validation, manufacturing, and global engineering teams.
* Participate in customer discussions, technical reviews, and project planning sessions.
* Support product integration activities and automotive product launch programs.
* Contribute to ADAS and advanced automotive technology projects where applicable.

### **Functional Safety & Quality**

* Support Functional Safety activities in accordance with ISO 26262.
* Participate in FMEDA and safety-related engineering activities.
* Ensure compliance with automotive development and quality standards.

### **Documentation**

* Prepare and maintain:

  + Design Documents
  + Validation Reports
  + Technical Specifications
  + Test Reports
  + Release Documentation

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **Mandatory Skills**

* Embedded C/C++
* ARM Cortex, STM32, NXP, and Infineon Microcontrollers
* CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C Communication Protocols
* RTOS-Based Development
* CANoe & CANalyzer
* Hardware Debugging & Validation
* System Integration
* Embedded Troubleshooting
* Board Bring-Up Activities
* Rapid Prototyping using Arduino, ESP, Raspberry Pi, etc.

### **Preferred Skills**

* MATLAB/Simulink
* Model-Based Development
* AUTOSAR
* ASPICE
* ASIL Awareness
* Eclipse IDE
* Image Processing (OpenCV, Python PIL, Scikit-Image)
* ADAS Technologies
* Functional Safety (ISO 26262)
* FMEDA

**Key Deliverables**
--------------------

* Delivery of reliable, scalable, and high-quality embedded software and electronics solutions.
* Successful hardware-software integration and system validation.
* Timely execution of project milestones while maintaining automotive quality standards.
* Effective fault diagnosis and troubleshooting of complex embedded systems.
* Contribution to innovation, proof-of-concept development, and next-generation automotive products.

**Experience Required**
-----------------------

* Minimum **8+ years of experience** in Automotive Embedded Software Development.
* Strong hands-on experience in microcontroller-based software development using Embedded C.
* Proven expertise in low-level driver development and embedded system integration.
* Experience with automotive communication networks and diagnostic tools.
* Exposure to product development within automotive or safety-critical environments.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* ASPICE Awareness / Assessor Training
* ISO 26262 Functional Safety Training

**Behavioral Competencies**
---------------------------

* Customer Focus
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Sound Decision Making
* Execution Excellence
* Accountability
* Collaboration & Teamwork

* Trust Building

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and within global cross-functional teams.
* Passion for innovation and continuous learning.

  excellence.

**What We're Looking For:**

------------------

We are looking for an experienced software engineer to design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable backend infrastructure that powers Cyberhaven's data security platform.

Our team builds and operates core platform services that process large volumes of data across distributed environments. We focus on scalability, reliability, performance, and efficient resource utilization while continuously evolving our architecture to support new capabilities and growing workloads.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant architectural ownership and opportunities to influence technical direction across the platform. We value engineers who understand how complex systems behave under load, reason about failure scenarios, and make pragmatic engineering trade-offs.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Design, build, and evolve scalable distributed backend systems and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
* Develop reliable, high-performance services with a strong focus on concurrency, efficiency, and fault tolerance.
* Design and improve event-driven architectures, asynchronous workflows, and distributed coordination mechanisms.
* Solve complex engineering challenges involving consistency, retries, idempotency, deduplication, backpressure, and failure recovery.
* Make architectural decisions involving distributed storage, messaging systems, and data processing strategies.
* Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, improving throughput, latency, resource utilization, and infrastructure cost efficiency.
* Drive architectural improvements and modernization of existing systems while maintaining production stability.
* Own critical services end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production operations.
* Lead technical design discussions, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and establish engineering best practices.
* Collaborate across engineering teams to define technical direction, develop platform capabilities, and solve complex cross-service challenges.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating complex production backend systems.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, concurrency, asynchronous processing, consistency, and fault tolerance.
* Strong proficiency in Go, or comparable backend programming experience with the ability to become productive in Go.
* Experience designing and operating systems using messaging technologies such as Kafka, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, or AWS SQS.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

**In return, we offer you**

At Philips, we are driven by our mission to improve the lives of 3 billion people per year by 2030, and every day we move closer to achieving our goal by creating cutting-edge solutions that lead to confident diagnosis, improved care, and increased quality of life for patients. Thanks to our employees who share our passion for improving lives, we are at the forefront of the Healthcare industry leading in image guided interventions, ultrasound, patient monitoring, cardiology informatics, sleep therapy, respiratory care and services.

  

**How we work at Philips**  
Our newly-adopted hybrid work concept fuses flexibility with collaboration to deliver great outcomes for our people and our customers. We are embracing an approach wherein we spend more time together than apart – which for full-time employees translates to an average of at least 3 days working from the office and up to 2 days from home – for our hybrid roles. Hybrid work flexibility means people can meet the changing demands of work and home in the most balanced, productive, and healthy way.

title: Principal Network Developer
description:
Designs and develops advanced network systems for scalable enterprise, data center, or cloud-based environments, ensuring alignment with existing infrastructure patterns and collaborating with vendors and internal stakeholders for comprehensive validation. Designs and builds advanced modules within automation frameworks to support testing, operations, and service reliability, automating high-impact network tasks and developing proactive monitoring systems. Designs advanced test strategies and reusable test cases, leading cross-functional collaboration, refining validation methods, and ensuring systems meet compliance and deployment standards. Designs advanced systems for network health monitoring, partners with teams to refine anomaly detection, leads incident response and root cause analysis, and builds efficient tools for frontline support teams. Drives milestone achievements with project managers, mentors junior engineers, leads customer engagements and root cause analysis (RCA) documentation, and ensures integration meets technical standards. Leads network performance analysis to drive scalable improvements and forecasts infrastructure needs for growth.
  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Network Design, Development, and Validation:**  
-Designs and develops advanced network systems that support scalable enterprise, data center, or cloud environments, ensuring alignment with existing infrastructure patterns.
  
-Validates production networks and develops scaling strategies for diverse and evolving use cases across systems or services.
  
-Participates in solution architecture discussions, providing technical guidance on network requirements, tradeoffs, and design decisions.
  
-Identifies and assesses complex risks in network design and recommends mitigation strategies before deployment.
  
-Collaborates with vendors and internal stakeholders to align on hardware, firmware, software, and cloud network code requirements.
  
-Designs playbooks for resolving common and uncommon network issues involving moderately complex systems.
  
-Analyzes network workflows to identify inefficiencies and proposes scalable solutions to improve performance.
  
**Automation and Scripting:**  
-Designs and builds advanced modules within automation frameworks to support testing, operations, and service reliability across multiple environments.
  
-Automates high-impact network tasks for production and lab environments, and optimizes repetitive, cross-team workflows to improve operational efficiency.
  
-Develops and maintains advanced dashboards, telemetry tools, and alerting systems to enable proactive monitoring and faster issue resolution.
  
-Writes, enhances, and documents reusable scripts that streamline routine network operations across teams and product domains.
  
-Modifies and extends infrastructure pipelines and configuration management tools to meet evolving requirements using existing playbooks and custom logic.
  
-Independently configures and extends tools to support new products or services, ensuring alignment with platform standards and integration best practices.
  
**Testing and Quality Assurance:**  
-Designs and develops advanced test strategies and reusable test cases that validate complex network systems and enhance long-term network integrity and reliability.
  
-Leads team-level test practices and cross-functional collaboration, helping define robust testing protocols and ensuring consistency in execution across environments.
  
-Implements and refines post-incident validation methods, integrating break-fix outcomes and lessons learned into continuous test improvements.
  
-Reviews and approves L1 and L2 network changes, and presents high-impact changes to cross-team change management boards, ensuring risks are understood and mitigated.
  
-Partners with cross-functional teams to drive pre-production validation efforts, ensuring systems and environments meet compliance and deployment-readiness criteria.
  
-Prepares and delivers audit documentation and test evidence to support internal Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes, maintaining alignment with security and policy requirements.
  
**Monitoring and Reliability:**  
-Works with others (e.g. monitoring teams) to customize dashboards, telemetry pipelines, and alerting systems, defining service level objectives (SLOs) based thresholds and metrics to monitor network health.
  
-Partners with monitoring and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to refine alerting systems and enhance early detection of network anomalies and degradation.
  
-Leads incident response during support rotations, driving root cause analysis and coordinating cross-team resolution for escalated issues.
  
-Builds and improves internal tools that enable frontline support teams to efficiently respond to network failures and recurring operational issues.
  
**Cross-Team Collaboration and Leadership:**  
-Drives test and deployment milestones in collaboration with project/program managers, adapting plans to address risks and ensure cross-team alignment.
  
-Mentors junior engineers and acts as a technical SME, providing hands-on guidance in resolving complex issues.
  
-Leads customer engagements on technical escalations and delivers clear, actionable root cause analysis (RCA) documentation.
  
-Influences team-level roadmap and architecture decisions, contributing solutions that align with broader engineering goals.
  
-Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve standards misalignment, ensuring integration meets technical and operational expectations.
  
**Performance and Capacity Management:**  
-Leads analysis of network performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, packet loss) to identify systemic inefficiencies and drive scalable improvements.
  
-Forecasts infrastructure needs using performance and capacity data, ensuring systems are prepared for anticipated traffic and service growth.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**  
**Planning & Execution:**  
-Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
**Collaboration & Partnership:**  
-Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
**Problem Solving:**  
-Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem-solving strategies.
  
**Continuous Learning:**  
-Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
**Continuous Improvement:**  
-Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
**Performance and Development:**  
-Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Google One
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* Proven experience leading and mentoring software engineers.
* Strong hands on programming, and strong design skills.
* Solid understanding of recommendation systems, conversions, engagement metrics.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.  

Google One (G1) is Google's membership for personal cloud storage and Google's cutting-edge AI features. G1 is one of Google's fastest growing subscriptions, with over 150 million subscribers. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a high-impact team, shaping the future of our subscriber experiences, premium features and business growth initiatives.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Principal Application Software Engineer
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Principal Platform Software Engineer to provide technical leadership within the AI Platform and Productivity Engineering team. You will drive AI innovation by architecting, developing, and delivering platform capabilities and applications that improve employee productivity across Oracle.

This role will lead the technical design and implementation of AI control plane and data plane services, Codex enablement, AI plugins and skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools, GPT integrations, memory capabilities, and model routing. You will design and develop backend services and APIs, integrate AI models with enterprise systems, and establish reusable patterns for employee support, knowledge discovery, task automation, and collaboration.

Working with engineers, product managers, security teams, and partner organizations, you will translate complex requirements into practical technical solutions and guide projects from prototyping through production operation. You will establish architecture and engineering standards, lead design reviews, resolve complex technical issues, and mentor engineers while remaining actively involved in implementation.

Lead the design of AI cost, token, and usage intelligence capabilities, including telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, token budgets, threshold alerts, and model-cost optimization. These capabilities will help teams evaluate AI investment and scale adoption safely and efficiently.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, development, integration, and operation of secure, scalable AI platforms, enterprise applications, backend services, and APIs.
* Drive technical delivery across multiple teams, clarify requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies and technical blockers.
* Define and implement AI control plane and data plane architecture, Codex integrations, memory capabilities, and model routing.
* Architect and develop reusable AI plugins, skills, GPT integrations, MCP servers and tools, and enterprise AI workflows.
* Establish technical guidance for integrating AI models with enterprise applications, data sources, and services, including authentication, authorization, and access controls.
* Use AI development tools to accelerate engineering delivery and establish practices for validating generated code and maintaining software quality.
* Lead architecture and code reviews, contribute to complex implementations, and mentor engineers on design, debugging, testing, and operational practices.
* Define runtime, middleware, and API standards that support interoperability and multi-tenant scale, including versioning, compatibility, deprecation, and safe rollout practices.
* Establish automated testing and AI evaluation approaches that assess functionality, output quality, security, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Diagnose and resolve complex cross-service issues, guide performance optimization, and translate employee and stakeholder feedback into product improvements.
* Drive shared observability, service-level objectives, capacity planning, resilience, and operational improvements across AI workloads.
* Lead the design and delivery of AI usage telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, token budgets, threshold alerts, and reporting that supports informed investment decisions.
* Define and implement model selection and usage controls that balance cost, quality, risk, and performance.
* Establish token and context optimization patterns, including caching, context management, and workload-specific routing.
Create architectural guidance, migration plans, and adoption playbooks that improve platform consistency and make shared AI capabilities easier to adopt.  

**Minimum Job Qualifications Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or another bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Information Systems, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, and at least 7 years of software development experience.
* 7+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable distributed systems, backend services, APIs, developer platforms, or cloud services.
* 7+ years of experience developing or operating applications on cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* 7+ years of programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript or Go.
* 7+ years of experience with relational or NoSQL databases, including data modeling, querying, and integration with backend services.
* Experience leading technical design and delivery across teams, reviewing architecture, and mentoring engineers.
* Experience with API design and integration, automated testing, secure coding, complex debugging, and performance optimization.
* Experience operating production services, including observability, logging, monitoring, incident response, service reliability, and capacity planning.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, security, product, and business stakeholders to deliver shared platform capabilities.

**Preferred Skills: AI Engineering and Platform Development**

* Experience architecting, developing, or operating AI-enabled applications, generative AI platforms, developer tools, or enterprise productivity solutions.
* Experience using Codex or similar AI coding tools and establishing engineering practices for their effective use.
* Experience with LLM application patterns, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, agents, memory, evaluations, and model routing.
* Experience designing AI control plane and data plane services, reusable plugins, skills, GPT integrations, and enterprise AI enablement platforms.
* Experience designing and developing MCP servers and tools that connect AI applications and agents with enterprise APIs, backend services, and data sources, including authentication, authorization, testing, and observability.
* Experience implementing AI governance, security, privacy, model-access controls, and policy-based model selection.
* Experience establishing AI evaluation frameworks and production monitoring for quality, task completion, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Experience with AI cost optimization, including token and context management, usage telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, budgeting, caching, and model-performance optimization.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely.
  
  
In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data.
  
  
**What you will do**  
Maintain Performance
  

* Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance.

  
Debug and Test
  

* Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running.

  
Develop for the Future
  

* Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**  
  

* 8+ years of experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.
* Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software.
* Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services.
* Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues.
* Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns.

  
**Preferred skills and experience**  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
* Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

building scalable applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate, along with deep exposure to AWS  
Cloud services and practical experience designing, developing, or integrating with Agentic AI systems —  
autonomous AI agents that plan, reason, and execute multi-step workflows with minimal human  
intervention.

Design, develop, and maintain robust backend applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate  
Build and integrate RESTful APIs and event-driven services for seamless communication between

Agentic AI & Generative AI

workflows where agents defer to humans on low-confidence decisions  
Develop event-driven agent architectures using message queues (SQS/SNS, EventBridge, or Kafka) for  
async agent communication and workflow orchestration

Collaboration & Quality  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, data science, QA) to deliver high-quality AI-powered  
solutions  
Participate in prompt engineering, agent behavior tuning, and accuracy evaluation

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

* Databases - Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) — schema design,query optimization
* Architecture - Understanding of event-driven and microservices architecture patterns
* Problem-Solving - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineer - CD
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

We’re looking for a leader who’s not only strong in **backend technologies (Java, Go)** but also enjoys staying hands-on with code. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, startup-like environment, embraces ambiguity, and consistently transforms complex challenges into measurable impact.

* This role isn’t just about managing a team—it’s about building a **world-class product** that strengthens our position as a leader in the DevOps market.
  

**About you**

* **Experience:** 10-15 years of overall software development experience, with at least 2–3 years in a formal engineering management or solid tech-lead capacity managing high-performing backend teams.

* Proven Leader: 5+ years leading high-performing engineering teams, balancing technical depth with people leadership.
* Builder’s Mindset: 5+ years building SaaS applications in backend (Java/Go) roles, with a passion for hands-on architecture and coding.
* Organization Builder: A track record of assembling and scaling world-class engineering orgs.
* Global Collaborator: Comfortable leading teams and working with customers across time zones.
* Customer-Obsessed: You’ve directly influenced customer satisfaction and know what it takes to deliver mission-critical, customer-facing software.
* Performance-Driven: Skilled in building multi-tenant SAAS platforms that deliver seamless user experiences.
* Battle-Tested: Strong command of managing production incidents and leading effective on-call rotations.
* Strong knowledge of monitoring, alerting, logging and Performance optimization in large-scale systems.
* Hands-on experience in various Cloud Platforms or Kubernetes is highly desirable
Technically Grounded: BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

title: Sr Programmer Analyst II
description:
**Work Schedule**

Second Shift (Afternoons)

Office

**Job Description**

**Join Us as a Senior Programmer Analyst II – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation**
=============================================================================================

The Senior Programmer Analyst II performs advanced statistical and clinical programming activities to support clinical research projects. The role requires strong expertise in end-to-end clinical SAS programming, including SDTM, ADaM, and Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).

The Senior Programmer Analyst II works independently as a Lead Programmer or Study Lead on complex clinical studies, ensuring high-quality deliverables, managing study timelines, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and providing guidance and mentorship to junior programmers.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Act as the Lead Programmer or Study Lead on complex clinical studies, working directly with project leaders and client representatives to manage programming activities, timelines, resources, and deliverables.
* Independently manage end-to-end clinical SAS programming activities, including SDTM dataset creation, ADaM dataset development, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).
* Develop, execute, maintain, and validate SAS programs to support clinical trial data analysis and reporting.
* Ensure compliance with CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM, and applicable clinical programming guidelines.
* Lead programming activities across clinical studies, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality datasets, analysis outputs, and supporting documentation.
* Collaborate with Biostatistics, Clinical Data Management, and other cross-functional teams to meet study objectives.
* Perform quality control and validation of statistical programming deliverables, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
* Manage multiple programming assignments, prioritize deliverables, and ensure adherence to project timelines and departmental SOPs.
* Provide technical guidance, training, and mentorship to junior programmers.
* Participate in client meetings, project discussions, and programming reviews as the primary programming representative.
* Contribute to process improvements, programming standards, training materials, and departmental working practice documents.
* Support resource planning, project forecasting, and bidding activities when required.

**Education & Experience Requirements**
---------------------------------------

* Master's degree in computer science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or a related field, with relevant clinical programming experience.

**OR**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or an equivalent relevant academic/vocational qualification.

### **Mandatory Experience**

* **Minimum 7 years of end-to-end clinical SAS programming experience, including SDTM, ADaM, and TLF development, with proven experience independently leading clinical studies as a Study Lead Programmer.**
* Strong hands-on experience in SAS programming, including Base SAS, SAS Macros, PROC SQL, and clinical reporting.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing programming deliverables across clinical studies.
* Experience working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
---------------------------------

* Advanced proficiency in SAS programming, including Base SAS, SAS Macros, and PROC SQL.
* Strong knowledge of CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM.
* Extensive experience developing and validating Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).
* Proven Study Lead or Lead Programmer experience managing complex clinical studies independently.
* Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, statistical programming, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
* Ability to independently manage multiple studies, assignments, and challenging timelines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to interact effectively with clients and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with experience mentoring and guiding junior programmers.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and complex clinical data structures.
* Ability to identify process improvements and contribute to programming efficiency.

**Working Conditions and Environment**
--------------------------------------

* Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
* Occasional travel to site locations, including domestic and international travel, may be required.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence.

You'll work in an environment where collaboration and professional development are part of the everyday experience, and where your contributions make a meaningful difference in advancing clinical research.

**Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow's breakthroughs.**

description:
**Description**

Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go-to partner for the world’s most forward-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.

**Overview**

Synaptics is looking for talented Sr. Staff Software Engineer to join our dynamic and growing organization. You will be responsible for the software development for Synaptics Astra® SL Series of Embedded processors. The Astra® SL Series is a family of highly integrated AI-native Linux SoCs optimized for multi-modal Consumer and Industrial IoT workloads with high-performance hardware accelerators for edge-based inferencing, security, graphics, vision and audio. These processors incorporate multiple high-performance compute engines including a quad-core Arm64 CPU subsystem, multi-TOPS NPU, GPU for AI-acceleration and 3D Graphics, along with multimedia accelerators for Image Signal Processing, 4K video encode and decode, backed by industry-grade security certifications. This position reports to the Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibilities & Competencies**

Job Duties

* Develop device drivers for GPU/Display/Camera as well as the Media/Camera/Graphics framework for our Astra processor series
* Development of bare metal drivers for pre and post silicon bring up
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship on various Software lifecycle components including requirements analysis, design, implementation, qualification, and production release
* Participate in design reviews, documentation, and process improvements to ensure quality and efficiency
* This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of a large team around the world working to create revolutionary products

* Solid understanding of software system architecture
* Excellent skills in C/C++ programming

* Proactive, self-starter, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment to complete projects on time with minimal guidance

* Ability to work within a diverse team and mentor developing team members
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across engineering teams

**Qualifications** (Requirements)

* Strong development experience with device drivers, including Display, GPU, Audio, and Camera drivers

title: Software Engineer - AI
description:
**You Belong at Greenway**

Bring your best and truest self. We celebrate what makes us different and what brings us all together. At Greenway Health, we are committed to an inclusive environment and a culture of belonging as we pursue our purpose of healthier communities, successful providers, and empowered patients. We are united in our goal to build the future of healthcare technology. Join us.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an AI-Native Software Engineers to help transform our software development process into an AI-first engineering model. In this role, you will use AI tools as a primary development partner to convert requirements into working software solutions faster, while maintaining strong responsibility for quality, correctness, security, and production readiness.

You will be expected to take business and technical requirements, create precise prompts and implementation plans, generate a significant portion of the initial solution using AI, and then carefully validate the output for hallucinations, prompt accuracy, missing logic, incorrect assumptions, and alignment with expected outcomes. The goal is not simply to generate code quickly, but to deliver reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software using AI as an accelerator.

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience using AI tools for coding, design, testing, documentation, debugging, and refactoring. You should be comfortable working with ambiguity, breaking down requirements into AI-executable tasks, reviewing AI-generated code, and taking full ownership of the final solution.

Responsibilities

* Use AI-assisted development tools to generate, test, document, refactor, and improve software solutions.

* Convert product and business requirements into clear technical prompts, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.

* Generate 80–90% of initial solution drafts using AI tools, then review, validate, and refine the output.

* Detect and correct AI hallucinations, inaccurate assumptions, invalid code, security issues, and gaps in requirements.

* Create automated tests to verify expected behavior and business outcomes.

* Ensure all AI-generated code meets company standards for architecture, security, maintainability, performance, and documentation.

* Build reusable prompt templates and AI-native development workflows for common engineering tasks.

* Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, architecture, and security teams to deliver production-ready solutions.

* Document prompts, assumptions, validation steps, risks, and final implementation decisions.

* Help educate and guide other engineers in adopting AI-native software development practices.

Requirements

* Strong software engineering background with experience building production-grade applications.

* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages.

* Experience using AI coding tools or large language models for software development.

* Strong understanding of APIs, databases, cloud services, testing, CI/CD, and secure coding practices.

* Ability to write precise prompts and evaluate AI-generated outputs critically.

* Strong debugging, testing, code review, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to identify hallucinations, incorrect logic, missing edge cases, and gaps between generated code and requirements.

* Excellent communication and documentation skills.

* Strong sense of ownership for final deliverables, regardless of whether the initial code was AI-generated.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Amazon Q Developer, or similar tools.

* Experience creating prompt libraries, AI development workflows, or internal engineering automation.

* Experience with LLM applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or workflow orchestration.

* Experience leading process transformation or helping engineering teams adopt new development practices.

* Knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, security, and responsible AI usage.

What We Expect From This Role

This role is designed for an engineer who can operate in a future-facing development model. You will not only write code; you will design the way software is created with AI. You will be responsible for accelerating delivery while ensuring that every final output is correct, tested, secure, and aligned with business expectations.

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components
* Collaborate with ML scientists to productionize computer vision models and optimize their performance at scale
* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

PeopleSoft Developer
  
About the Role#JLLTechAmbitions
  
JLL, an international real estate management company, is looking for PeopleSoft Developers to join our JLL Technology Engineering organization. You will work on mission-critical financial systems, combining hands-on PeopleSoft development with analysis of business needs, root-cause work on production issues, and delivery of enhancements through the full change lifecycle.
  
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, changing environment, enjoys solving business problems through creative thinking, and brings a “Get it done” attitude with a “Think ahead” mentality. You should be comfortable working independently and with a distributed team, and able to lead by example.
  
**ResponsibilitiesDevelop and enhance:** design, code, and unit test customizations and enhancements to JLL’s PeopleSoft Financials modules using PeopleCode, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, SQR, and SQL.
  
**Resolve production issues:** analyze incidents and batch failures, determine root cause, deliver fixes, and move solutions through the change lifecycle. Document recurring failures as SOPs and known-error articles.
  
**Translate requirements:** work with finance users and functional analysts to turn business needs into functional and technical specifications, and articulate requirements in enough detail for thorough testing.
  
**Build and support integrations:** develop and maintain interfaces with upstream and downstream systems using Integration Broker, file layouts, and Component Interfaces, and monitor interface and batch process flows.
  
**Reporting:** build and maintain BI Publisher reports, PS Queries, and SQRs for finance, audit, and operational needs.
  
**Upgrades and infrastructure:** take part in PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) and PeopleTools upgrades, including keep/drop analysis, compare-report review, and retrofit of customizations, and support PeopleSoft environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  
**Testing and quality:** prepare test cases, run unit and system integration testing, coordinate user acceptance testing, and track defects to closure.
  
**Improve and optimize:** identify performance improvements and automation opportunities, evaluate user interface enhancements, and drive change that reduces manual effort.
  
**Document and enable:** maintain technical documentation, training material, and job aids, and consult with the business on correct use and interpretation of PeopleSoft functionality.
  
**Collaborate and mentor:** participate in global and regional enhancement and implementation projects, and share knowledge with and guide junior team members.

Proven experience supporting and enhancing PeopleSoft Financials (FSCM 9.2) in a production environment.
  
Experience with PeopleSoft upgrades (PUM image and PeopleTools), including object compare and retrofit.
  
Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to resolve issues under SLA pressure.
  
Experience with API testing and familiarity with HTTP, REST, and JSON protocols.
  
Reliable, self-motivated, and self-disciplined, able to plan and run multiple tasks at once.
  
Effective written and verbal communication, and strong analytical and organizational skills.
  
Technical Skills & CompetenciesPeopleSoft development (required): PeopleCode, Application Designer, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, File Layouts, Data Mover, Approval Workflow Engine (AWE), and PS Query, on PeopleTools 8.5x and later.
  
**Reporting (required):** BI/XML Publisher and SQR.
  
**Integrations (required):** PeopleSoft Integration Broker, plus experience with file-based and web-service interfaces.
  
**Database (required):** Strong Oracle SQL; ability to write, tune, and troubleshoot SQL scripts.
  
**Financial modules:** hands-on experience in several of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Billing, Contracts, Purchasing/Requisitions, Asset Management, Project Costing, and Travel & Expenses. Exposure to a multi-currency, multi-book instance is a plus, including document sequencing, VAT, sales and use tax processing, payment predictor, and bank interfaces.
  
**SDLC and tooling:** full software development lifecycle (analysis, design, coding, testing, deployment), Agile delivery, and ticketing tools such as ServiceNow and Jira.
  
Basic knowledge of financial accounting.
  
Preferred (Nice to Have)PeopleSoft Fluid user interface development.
  
Experience with PeopleSoft on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or a cloud migration.
  
PeopleSoft Test Framework or other test automation tools.
  
UNIX shell scripting and job scheduling tools (for example Autosys).
  
PeopleSoft security administration (user profiles, roles, workflow setup).
  
Integration experience with external platforms such as Workday or ServiceNow.
  
Oracle PeopleSoft or Oracle Cloud certifications.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Experience Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you eager to shape the future of video entertainment, from movies and TV shows to live sports events? Do you enjoy tackling complex challenges within large-scale systems? If so, we invite you to help build the future of entertainment with us at Prime Video!  
  
Since its launch in 2007, Prime Video has been transforming the traditional television and movie industry. With a rapidly expanding library of high-quality content and availability in over 240 countries and territories, Prime Video is now a key strategic priority for Amazon. We invest heavily in acquiring, producing, and programming a diverse range of TV shows, movies, and live events. Our exclusive titles include "The Lord of the Rings," "The Boys," "The Wheel of Time," and "The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel," among others. Beyond our extensive On-Demand catalog, Prime Video offers a wide selection of Linear Channels and Live Sports, featuring major events like Thursday Night Football, the English Premier League, NBA, MLB, ATP tennis, French Open, and the UEFA Champions League. If this sparks your interest, read on!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable systems that power Prime Video’s streaming services.
* Define the architecture for our software, utilizing a broad range of technologies, programming languages, and systems.
* Implement and operate APIs that manage billions of playback start requests, ensuring seamless, low-latency content delivery.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence the overall technical strategy and contribute to the team’s long-term roadmap.
* Communicate effectively across teams and stakeholders, ensuring alignment with technical goals and project timelines.
* Apply creative problem-solving skills to address complex challenges.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and new technologies, integrating them where appropriate. Fluency in GenAI based developer efficiency tools is a plus.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, contributing to the overall growth and success of the engineering team.

  
A day in the life  
As a software engineer on the Prime Video team, my day starts with diving into hands-on coding and technical problem-solving. I’m not just writing code—I’m helping to shape the architecture of complex systems that millions of people rely on every day. One of the most rewarding aspects of my role is seeing my work come to life when friends and family use Prime Video to watch their favorite shows and live sports.  
  
My primary focus is on designing and maintaining the APIs that power every title on Prime Video. This involves creating highly reliable and low-latency systems that ensure users can start streaming their content with just a click. The challenges are unique, especially when it comes to managing the sheer scale of requests we handle daily. To tackle these, I leverage AWS technologies like EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis, and CloudFront.  
  
Collaboration is a significant aspect of my role. I collaborate with a cross-functional team to align our technical strategies and define our long-term roadmap. It’s exhilarating to influence decisions that will shape the future of Prime Video. Throughout the day, I alternate between deep focus on coding and brainstorming sessions with my teammates to tackle novel challenges.  
  
Beyond the technical work, I also play a key role in mentoring junior engineers. Sharing my knowledge and seeing others grow is incredibly fulfilling. I’m always encouraged to push the boundaries of what’s possible, and I have the freedom to explore new ideas that can elevate our service to the next level.  
  
At the end of the day, I know that the work I do directly contributes to a world-class viewing experience for millions of Prime Video users, and that’s a great feeling.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
