title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
===============

The Acceptance Solutions Product Development team are the engineers responsible for a portfolio of products that drive diversification of Visa revenue, differentiate our network, and deliver value-added solutions across other rails. This is part of a strategy to increase total merchant value by developing solutions that address complex and emerging needs of both merchants and acquirers. Our mission is to drive the future of payment acceptance, helping our clients navigate digital commerce complexities and address an increasing need for flexibility and agility.

The goal of the Visa Acceptance Platform is to be the world’s most open payment platform by delivering market leading, globally relevant, omnichannel acceptance componentry through open, composable, modular APIs delivered with Visa-grade resilience, security, maintenance, and scale.

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on engineering leader to lead teams building secure, high-performing distributed systems for payment acceptance. Our technology stack includes Java, Containers, Kafka, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering depth, proven people leadership, and the ability to stay close to day-to-day design, code, architecture, delivery, and operational decisions while partnering with architecture, product, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient platforms at scale.

This role requires a leader who can balance strategic direction with active hands-on engineering involvement, apply AI/ML and Generative AI to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes, and mentor engineers to grow their technical capabilities and careers. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams while remaining deeply engaged in the technical details that shape secure, scalable payment acceptance. Be a part of our mission to shape the future of secure payments.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

* Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Payment Processing Platform across the Visa Acceptance Platform, providing technical direction across architecture, design, implementation, scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of secure, reliable, robust, and interoperable payment acceptance products.
* Provide engineering leadership to ensure solutions align with platform principles, architecture standards, and Visa-grade availability, resiliency, and operational excellence expectations.
* Remain actively hands-on with architecture, design reviews, code reviews, proof-of-concepts, performance analysis, debugging, technical troubleshooting, production-readiness, and critical delivery decisions on a day-to-day basis.
* Apply AI/ML, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent engineering practices to improve software delivery, search relevance, analytics capabilities, operational insight, developer productivity, and business outcomes.
* Define and execute the technical strategy for payment processing and acceptance platforms in alignment with product vision, business priorities, and long-term platform evolution.
* Drive delivery of fit-for-purpose products and platform capabilities that improve time-to-market while maintaining security, quality, scalability, and reliability.
* Design and evolve secure, reliable, and scalable search, indexing, analytics, enrichment, and data-processing capabilities that support high-volume payment acceptance use cases.
* Provide technical leadership for modern, intuitive, secure, and performant user interfaces that enable search, analytics, reporting, operational insights, and data-driven workflows for internal and external users.
* Set technical direction for event-driven data flows, transaction enrichment, search indexing, analytics pipelines, user-facing dashboards, observability, and operational insights in alignment with product, platform, security, user experience, and business objectives.
* Lead technical design for event correlation, transaction matching, retry handling, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, exactly-once processing considerations, and high-throughput data movement.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering best practices for application development, testing, deployment, observability, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness, strengthening reliability, performance, maintainability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Search and Analytics capabilities.
* Partner with application, data, platform, product, regional, business, client-facing, security, privacy, risk, governance, compliance, and operations teams to translate requirements into high-quality solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements (security, latency, availability, compliance, maintainability) and applicable policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments.
* Communicate and present technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, delivery progress, and recommendations clearly, adapting to audiences that include executive leaders, business partners, product partners, architecture forums, and engineering teams.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers, senior engineers, technical leads, and engineering leaders through regular feedback, design reviews, architecture discussions, hands-on problem solving, technical deep dives, brown bag sessions, tech talks, production troubleshooting, and career development conversations.
* Build and lead high-performing teams by promoting collaboration, constructive debate, accountability, inclusion, and execution excellence consistent with Visa Leadership Principles.
* Bring forward new ideas, engineering improvements, and technology recommendations that increase team effectiveness, improve developer productivity, and advance platform capabilities.
* Influence technical strategy across teams without relying on formal reporting authority, using strong engineering judgment, collaboration, credibility, and hands-on technical depth.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

* 10+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD.
* Demonstrated success leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary, and geographically distributed software engineering teams, including people management, coaching, performance development, delivery accountability, and hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical talent.
* Deep experience designing, building, and operating globally distributed, mission-critical systems that require high availability, scalability, resiliency, and security, and that support very high transaction volumes with strict availability, latency, security, and compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to solve complex technical and organizational problems across multiple domains, systems, and teams.
* Experience setting technical direction, influencing architecture and delivery strategy, and aligning engineering execution with product and business objectives.
* Strong proficiency in modern software engineering practices, programming languages, API design, system design, testing, deployment, and operational excellence, with a strong hands-on background in API-first software product development using technologies such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Vert.x, REST, Kafka, Hazelcast, Git, Maven, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation.
* Recent hands-on experience with architecture, design, coding practices, code reviews, debugging, production support, and technical decision-making in complex software systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, containerized deployment models, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, streaming platforms such as Kafka, and high-throughput transaction or data processing systems, including resilient patterns such as event correlation, transaction matching, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, and exactly-once processing considerations.
* Experience delivering secure software platforms, including familiarity with authentication, authorization, encryption, identity, and secure engineering practices.
* rack record of mentoring engineers, developing technical leaders, and building strong engineering culture.
* Experience applying AI-enabled engineering practices, automation, or developer productivity improvements across software delivery teams, and implementing, deploying, or governing AI/ML, Generative AI, or agentic AI capabilities in production environments or engineering workflows.
* Experience in payments, financial services, fintech, or high-scale transaction processing environments, including payment processing, transaction lifecycle concepts, payment network protocols, and acceptance workflows.
* Experience partnering with executive leadership, product leaders, technical product managers, regional teams, and business stakeholders to define strategy, roadmaps, requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Experience with financial services compliance, risk, and control requirements such as PCI-DSS, SOX, security standards, audit readiness, and operational controls.
* Strong experience with agile delivery, software development lifecycle practices, engineering metrics, continuous improvement, developer productivity, and operational performance management.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to form, advocate, and communicate an independent technical viewpoint grounded in hands-on engineering experience.
* Long-term strategic thinker who stays current with emerging technologies and translates them into practical engineering and business outcomes.
* Highly driven, resourceful, results-oriented, and collaborative, with strong communication skills and a focus on durable, win-win outcomes.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

This is a project-based role where you’ll enjoy deep involvement throughout the lifespan of a project, as well as the chance to work closely with Architects, Technicians, and PMs. Whatever your current level of tech savvy or where you want your career to lead, you’ll find the right opportunities and a buddy to support your growth. Boredom? Trust us, that won’t be an issue.

  

Your future at Kyndryl

There are lots of opportunities to gain certification and qualifications on the job, and you’ll continuously grow as a Cloud Hyperscaler. Many of our Infrastructure Specialists are on a path toward becoming either an Architect or Distinguished Engineer, and there are opportunities at every skill level to grow in either of these directions.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience**

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.

The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.

We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call.
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context.
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits.
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca.
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down.
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages.
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks.
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end.
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others.
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks.
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media.
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers.
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail.
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps.
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits.
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents.
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat.
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency.

**Why Blue Machines**
---------------------

You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Cloudera Data Platform
description:
**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**DATA PLATFORM TECHNOLOGY / JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Senior Cloudera Data Platform, NiFi & Airflow Administrator**

**Senior / Expert Level | Enterprise Data Platform Operations**

**Short Overview**
  
The Senior Cloudera, NiFi & Airflow Administrator is responsible for the administration, design, operation, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of enterprise data platform services. The role provides end-to-end administration of Cloudera Data Platform environments, Apache NiFi data-flow services, and Apache Airflow orchestration services across production and non-production environments. The administrator is expert for distributed data processing, data engines, data ingestion, workflow orchestration, platform automation, observability, troubleshooting, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and operational governance in a mission-critical enterprise environment. The role also requires strong Linux administration skills, including system configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, networking, storage management, and security.

**Overall Experience: 5+ years, senior / expert level**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operate and maintain enterprise data platforms**

Ensure secure, reliable, and stable operation, availability, performance, and resilience of Cloudera, Apache NiFi, and Apache Airflow services across production and non-production environments, including platform security, access control, authentication, authorization, encryption, and compliance with enterprise security standards.

**Design and evolve platform architecture**

Define and review high-availability concepts, disaster recovery arrangements, environment topology, service placement, integration patterns, configuration standards, naming conventions, and operational guidelines.

**Provide senior-level troubleshooting and incident support**

Analyze and resolve complex issues across distributed services, workloads, data flows, workflows, metadata, security, networking, operating systems, storage, databases, JVMs, and dependent infrastructure.

**Support application, analytics, data engineering and data science teams**

Consult teams on solution onboarding, workload design, resource utilization, scheduling, data movement, dependency management, resilience and error handling, operational readiness, and production support requirements.

**Manage platform configuration, security, and access control**

Maintain authentication, authorization, roles, policies, service accounts, certificates, TLS, secrets, network connectivity, encryption settings, and integrations with enterprise identity and security services.

**Perform capacity planning and performance optimization**

Monitor workload concurrency, queues, memory, CPU, storage, network throughput, JVM behavior, NiFi back pressure, repository usage, Airflow scheduler performance, task throughput, metadata database health, and service saturation; recommend scaling and tuning actions.

**Support and maintain non-production and production environments**

Provide maintenance, refresh, patching, configuration alignment, access management, test support, troubleshooting, and lifecycle activities for DEV, TEST, SIT, UAT, PROD, and similar environments.

**Develop automation and operational tooling**

Create and improve scripts, configuration templates, deployment automation, health checks, dashboards, alerts, reporting, and self-service procedures using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices.

**Manage platform lifecycle and vulnerability remediation**

Coordinate version currency, upgrades, patches, vulnerability assessment, remediation plans, exception handling, risk acceptance, end-of-support tracking, and compliance evidence for platform components.

**Lead changes, upgrades, migrations, and recovery tests**

Plan and execute platform upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, certificate renewals, component replacements, backup and restore validation, failover exercises, and disaster recovery tests with controlled business impact.

**Ensure observability and operational reporting**

Define monitoring standards, alert thresholds, service dashboards, availability views, incident trends, capacity reports, and operational KPIs for the supported services.

**Contribute to service governance and compliance**

Maintain architecture records, technical documentation, runbooks, standards, configuration inventories, risk records, audit evidence, operational controls, and support procedures.

**Act as platform subject matter expert**

Provide expert guidance on distributed data platforms, data ingestion, orchestration, resilience, security, platform selection, and operational best practices.

**Participate in on-call, major incident, and problem management**

Support critical incidents, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, permanent corrective actions, and knowledge sharing across operations, engineering, architecture, and application teams.

**Cloudera-Specific Responsibilities**

* Administer Cloudera Data Platform services and supporting components, including Cloudera Manager, HDFS, YARN, Hive, Impala, Spark, Ranger, Atlas, Knox, ZooKeeper, Kerberos, Ozone , OTF Iceberg and related platform services where deployed.

* Manage service configuration, role placement, parcels and runtime versions, host maintenance, commissioning and decommissioning, rolling restarts, health checks, configuration validation, and environment consistency.

* Monitor and troubleshoot cluster health, HDFS and Ozone capacity, replication, under-replicated data, YARN queues, workload contention, Hive Metastore, Impala admission control, Spark execution, service logs, JVM resources, and host-level dependencies.

* Administer data-platform security, including Kerberos integration, Ranger policies, Knox access, TLS certificates, keytabs, service identities, encryption-related configuration, and audit logging.

* Support backup, restore, replication, disaster recovery, data retention, metadata protection, and recovery testing for platform services and configuration.

* Plan cluster expansion, operating system and Java compatibility changes, platform upgrades, service migrations, storage evolution, and decommissioning of obsolete components.

**Apache NiFi-Specific Responsibilities**

* Administer clustered Apache NiFi environments, including nodes, process groups, processors, controller services, parameter contexts, reporting tasks, connection pools, repositories, and registry integration.

* Operate and troubleshoot data flows, queues, back pressure, provenance, bulletins, failed transactions, state management, priorities, concurrent tasks, scheduling, record processors, and interactions with source and target systems.

* Define standards for reusable flow design, version control, promotion between environments, parameterization, secret handling, naming, documentation, error routing, retry logic, dead-letter patterns, and operational ownership.

* Manage NiFi security, including TLS, certificates, authentication, authorization policies, service accounts, proxy configuration, sensitive properties, and integration with enterprise identity services.

* Plan and execute NiFi upgrades, node replacement, cluster expansion, repository maintenance, certificate renewal, flow migration, backup and recovery activities, and resilience testing.

* Monitor flow throughput, queue growth, back pressure, repository utilization, JVM resources, garbage collection, thread usage, connection status, and end-to-end delivery behavior.

**Apache Airflow-Specific Responsibilities**

* Administer Apache Airflow environments and core components, including schedulers, webservers, triggers, workers, executors, metadata databases, DAG processing, connections, variables, pools, queues, plugins, and providers.

* Operate and troubleshoot DAG parsing, task scheduling, retries, dependencies, sensors, deferrable operators, worker capacity, queue behavior, executor performance, metadata database contention, failed tasks, and scheduler availability.

* Define standards for DAG structure, deployment, version control, environment promotion, secrets, connections, variables, pools, concurrency, retries, alerting, ownership, documentation, and operational readiness.

* Manage Airflow security, including authentication, role-based access control, secrets backends, service identities, TLS, API access, auditability, and integration with enterprise identity and security services.

* Plan and execute Airflow upgrades, provider updates, executor or worker changes, metadata database maintenance, DAG migration, backup and restore validation, and high-availability improvements.

* Monitor scheduler heartbeat, DAG processing time, task latency, queue depth, worker utilization, executor state, triggerer health, metadata database performance, and availability of dependent services.

* Hands-on production administration experience with Cloudera Data Platform, Apache NiFi, and Apache Airflow.

* Strong troubleshooting capability across application, platform, JVM, database, operating system, network, storage, and security layers.

* Ability to analyze logs, metrics, traces, service states, resource queues, flow files, back pressure, provenance, DAG runs, task instances, scheduler behavior, and infrastructure dependencies.

* Ability to maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, support models, architecture records, operational procedures, and audit evidence.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to coordinate technical activities during incidents, changes, upgrades, migrations, releases, and service improvements.

**Profile required**

**Cloudera Data Platform**

Cloudera Manager, CDP Private Cloud Base, HDFS, Ozone, OTF Iceberg, YARN, Hive, Impala, Spark, Ranger, Atlas, Knox, ZooKeeper, Kerberos, Hive Metastore, resource management, workload governance, backup and disaster recovery.

NiFi clustering, processors, controller services, process groups, queues, back pressure, FlowFile and content repositories, provenance, state management, parameter contexts, Registry, record-based processing, Site-to-Site, APIs, security, monitoring, and performance tuning.

Schedulers, webservers, triggerers, workers, DAG processors, executors, metadata database, DAGs, operators, sensors, task instances, pools, queues, connections, variables, providers, plugins, secrets backends, REST API, RBAC, monitoring, and performance tuning.

Python, Bash, Ansible, Git, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, REST APIs, configuration management, container images, Kubernetes, Helm, and artifact repositories.

From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.

**Overview**

Synaptics is looking for talented Software Engineer, Embedded & Edge AI to join our dynamic and growing organization. These processors incorporate multiple high-performance compute engines including a quad-core Arm64 CPU subsystem, multi-TOPS NPU, GPU for AI-acceleration and 3D Graphics, along with multimedia accelerators for Image Signal Processing, 4K video encode and decode, backed by industry-grade security certifications. * Solid understanding of software system architecture

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**About the Team & Role**

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's Mobility organization.

  
  

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app scaffolding via Theseus Builder. In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Build specific components within an established architecture.
* You'll follow the patterns your team has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them.
* Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards.
* Before you start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're solving the right problem, not just writing code.
* Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks.
* You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching the symptom.
* Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under supervision.
* During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your confidence with live systems gradually and safely.
* Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug issues.
* You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should make it easier for others to do so.
* Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
* Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if something is at risk.
* You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first.
* Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos.
* You'll listen to stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not just whether it passed the acceptance criteria.
* Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked.
* Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system.
  

  

**Experience You'll Bring**

* You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience.
* You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional.
* You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought.
* You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on.
* You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure.
* When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due.
* You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution.
* Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging environment as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
* Familiarity with cloud basics even through coursework or personal projects.
* Exposure to containerization through Docker. Reading and running existing Dockerfiles counts, you don't need to have written them from scratch.
* Some experience working in an existing codebase, contributin improvements, and navigating code you didn't write yourself.
* Awareness of AI tools beyond code completion, such as experimenting with prompt design or modifying a simple AI-powered script or agent.
* A genuine interest in the domain. Payments, fleet operations, or developer platform work are exciting problem spaces and it helps to be curious about the industry, not just the technology.

description:

---------------

You'll go beyond software development to include reliability engineering, where you'll design robust frameworks to fortify system resilience. This role blends technical challenge, creative problem-solving, and strategic impact. If you're passionate about leveraging automation for business transformation, join us on this journey towards operational excellence.

title: Sr Salesforce CRM Developer
description:
Experience- 6 plus years

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and analytical Senior Salesforce CRM Developer with strong technical expertise in the Retail industry domain. This role requires an architecturally minded developer with 5+ years of hands-on experience, specifically focused on robust ecosystem integrations connecting Salesforce with key retail retail operations engines like LS Central and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or equivalent.

Core Responsibilities & Technical Capabilities

Systems Integration & Retail Architecture

* ERP & Unified Commerce Integration: Design, implement, and support scalable sync architectures connecting Salesforce CRM with LS Central and Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* API Development: Build custom Apex REST/SOAP endpoints and design complex integration workflows utilizing Platform Events and External ID matching architectures.
* Robust Logging: Implement comprehensive integration exception logging, monitoring frameworks, and automated retry mechanisms for transaction-heavy retail syncs.

Core Configuration & Automation

* Data Modelling & Security: Architect custom objects, custom fields, page layouts, record types, advanced validation rules, and granular permission sets.
* Modern Automation: Develop complex screen, record-triggered, and scheduled Flows; lead initiatives migrating legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builder automations into high-performance Flows.

Custom Technical Development

* Programmatic Solutions: Write high-performing, asynchronous, and secure programmatic logic including Apex classes, multi-object triggers, Batch Apex, and Scheduled Apex.
* UI Frameworks: Design and deploy scalable custom web interfaces using Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Code Quality & Optimisation: Perform system-wide bulkification, refactor technical debt to circumvent strict governor limits, and drive code quality via static code analysis (PMD cleanup).

Lifecycle Management, Enhancements & Release

* Lifecycle Execution: Deliver standard maintenance changes against live production processes alongside complete end-to-end management of complex new functional requirements (from solution design to sandbox construction).
* Testing & Deployment: Organize and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles and manage technical release management from sandbox to production.
* Release Resilience: Execute thorough regression test beds to proactively adapt custom layers to Salesforce's three major seasonal releases (Spring, Summer, Winter).

Platform Governance & Operational Support

* Operational Support: Manage ticket-based user queues, handle comprehensive licence allocations, maintain corporate data integrity fixes, and continuously audit the global platform security model.

Experience & Certifications

* Professional Experience: Minimum 6+ years of pure, hands-on Salesforce development and configuration lifecycle experience.
* Industry Expertise: Strong contextual knowledge of the retail landscape, omnichannel supply chains, or physical point-of-sale (POS) integrations.
* Required Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator and Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PDI) at a minimum; Advanced Administrator, Platform Developer II (PDII), or Integration Architect certifications are highly desired.
* Technical Stack Alignment: Proven track record working directly on integrations involving LS Central and Dynamics 365 Business Central.

LWC framework knowledge details

Batch and Scheduled Apex

NFR aspects including bulkification, performance, code review / clean ups etc NFR

Required Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator and Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PDI) at a minimum; Advanced Administrator, Platform Developer II (PDII), or Integration Architect certifications are highly desired.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, and do you currently hold both the Salesforce Certified Administrator and Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PDI) certifications?
* Have you designed and built direct ecosystem integrations connecting Salesforce CRM with retail ERPs or POS engines such as LS Central or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central?
* Do you have experience building custom Apex REST/SOAP APIs, utilizing Platform Events, and writing multi-object triggers, Batch Apex, and Scheduled Apex handling high-volume data?
* Are you proficient in building custom user interfaces using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and performing code cleanups/refactoring using static code analysis tools like PMD to comply with governor limits?

Partner with governance, legal, and security teams to establish guardrails and standard practices for the safe enterprise deployment of large language models.

* Stay current with emerging advancements in AI and machine learning, including new LLMs, vector database technologies, open-source frameworks, and cloud AI capabilities. description:

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Sr. System Software Quality Engineer**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD’s quality engineering team is looking for an Associate QA Engineer to build, execute, and scale automated test suites for our core memory-tiering agent and central management platform. You will work closely with developers to ensure the stability of low-level Linux systems and high-performance prefetching engines. You will leverage a comprehensive test environment to practice robust test automation daily, using modern AI tools to accelerate development and focus on the core semantics of test behaviors rather than syntax. While automation is central to scaling and regression, some manual testing is also expected.

**THE PERSON:**

We are looking for a QA Engineer with proven experience in software testing, QA, or systems validation. The candidate will have advanced Linux knowledge and intermediate Python scripting skills, and will bring endless curiosity about how complex, low-level software and hardware systems interact. The engineer will thrive in a fast-moving, high-velocity environment, working independently while managing rapidly changing priorities.

The engineer will engage as an active team player, communicate with empathy across technical and non-technical audiences, and consistently drive to make things better, faster, and more cost-effective.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Responsibilities:

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Platform Optimization & Org Health**

* Hunt down technical debt — dead automations, bloated triggers, redundant fields, and queries that scan half the database for one record.
* Audit and rationalize automations into a single, sane framework. No more “which of the five automations on this object actually fires first?” mysteries.
* Monitor org health proactively — governor limits, storage, API consumption, deployment stability — using Salesforce Optimizer, Event Monitoring, and custom dashboards you build yourself.

**Development & Code Quality**

* Build production-grade Apex — bulkified, governor-limit-aware, single-trigger-per-object, with proper separation of concerns (service/selector/domain layers).
* Develop Lightning Web Components that are reusable, accessible
* Hold the quality bar in code reviews — meaningful test assertions (not just coverage farming), no hardcoded IDs, clean error handling, sensible naming.
* Own and improve the CI/CD pipeline — scratch orgs, source-driven development, automated test gates, and deployments that don’t need a war room.

**Integration & Data Management**

* Design and maintain integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture — with proper retry logic, error handling, and idempotency.
* Champion data quality — deduplication strategies, validation rules that actually help, and migration practices that don’t create a cleanup project of their own.
* Troubleshoot sync failures and API limit issues across connected systems before they become someone’s escalation.

**Collaboration & Best Practices Enablement**

* Define and document development standards and best practices — then make sure the team actually follows them.
* Mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing — not lectures.
* Evaluate every Salesforce release (three per year) for features worth adopting and deprecations worth addressing.
* Help the team make smart clicks-vs-code decisions so the org stays maintainable as it grows.

Qualifications:

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, and enough Visualforce knowledge to maintain legacy components.
* Strong JavaScript/ES6+, HTML, and CSS fundamentals.
* Expertise in Salesforce’s security architecture — profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS, OWDs, role hierarchy.
* Solid Git workflow habits — branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution.
* Proficiency with Salesforce CLI, scratch orgs, metadata API, and at least one CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset).
* Sharp debugging instincts — Debug Logs, Query Plan tool, Limit monitoring, and the patience to trace a bug through five layers of automation.
* Familiarity with data migration/ETL tools — Data Loader, Dataloader.io, or equivalent.
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum rhythms without needing a ceremony for every decision.

**Good to have AI Exposure**

* Understanding of AI/ML fundamentals — supervised vs unsupervised learning, model training, evaluation metrics, and data pipelines.
* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) — prompt engineering, fine-tuning concepts, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and API-based integrations.
* Familiarity with generative AI use cases in enterprise contexts — summarization, classification, content generation, conversational bots, and intelligent search.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools for code generation, test scaffolding, or automated code review.
* Basic comfort with Python or similar languages for scripting AI/ML workflows, data wrangling, or prototyping.
* Awareness of responsible AI principles — bias, explainability, data privacy, and governance considerations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–9 years of hands-on Salesforce platform development — cloud-agnostic, problem-first.
* Active Salesforce certifications preferred — Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, or any specialist certification.
* Clear communicator who can explain a complex technical tradeoff to a business stakeholder without their eyes glazing over.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
The Lead Software Engineer for Disney Experiences Technology is a subject matter expert and hands-on technical leader who designs, builds, and evolves high-scale software that powers magical, immersive Guest experiences across parks, resorts, cruise, vacation, travel, retail, and consumer touchpoints worldwide. In this role, you guide engineering efforts across the stack, mentor other developers, and ensure solutions are robust, performant, and aligned with Disney’s creative, customer-focused, and innovative culture.

**Responsibilities:**

As a Lead Software Engineer, you act as a skilled, experienced subject matter expert and lead, organizing development efforts across UI, services, and integrations to deliver intuitive, high-volume Guest and internal experiences for Disney Experiences brands. You solve complex problems, identify innovative solutions, and serve as a mentor and problem-solver who can explain difficult concepts, influence technical direction, and collaborate as a team player across technology and business partners. This role matters because it connects engineering excellence with Disney’s Guest-centric vision, requiring strong technical depth, communication, collaboration, and accountability to succeed.

* Serve as a subject matter expert and technical lead across the software stack, guiding architecture, design, and implementation for complex, large-scale systems and applications.

* Organize and lead development efforts, including analysis, programming, debugging, and modification of software improvements and new products used across Guest-facing and internal platforms.

* Mentor, train, and guide individual contributors by providing continuous coaching, feedback, and technical oversight, helping them connect their work to team goals and business outcomes.

* Break down organizational and product goals into clear strategies, expectations, and priorities, empowering team members to contribute their unique talents toward well-defined results.

* Lead end-to-end troubleshooting, problem analysis, and incident resolution for high-volume, 24/7 applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and a seamless Guest experience.

* Participate in and often lead agile rituals—such as scrums, sprint planning, capacity tracking, and demos—to align deliverables, manage dependencies, and drive continuous value delivery.

* Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners and other technology teams to define system requirements, estimate and plan scalable projects, and negotiate solutions that balance technical and business needs.

* Own the design and development of backend services, APIs, and integrations, including security, data flow, and performance considerations for cloud-hosted, distributed systems.

* Stay current with emerging technologies and tools, making informed recommendations that foster creativity, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team.

* Create an environment where Disney values are experienced daily by encouraging collaboration, creative problem solving, accountability, and ensuring every voice is heard.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong subject matter expertise in software engineering, with the ability to lead complex projects and act as a primary technical point of contact for teams and stakeholders.

* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript, Python, or similar, including experience with front-end and service development for high-volume applications.

* Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems, including security frameworks like OAuth and JWT and integration with cloud hosting environments.

* Familiarity with persistent storage technologies such as relational databases, document databases, caches, and database programming (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, schema design).

* Comfort working in an agile environment, managing team rituals, coordinating releases, and delivering continuous value across large or sophisticated systems.

* Strong problem-solving, analysis, and communication skills, with the ability to explain difficult concepts, negotiate different points of view, and influence technical direction.

* Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers, hold self and others accountable to commitments, and collaborate effectively as a team-oriented, customer-focused leader.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field of study, or equivalent work experience.

* Minimum 7 years of industry experience in software development or related work on large, scalable systems and high-scale environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience operating at scale in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP), including observability, performance monitoring, and reliability for 24/7 web applications.

* Background with server-side rendering web frameworks (such as Astro or Angular SSR) to ensure performant, accessible, and SEO-optimized experiences for Disney Parks websites.

* Exposure to AI-related tools or intelligent service integration, and a desire to further develop technical expertise in modern engineering tools and methodologies.

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, and/or relevant professional certifications in software engineering or cloud technologies.

title: AI/Software Engineer
description:
External Job Ad:

**AI Engineer / Software Engineer**

**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here**

Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for a Data Migration Manager to lead a team within our Data Services organization. This role is responsible for the people leadership, delivery oversight, and client-facing communication needed to ensure that customer data migrations from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products are executed seamlessly, on time, and with a high standard of quality and customer satisfaction.

**Job Summary**

In this role, you will design, build, and deploy Generative AI solutions—LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows—integrated with enterprise data and systems. Working alongside senior engineers and in close collaboration with product, engineering, and security partners, you’ll help deliver reliable, scalable, and safe GenAI capabilities, with a focus on evaluation, observability, and cost/latency performance in production.  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain RAG pipelines (document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing) using vector databases and AI-enabled search

* Implement safety and compliance guardrails (content filtering, prompt injection defenses, data access controls) and support red-teaming/testing of GenAI applications

* Document designs, prompts, evaluation results, and operational runbooks; contribute reusable components and code that the wider team can build on

-------------------------------

* BE/BTech in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

3–5 years of total experience as a software engineer, including hands-on experience building and shipping AI/ML and GenAI solutions (LLMs, RAG, prompt/tool calling) using Python. Good to have: Node, React, Terraform, Git, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes

* Programming skills in Python and experience building LLM applications using common frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph); familiarity with evaluation/testing frameworks is a plus

  

* Hands-on experience deploying GenAI applications on cloud platforms (GCP/Azure/AWS), including integration with managed LLM services and secure API patterns

  

* Experience with vector databases and retrieval systems (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch); exposure to LLMOps tooling for prompt/version management and evaluation is a plus

  

* Working knowledge of CI/CD and familiarity with observability for GenAI systems (quality/safety metrics, tracing, monitoring latency and cost)

  

* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence); ability to clearly communicate technical work and trade-offs to the team

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to debug GenAI issues (grounding gaps, hallucinations, prompt injection, retrieval quality) across application, data, and infrastructure layers

* Position requires a four-year degree from an accredited college or university.
* Fifteen + years or more of experience in designing and developing software applications in Java or Scala or at least ten years of experience in Java with master’s degree in computer science or related field.
* Three years or more of experience in managing 8 to 14 member cross functional team.
* Five years or more of experience in public cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure.

**Top candidates will also have:**

* Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities.
* Ability to cope with shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to effectively prioritize, delegate responsibilities and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Oversees performance of individual team members and team as whole. Identifies and addresses staff training and development needs.
* Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
* Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints.
    
  Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to provide guidance in applying the right architectural design pattern for the modernization of the applications by analysing the gaps between existing architecture and new business requirements.

**Proven experience in many of the following:**  

* Designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining software at scale.
* Application architectural patterns, such as MVC, Microservices, Event-driven, etc.
* Technical expertise in building a complex open-stack, microservices-based platform or product that is highly reliable, and scalable.
* Message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Apache ActiveMQ, Kinesis.
* Datastores such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL.
* Developing software applications using relational and NoSQL databases.
* Deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GoCD, Azure Devops etc.
* Working within an Agile framework (ideally Scrum).
* Researching data to support design decisions.
* Must demonstrate solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals like data structures and Algorithms.
* Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of ecommerce platforms like HCL Commerce (WCS) Version 8.0+ or equivalent; WebSphere Commerce subsystems - Trading, Catalog Management, Order Management, Member Management Sub-system, etc

* Must Have - Deep hands-on expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot.
* Nice to Have - Certifications in AWS/Azure, MongoDB/Redis.
* Nice to Have - Hands-on experience on React, Typescript, JavaScript frameworks.
* Nice to Have – BPMN/Workflow/Rules Engine technology like Camunda, Temporal, Drools.

description:

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. **Job Roles and Responsibilities**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand dealer order-planning, product-structure, interface, data, reporting, and operational-planning needs.
* Collect, analyze, document, and maintain business requirements, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and traceability for application changes.
* Assess enhancement requests and production issues, clarify business value and impact, and support backlog refinement with product and technical teams.
* Level 4 support for product incidents, service requests, data issues, and recurring defects; analyze application behavior, interfaces, logs, batch dependencies, and business impact to support root cause analysis.
* Coordinate development requests with developers, database teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity partners, and vendors; validate that fixes address the documented business need.
* Manage enhancements and code fixes from demand intake through implementation, including scope clarification, test planning, business validation, release readiness, and post-production verification.
* Develop functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance test scenarios; coordinate test execution, document evidence, manage defects, and confirm solution quality.
* Create and maintain application support procedures, interface inventories, data mappings, knowledge articles, and business continuity or recovery instructions.
* Facilitate communication between business and technical teams by translating business needs into clear solution requirements and technical issues into understandable business impacts and options.
* Identify opportunities for product modernization, process simplification, automation, improved controls, stronger monitoring, and reduced manual support effort.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, testers, vendors, and business users throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Candidates Will Have**

* Four-year bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, solution analysis, application support, product support, or technology delivery.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications and coordinating production incident, problem, change, and release activities.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate business-process, application, interface, and data issues.
* Experience developing test scenarios, coordinating user acceptance testing, managing defects, and validating production changes.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, interfaces, batch processing, and system integration or data-flow analysis.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences and manage work across global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong skills in accountability, organization, collaboration, customer focus, and managing priorities under time constraints.

**Top Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Sales & Operations Planning, dealer demand or order planning, order management, product configuration, bill of materials, or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of S&OP business processes, data structures, batch cycles, interfaces, controls, and downstream dependencies.
* Familiarity with C#/.NET and Python applications sufficient to support requirement analysis, issue triage, testing, and collaboration with developers.
* Experience with Oracle, Snowflake, Windows Server, FTP or secure file transfer, load-balanced applications, and operational-monitoring tools.
* Experience with Agile delivery methods, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or comparable work-management and service-management tools.
* Experience supporting application-security findings, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, and regression validation.
* Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends, validate business outcomes, define requirements, and support decision-making.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar planning, ordering, product-structure, and application-delivery processes is a plus.

**What You Will Have**

**Business Analysis:** Knowledge of methods for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business requirements; ability to translate stakeholder needs into actionable solution requirements and acceptance criteria.

**Core Application Systems:** Knowledge of production application systems used to support internal and external clients; ability to analyze application behavior, dependencies, interfaces, and business impacts.

**Analytical Thinking:** Knowledge of techniques and tools that support structured analysis; ability to interpret business processes and data, identify patterns, and distinguish root causes from symptoms.

**Application Delivery Process:** Knowledge of major delivery tasks, controls, and deliverables; ability to support requirements, testing, release readiness, implementation, and post-production validation.

**System and Technology Integration:** Knowledge of how applications, databases, batch jobs, file transfers, and technology platforms exchange information; ability to analyze and document end-to-end data flows.

**Software Quality Management:** Knowledge of test planning, traceability, defect management, regression testing, and acceptance practices; ability to confirm that delivered solutions meet business expectations.

**Problem Management:** Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis; ability to coordinate corrective and preventive actions for recurring operational issues.

**Information Security Technologies:** Knowledge of application-security concepts and remediation processes; ability to coordinate business-impact assessment, test planning, and validation for security-related changes.

**Stakeholder Management:** Ability to build effective relationships, facilitate decisions, communicate risks and dependencies, and align business and technical teams around clear outcomes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* DOP and Global BOM requirements are clear, complete, actionable, and traceable to business outcomes.
* WD 10 processing is monitored and validated, with timely coordination and transparent stakeholder communication when issues occur.
* Production issues are analyzed efficiently, business impact is understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Enhancements and fixes are thoroughly tested and released with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Application, interface, process, and support documentation remains accurate and usable.
* Business and IT teams work from a shared understanding of scope, priorities, risks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Continuous-improvement opportunities reduce recurring issues, manual effort, and operational risk.

**What You Will Get**

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar's employee resource groups across the globe
* Career development opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical, life, and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance through the annual incentive bonus plan

**Additional Information**

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. through the Caterpillar careers website. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities, are encouraged to apply.

Skill Descriptors  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

  
Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

  
Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

  
Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

  
System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

  
System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

  
Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.

* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
