title: Principal Software Engineer (Platform Engineering)
description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

This is a Principal position within the **Platform Engineering** organization. Our core mission is to build the foundational, core common layer across Saviynt engineering, consolidating and centralizing scattered platform tools, workflows, and infrastructure primitives. Wearing a dedicated **Platform Engineering hat**, this role will proactively find opportunities to eliminate operational friction and standardize capabilities into a seamless, unified developer experience.

A primary focus of this role is designing, developing, implementing, rolling out, and supporting our **Internal Developer Platform (IDP)**, fitting all foundational tooling into a cohesive, self-service ecosystem. You will build and implement "golden paths" for developers, creating self-serve platforms embedded with essential security and operational guardrails. Crucially, you will act as a partner across engineering—working closely with developers, Embedded SREs (E-SREs), and Central SRE teams—while actively evangelizing platform products to accelerate adoption throughout the organization.

### **WHAT YOU BRING**

* **12+ Years** of experience across the Software Development lifecycle with a focus on platform engineering, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Proven IDP build experience: you have shipped or significantly contributed to a Backstage or Port portal (or equivalent) used in production.
* Deep Kubernetes expertise across EKS and AKS, including multi-tenant cluster design, Helm, Kustomize, and Crossplane.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS fleet management, cell-based architectures, and ring/canary deployment strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or Python for building production-grade CLIs, custom operators, or platform backends.
* GitLab CI + ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts pipeline implementation experience—building CI/CD-as-a-service for engineering teams.
* Terraform / OpenTofu module authoring at scale—module registry design, state management, and refactoring large IaC codebases.
* Background in developing Backstage plugins or contributing to open-source developer platform ecosystems.
* Practical application of workload identity, SPIFFE/IRSA, and cloud-native zero-trust network architectures.
* Implementation of OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno for policy-as-code within production-grade Kubernetes clusters.
* Proficiency in FinOps methodologies and tools such as Kubecost or cloud cost exposure APIs.
* Experience managing Kafka or AWS MSK as a multi-tenant platform capability.
* Proven platform-first mindset with a history of centralizing scattered tooling into core foundation layers, evangelizing platform adoption, and collaborating effectively across developers, Embedded SREs, and Central SREs.
* Professional exposure to identity security frameworks, SaaS delivery, and high-compliance operational environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP).

### **WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

### **Internal Developer Platform (IDP) & Developer Portal**

* Take ownership of key aspects of the IDP architectural lifecycle, from service catalog creation to automated, self-service environment provisioning.
* Construct and manage a centralized developer hub featuring TechDocs, software catalogs, and seamless integrations with GitLab, Jira, and cloud management consoles.
* Develop and implement "golden-path" templates to rapidly deploy new microservices equipped with Kubernetes configurations, observability tools, and automated security guardrails.
* Champion and evangelize the adoption of platform products across engineering units using developer feedback, usage analytics, and active outreach.

### **Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Fleet Operations**

* Design and support cell-based deployment patterns and progressive ring-deployment strategies across multi-tenant and single-tenant customer fleets to isolate tenant workloads and limit blast radiuses.
* Automate continuous zero-downtime release deployments globally while providing platform abstractions that support multi-region SaaS deployments.

### **Platform-as-a-Service on Kubernetes**

* Design and supervise multi-tenant Kubernetes environments on AWS EKS and Azure AKS, ensuring a unified cluster management experience for internal users.
* Produce modular Helm libraries and infrastructure compositions that mask underlying cloud complexities for product development teams.
* Enforce robust isolation and access control policies that reflect our multi-tenancy security framework at the namespace level.
* Maintain high availability through automated cluster lifecycle operations, including seamless scaling and blue/green deployment rotations.

### **GitOps, CI/CD, and Delivery Infrastructure**

* Drive the evolution of CI/CD-as-a-service by providing standardized pipeline templates via GitLab CI and ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts for effortless team consumption.
* Deploy GitOps methodologies to establish default rollback capabilities, continuous drift detection, and transparent audit trails across environment workflows.
* Incorporate supply-chain security measures, such as container signing and SBOM creation, directly into our core delivery infrastructure.

### **API Gateway, Traffic Management & Edge Infrastructure**

* Manage edge, ingress, and service-to-service communication infrastructure (API gateways, service mesh), incorporating built-in mTLS, rate limiting, distributed tracing context propagation, and circuit breaking as platform primitives.
* Configure global load balancing and edge protection (CDN/WAF) as standardized defaults across developer paths.

### **Infrastructure Automation & IaC**

* Curate a centralized Terraform / OpenTofu registry for multi-cloud resources that adheres to stringent FinOps and security standards by default.
* Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning via Kubernetes-native workflows by implementing advanced provider compositions (Crossplane).
* Engineer custom Go-based CLI tools and operators to automate critical platform tasks, including cost tracking and credential rotation.

### **Platform Observability, FinOps & Resilience**

* Launch a unified observability suite using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to provide teams with essential self-service performance metrics.
* Establish logging and distributed tracing as foundational platform primitives, integrated automatically through standard developer paths.
* Create detailed FinOps reporting mechanisms and real-time cost anomaly guardrails to enable precise cloud expenditure attribution for teams and tenants.
* Integrate chaos testing and automated disaster recovery (DR) failover verification to meet strict enterprise SaaS uptime requirements.

### **Platform Security & Compliance Guardrails by Default**

* Integrate zero-trust principles and workload identity into the platform fabric using short-lived credentials and cloud-native network policies.
* Utilize policy-as-code (OPA, Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and admission controllers to enforce security standards at the cluster level without impeding development velocity.
* Streamline secrets management by providing a secure, automated, self-service platform capability.
* Build compliance-as-code into CI/CD pipelines to automatically generate audit trails and SBOM documentation required for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP certifications.

### **Event-Driven & Messaging Infrastructure**

* Manage shared messaging infrastructure systems like Kafka and AWS MSK, delivering topic provisioning and schema management as a robust platform service.
* Construct reusable patterns and scaffold templates that allow product teams to easily implement event-driven architectures from within the IDP.

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

  

***Security & Compliance***  
This role requires adherence to Saviynt’s information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training.  
  
***Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.***

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Power BI Developer
description:

Manager

title: Software Engineer Manager, Search Platforms, Search
description:

* 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems.
* 3 years of experience in a people management and 2 years of experience in a technical leadership role.

* Continuously evolve and support requirements gathering process and traceability flow.
* Actively coordinate with cross-functional engineering teams to meet customer's requirements and to drive complex issues to closure.

* Performance tuning of customer use-cases and functions on Drive OS software

**What we need to see:**

* BS/MS or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of overall experience and preferably with 4+ years of automotive industry experience.
* In-depth understanding of the d isplay software stack on Android and/or Linux including surface flinger, HW composer, DRM/KMS

* Strong understanding of QNX/Linux/Android operating system and hands-on experience with QNX/Linux device driver development
* Strong C/C++ programming and debugging skills
* In-depth understanding of ARM processor architecture fundamentals
* Background in embedded software development and deep knowledge of product development lifecycle.
* Exposure to functional safety architecture to meet ISO26262 standard would be a plus
* Effective written and verbal communication regardless of audience or issue complexity.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Extensive experience on developing/debugging complex device drivers on Linux/QNX OS
* Possess in-depth expertise in embedded system-level debugging, with a focus on resolving complex performance bottlenecks and stress-related failures

description:

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. Required technical and domain skills
  
- Expert understanding of distributed systems architecture, including domain-driven design, service decomposition, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, scalability, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, consistency models, disaster recovery, observability, and operational excellence.

- Strong engineering and architecture expertise across relational databases and document databases, including platform-scale data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, replication, migration strategies, data lifecycle management, and operational resilience.
  
- Deep experience leading cloud-native engineering initiatives encompassing containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, platform engineering, secure software supply chains, observability, reliability engineering, security architecture, upgrade strategies, and recovery mechanisms.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes.

- Experience modernizing large-scale ERP, enterprise business applications, batch-processing platforms, reporting platforms, or complex legacy systems. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are valuable context but are not required.
  
- Deep understanding of ERP, manufacturing, distribution, finance, supply-chain, commerce, or operational workflow domains, including platform modernization, migration, reconciliation, and business continuity.
  
- Experience leading platform engineering, SaaS infrastructure, cloud platform transformations, developer-experience initiatives, or internal platform product development.
  
- Experience designing extensible ecosystems, marketplace architectures, partner enablement platforms, metadata-driven platforms, migration factories, or highly configurable enterprise applications.
  
- Experience delivering regulated, highly available, enterprise-scale SaaS platforms with strong requirements for reliability, security, compliance, privacy, auditability, and operational governance.
  
- Experience influencing engineering organizations through architecture governance, technical strategy, technology roadmap definition, engineering excellence programs, and senior technical mentorship.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
- Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant ownership of architecture, platform strategy, distributed systems design, and cross-team technical leadership for large-scale cloud-native products.
  
- Demonstrated success leading major modernization, transformation, platform, or SaaS initiatives that span multiple teams, business domains, and technology stacks.
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  
- Recognized as a trusted technical leader capable of balancing customer outcomes, business priorities, engineering quality, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability.
  
Provide your feedback on BizChat
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- A small number of agreed architecture decisions and transition states guide delivery without blocking squads.
  
- Modern components and contracts reduce coupling, runtime dependency and support effort while preserving customer behaviour.
  
- Critical releases and migration waves have repeatable quality, observability and rollback evidence.
  
- Engineers make more decisions locally because standards, examples and mentoring are clear.
  
Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Architects, Product Management, Engineering Managers, Principal and Senior Engineers, Automation, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services, partners and Europe/North America domain experts. India delivery is a first-class ownership centre with planned Europe/North America overlap and clear hand-offs across time zones.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Acts as a calm technical role model, makes uncertainty visible, develops talent and chooses the simplest safe path that improves customer and business outcomes.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Own cross-squad technical strategy for a significant modernisation outcome, from current-state discovery through a viable transition state and measurable exit criteria.
  
- Make and record decisions on domain boundaries, GraphQL contracts, componentisation, data-path simplification and legacy-runtime reduction.
  
- Lead difficult implementation, incident, performance and migration problems; decide when to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire a capability.
  
- Set engineering standards for secure coding, testing, observability, deployment, upgrades and rollback, and ensure they are adopted rather than merely documented.
  
- Coach senior and developing engineers, grow technical leadership in India and across the distributed squad network, and challenge designs constructively.
  
Decision ownership:
  
Technical direction within the assigned portfolio, cross-squad trade-offs, exception escalation, transition-state design and acceptance of engineering evidence. Escalates product, legal, security or commercial policy decisions with a clear recommendation.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

**What You Will Have**

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep hands‑on experience with Dynamics 365 F&O modules (Finance, Supply Chain, Project Operations).
* Expert‑level knowledge of X++ development, SSRS reporting, and D365 F&O layered architecture.
* Strong understanding of customization, configuration, and upgrade‑safe extensions.

**Tools & Frameworks**

* Skilled in integration strategies using OData, REST/SOAP APIs, AIF/DMF, and Azure services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory).
* Experience with Common Data Services (Dual Write) for integration with Dynamics 365 Sales, Field Service, and Project Operations.
* Knowledge of SQL Server Management Studio, DMF tools, and ETL techniques for data migration.
* Hands‑on experience with Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and AI‑driven workflows for automation.

**DevOps & Environment Management**

* Expertise in Azure DevOps: Git, pipelines, CI/CD, release management, and test plans.
* Skilled in environment management, version control (GITHUB), and branching strategies.
* Experience managing build, release, and deployment activities across Dev/UAT/Prod environments.
* Familiarity with Lifecycle Services (LCS) and Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC).

**Considerations for Top Candidates**

* **Advanced Debugging Skills** – Ability to troubleshoot complex X++ code issues, identify root causes, and implement optimized fixes without impacting upgrade safety.
* **Database Proficiency** – Strong knowledge of SQL Server, indexing strategies, query optimization, and handling large transactional datasets within D365 F&O.
* **Testing Automation** – Experience building automated test scripts (e.g., using Python or other frameworks) to validate customizations, integrations, and performance benchmarks.
* **API Development & Management** – Skilled in designing custom APIs, managing authentication/authorization flows, and ensuring secure data exchange between F&O and external systems.

Preferred exposure to **Leapwork**, Azure App Testing, **Playwright**, with accepted proficiency in JMeter, Ranorex, Selenium, or equivalent platforms to validate customizations, integrations, and performance across Finance, Supply Chain, Retail & Commerce & Project Operations modules.

The U.S. healthcare industry is a massive and essential sector, valued at $4.4 trillion. It offers
  
around 1.8 million job openings in the healthcare tech industry annually. This reflects the
  
industry's vast opportunities and the growing need for technological advancements.

party integrations, HealthEdge tackles unique problems at an extraordinary scale daily. We
  
support 48 out of 50 states in the U.S.
  
Innovative Transformation: Founded in 2005, HealthEdge is transitioning from a monolithic

step at a time.

through innovative technology solutions. We hope you're as excited as we are to take on this
  
challenge and make a significant impact in the healthcare sector.

HealthEdge is looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer who is passionate about solving
  
real-world business problems to join our team. As a Senior member of the team, you will be
  
working on developing solutions that help our customers integrate with our product suite. You
  
will be working as a problem solver with plenty of unique assignments within the department.

frontend, and working heavily with the database and J2EE/integration technologies.

You'll work largely solo, moving fast between ideas, working prototype, and production deployment, while integrating with real enterprise systems (SSO, mailboxes, databases, cloud infrastructure) that don't forgive sloppy assumptions.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Take a business need directly from a stakeholder (a team lead, an exec, a support team) and turn it into a working Next.js/React app without a formal spec or a dedicated developer team.
* Direct AI coding agents build features, then verify their output against how the system actually behaves — not just whether it compiles.
* Integrate with enterprise identity and data systems: SSO (Cognito + Entra), Microsoft Graph (mailbox/calendar access), shared internal database APIs, cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock)
* Own deployment: CI/CD pipelines, containerized deploys, environment configuration — enough infra literacy to read a failed pipeline and fix it yourself
* Debug production issues by building your own diagnostics (an admin page, a probe endpoint) rather than waiting on someone else's logs
* Recognize the boundary between "I can fix this myself" and "this needs IT/platform team” and write a clear, specific ask when it's the later, instead of thrashing on a workaround
* Test in production and iterate from real usage rather than over-planning up front
* Keep documentation current enough that the next person (or the next AI session) doesn't have to rediscover what you already figured out

**What You Bring**

**Technical**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field with minimum 5-6 years of relative experience
* Full-stack web development: React/Next.js, TypeScript, REST APIs
* Cloud fundamentals: AWS IAM, ECS/containers, CloudFormation basics — enough to reason about who owns what permission
* Enterprise auth: OAuth/OIDC, SSO integration (Cognito, Entra ID)
* SQL / relational data modeling, working within a shared/managed database rather than standing up your own
* Git/GitLab, CI/CD pipeline literacy

AI-assisted development ("vibe coding") specifically

* Fluency directing AI coding agents to build real, deployed software — not just toy scripts
* The judgment to catch when an AI's output is subtly wrong (e.g., an IAM policy written for the wrong model version) rather than shipping it as-is
* Comfortable debugging by reading actual system behavior (live API calls, logs, diagnostics) instead of guessing
* Knows the difference between a code problem and an infrastructure/permissions problem — and doesn't burn cycles trying to code around the latter

**Working style**

* Direct communicator — wants the one-sentence answer, not a hedge
* Ships fast, tests in prod, iterates from what breaks
* Comfortable being both the builder and the product owner for what you ship
* Persistent through ambiguous, multi-day infrastructure blockers without losing momentum on everything else

**Nice to have**

* Design-system awareness (brand consistency, accessibility)
* Experience building analytics/reporting features (charting, data taxonomies, dedup pipelines)
* Comfort coordinating directly with IT/platform teams on access and permissions requests
* Candidate will be required to work with USA team and should be comfortable working on US time zones

title: WhatsApp - Software Engineer - Product Generalist
description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done — people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go — staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation.As a full-stack product engineer at WhatsApp you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set direction for a team's technical area, lead major initiatives end to end, and be one of the people the pillar relies on to make the right engineering trade-offs under real ambiguity.  
  
  

### **WhatsApp - Software Engineer - Product Generalist Responsibilities:**

* Build end-to-end product features across client and server, from product definition through rollout and launch.
* Develop reusable software components and APIs for interfacing with back-end platforms, including payments and third-party service integrations.
* Work across a variety of coding languages and technologies, moving to wherever the problem is rather than staying inside one layer of the stack.
* Set direction and goals for a team, lead major initiatives and drive them to completion across functions.
* Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications, and make the engineering trade-offs a 0-to-1 effort demands.
* Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt.
* Establish ownership of significant components, features or systems with expert end-to-end understanding.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, help onboard new team members and raise the engineering bar in the team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in product management, design, data science and operations to build innovative application experiences.
* Partner with payments, legal, compliance and local operations partners to ship services that meet the reliability and regulatory bar expected in India.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language, or 4+ years of experience with a PhD
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building large-scale applications or similar experience
* Experience in programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Swift or Kotlin, and scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript or Hack
* Experience with API integrations, and exposure to architectural patterns of large-scale software applications
* Experience building for the Indian market, including familiarity with UPI and India's digital payments ecosystem
* In-market experience in India, or experience at an India-based consumer technology or fintech company operating at scale
* Experience building payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry
* Background in monetization, payments, commerce or AI/ML products
* Experience building 0-to-1 products or standing up new product areas
* Experience with global, multi-market products, particularly in emerging markets
* Experience working with teams distributed across multiple sites
* Familiarity with messaging platforms or mobile-first consumer products
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Software Development Engineer 5
description:
**Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer**
------------------------------------

### **Position Summary**

As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation—creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster.

You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX’s data platform remains a competitive advantage.

Is this role for you?

* YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems.
* NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture.

### **Responsibilities**

* Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e.g., Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level.
* Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate.
* Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e.g., specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency.
* Global Governance & Security: Architect "compliance-by-design" systems. Automate data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity.
* Engineering Excellence & Influence: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will lead Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks.
* Organizational Mentorship: Beyond individual mentoring, you will foster an "Engineering Community," influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years in a principal or staff-level capacity leading platform-scale initiatives.

**Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus):**

* Strong Software Foundations: Strong fundamentals on software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design).
* Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and python. We are looking for a developer who writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts.
* Data as a Product: Experience building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves.

**Data Lakehouse Mastery:**

* Deep internal knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies).
* Experience contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e.g., Spark, dbt).

**Cloud & Infrastructure:**

* Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks.

**AI-Driven Development & Productivity:**

* AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures.
* LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to architect the infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration.

**Leadership & Vision:**

* Proven track record of "leading by influence"—driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams.
* Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e.g., "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and junior engineers alike.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Full Stack Software Engineer to join the WEX Mobility Engineering team. In this role, you will design and build scalable APIs, backend services, and data pipelines that power our next-generation fleet and payments platforms. You’ll work on Moving Legacy Financial systems (ERP) to Microservice based Hybrid system and operational insights — all while modernizing legacy workflows into cloud-ready architectures.

You’ll collaborate with a cross-functional team to develop secure, maintainable software in a DevOps environment, utilizing modern event-driven and microservices architectures. This role offers an opportunity to influence and implement technical strategy while working alongside experts in APIs, Kafka, Python, and cloud technologies.

**How you’ll make an impact**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain robust full-stack solutions with an emphasis on APIs, microservices, Kafka and backend systems.
* Work with streaming data, including real-time event processing using Kafka or similar technologies.
* Build automation for Change Data Capture (CDC) and data synchronization pipelines using JSON-based services.
* Participate in agile ceremonies and own the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality software.
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior developers.
* Troubleshoot and resolve critical production issues as needed.

**Experience you’ll bring**

* BS in computer science or related fields
* 6 years+ hands-on experience developing applications/microservices with Java/Python/Kafka.
* 3 years+ hands-on experience with REST API development.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in backend languages such as Python, Java, or Node.js.
* Experience designing and building RESTful APIs.
* Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka or similar event streaming platforms, SMS and Dead letter Queues.
* Strong knowledge of Change Data Capture (CDC) strategies and implementation.
* Familiarity with JSON, XML, and other data interchange formats.
* Solid understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle, Snowflake).
* Experience working in Unix/Linux environments and scripting (e.g., shell, Python).
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and source control tools (e.g., Git).

**Nice to Have (Bonus Qualifications)**

* Exposure to Financial Platforms like (PeopleSoft, EBS,SAP) - including APIs and integration workflows.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
* Familiarity with Peoplesoft Tools and Web Services.
* Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud-native services.
* Experience with large-scale transaction or payments systems.
* Familiarity with modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js).
* Knowledge of tools like JIRA, Confluence, and design documentation best practices.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Strong sense of ownership, with a passion for solving complex engineering challenges.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across teams and time zones.
* Ability to break down large initiatives into shippable, iterative technical deliverables.
* Eagerness to work in a fast-paced, evolving tech environment.
* A focus on building maintainable, scalable, and secure software.

title: WhatsApp - Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) - Product Generalist
description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done — people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go — staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation.As a full-stack product engineer at WhatsApp you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set technical direction across multiple teams, own the architecture for a major area of the product, and shape what WhatsApp Services becomes in India.  
  
  

### **WhatsApp - Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) - Product Generalist Responsibilities:**

* Build end-to-end product features across client and server, from product definition through rollout and launch.
* Develop reusable software components and APIs for interfacing with back-end platforms, including payments and third-party service integrations.
* Work across a variety of coding languages and technologies, moving to wherever the problem is rather than staying inside one layer of the stack.
* Identify and solve the hardest technical problems across the pillar, including finding where new technology can address previously intractable problems.
* Set technical direction across multiple teams and own the architecture for a major area of the product.
* Lead initiatives of org-wide scope, resolving ambiguity in both product definition and technical approach.
* Drive engineering standards, quality and craft across the pillar, and make teams and systems work better to increase their impact.
* Mentor senior engineers, influence cross-functional partners in product, design and data science, and act as a credible co-owner of product outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in product management, design, data science and operations to build innovative application experiences.
* Partner with payments, legal, compliance and local operations partners to ship services that meet the reliability and regulatory bar expected in India.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 8+ years experience with a PhD
* Experience communicating and working across functions to drive solutions
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
* Experience driving large cross-functional/industry-wide engineering efforts
* Proven track record of planning multi-year roadmap in which short-term projects ladder to the long-term mission
* Experience mentoring/influencing executive stakeholders across organizations

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building large-scale applications or similar experience
* Experience in programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Swift or Kotlin, and scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript or Hack
* Experience with API integrations, and exposure to architectural patterns of large-scale software applications
* Experience building for the Indian market, including familiarity with UPI and India's digital payments ecosystem
* In-market experience in India, or experience at an India-based consumer technology or fintech company operating at scale
* Experience designing and operating payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry
* Background in monetization, payments, commerce or AI/ML products
* Experience establishing the technical foundations of a 0-to-1 organization or a new product area
* Experience setting technical strategy for global, multi-market products, particularly in emerging markets
* Experience as a technical leader across distributed teams in multiple sites
* Familiarity with messaging platforms or mobile-first consumer products, including super-app or founder-led product experience in market
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

description:
Meet the Team
  
Our Routing SD-WAN Group is at the forefront of innovation, delivering intelligent, secure, and scalable WAN edge solutions that empower enterprises to connect and protect their networks from the edge to the cloud. Within this group, the Routing Platform Software team builds industry-leading headend SD-WAN and edge routing platforms. We are a high-energy group working on next-generation routing and services at a global scale, connecting thousands of devices and millions of users.
  
  
Your Impact
  
We are looking for a software engineer to develop and evolve the forwarding and platform software that powers SD-WAN and edge routing. In this role, you will collaborate with ASIC, hardware, and cross-functional engineering teams to define new architectures, implement high-performance packet forwarding, and deliver robust, production-ready features. You will leverage modern AI tools to enhance software development practices, helping to drive greater efficiency, quality, and innovation across the team.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with hardware engineering teams to bring up new platforms, develop low-level drivers, and integrate Network Interface Modules (NIMs).
* Firmware Development: Design, implement, and maintain ROMMON and bootloader software to ensure secure and reliable system initialization.
* Forwarding Plane Optimization: Develop and tune high-performance forwarding plane software to meet the rigorous demands of modern secure routing environments.
* Performance Debugging: Perform deep-dive analysis into performance bottlenecks at the kernel and hardware-abstraction layers, including the control plane.
* Modern Development Practices: Utilize modern development workflows, including AI-assisted coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Codex) and integrated development environments like VSCode, to accelerate the development lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 4-8 years of industry experience with end-to-end software development in networking, including platforms, system software, kernel/user-space drivers, bootloaders, and BIOS.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ with a focus on systems programming and Linux environments.
* Proven experience in developing device drivers and working with RTOS/Linux kernels.
* Solid understanding of routing architectures and Layer 2/Layer 3 networking protocols (e.g., Ethernet, VLANs, STP).
* Experience with bootloaders (ROMMON), hardware bring-up, and board support packages (BSP).

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Knowledge of high-speed interfaces (PHY, MAC, MACSEC) and DPDK.
* Debugging experience with hardware interfaces (i2c, PCIe) and hardware/software debuggers (e.g., GDB, Arium, BDI).
* Knowledge of x86 or ARM assembly code, instruction sets, and ABIs.
* Experience with AI/ML techniques and tools for development (e.g., code assistants, static analysis tools, test automation platforms).
* Strong collaborative skills and the ability to debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, and software layers.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to team:**

Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.

The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.

We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.

  

As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
description:
**Netradyne** harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

**Role Summary**

The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents.

* Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation.

* Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans.

* Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership.

* Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals.

* Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions.

* Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings.

* Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails.

* Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team.

* Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams).

* Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting.

* Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect.

* Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents.

* Lead investigation of complex production issues that cross application, database, network and cloud layers, and drive lasting fixes.

* Plan sprints and roadmaps with engineering leadership: break down work, manage dependencies, track delivery and report progress with team metrics.

* Make sure critical knowledge is written down: design documents, runbooks and ownership maps for every system the team runs.

* Mentor and grow engineers through design guidance, code reviews and career coaching.

* Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding for the Infra teams.

**Essential Skills**

* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience building infrastructure, platform, DevOps or SRE software at scale.

* Expert programming skills in Python and/or Go, with a strong record of production-quality code and code review.

* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, networking, IAM, storage, databases, messaging and billing, including multi-account and multi-cluster environments.

* Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and the cloud-native ecosystem: Helm, Argo CD, Crossplane, service networking and autoscaling.

* Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Terragrunt or equivalent) and designing reusable modules and golden paths.

* Strong experience designing CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment strategies across multiple environments.

* Strong understanding of distributed systems: reliability, fault tolerance, idempotency, retries and capacity planning.

* Strong understanding of database operations and internals for relational and NoSQL data stores.

* Experience with cloud cost management, including cost data pipelines, cost allocation and commitment-based discounts.

* Proven ability to determine methods and approaches on new, loosely defined assignments and to evaluate trade-offs across many variables.

* Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building LLM agents and AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Strands or LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, agent observability).

* Experience building internal developer platforms or platform-engineering products used by many teams.

* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry or the ELK stack.

* Experience with Snowflake, data warehouses and forecasting or anomaly detection techniques (e.g., Prophet, regression models).

* Experience with IoT or device platforms and large-scale data ingestion.

* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Act as the senior technical leader and approver for Infra-Dev, and own team goals for its tactical business targets.

* Support the decisions and goals of the wider Infrastructure function (DevOps, Database and Infra-Dev); your work is reviewed on completion.

* Understand how infrastructure, application engineering, security and finance depend on one another, and design solutions that work across them.

* Direct how existing engineering principles are applied in Infra-Dev, and guide the development of new infrastructure policies and standards.

* Build a culture of engineering quality, ownership, automation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Typically requires 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years with a Master's degree, or a PhD with 3+ years of experience.

description:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

**General Summary:**

Job Title: Engineer BTSW-HOST

Department Name & No.: 50736 - WRD Tech QuIC Tech BT Host SW - BDC

Available to New or Recent Graduate: No

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* At least 3-6 years’ experience in embedded SW development using the C programming language for Wireless connectivity products

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth host stack.

* Understanding of Bluetooth controller transports and arbitration, including UART, SPI/I3C or comparable inter-processor/controller interfaces.

* Experience integrating Bluetooth audio and connectivity services, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, LE Audio, audio routing, and session control.

* Familiarity with Bluetooth SIG qualification, specification interpretation, interoperability events, and contribution to standards or technical working groups.

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

* **Educational Requirements:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics or Computer Science from an internationally recognized institution.

  

**Keywords:** C Programming, Bluetooth host Protocols, Bluetooth Profiles, LE Audio (LEA), BT, Sniffer, Air logs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

* 1+ year of experience with Database Management Software.

* 1+ year of experience with API.

* 1+ year of work experience with Git, Perforce, or Source Code Management System.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Applies Software knowledge to assist and support the design, development, creation, modification, and validation of embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs.

* Analyzes user needs and software requirements.

* Designs and implements small software features for products and systems.

* Participates in the design, coding for small features, unit testing, minor debugging fixes, and integration efforts to ensure projects are completed on schedule.

* Assists in performing code reviews and regression tests as well as the triaging of issues to ensure the quality of code.

description:

With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and transparency.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.

  
  
  

**Role Description:**

  

This is a great opportunity for a hands-on DevOps Engineers or Infrastructure Cloud Engineers with experience in cloud platforms (GCP). You will be tasked with transforming business requirements into robust cloud infrastructure solutions which forms the underlying foundation for all distributed systems and applications of the LSE Group.

  

As a Cloud Platform Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), you will support and enhance our cloud environment, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and cost-efficiency. This role involves close collaboration with various teams to drive cloud adoption and implement GCP standard methodologies.

  

**Main Responsibilities:**

  

GCP Infrastructure Design and Implementation:

* Implement scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure using GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, and Interconnect.

* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and YAML configuration files.

  
  

Security and Compliance

* Apply GCP security best practices including IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud KMS, and Organization Policies.

  
  

Automation and DevOps Integration

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab pipelines.

* Automate deployments and infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and GitOps practices.

  

Networking and Hybrid Connectivity

* Manage VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules and policies, Cloud NAT, and Private Google Access.

* Implement networking features such as VPC Peering, Shared VPC, VPN, and Cloud Interconnect.

  
  

Agile Practices and Teamwork Tools

* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives).

* Use Jira for task tracking and Confluence for documentation and teamwork.

  
  

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

* Stay current with GCP innovations and evaluate new services for potential adoption.

* Propose and implement improvements to enhance performance, security, and developer experience.

  
  

**Required Skills:**

  

Experience

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience with GCP services.

  
  

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of GCP services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Interconnect, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Network Connectivity Center (NCC), Workload Identity Federation (WIF).

* Experience with Terraform and YAML for Infrastructure as Code.

* Networking knowledge: VPC design, VPN, Cloud NAT, Interconnect, Peering, firewall rules and policies.

* Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (GKE).

* Experience with Python for various applications.

* Experience with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodologies.

  
  

Certifications

* Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer or other relevant GCP certifications.

  
  

Soft Skills

* Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

* Communication and collaboration abilities.

* Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon Detail Page
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Detail Page is where Amazon customers decide what to buy. Every day, hundreds of millions of shoppers land on a product page to discover, evaluate and compare products and offers on mobile, desktop and app, and this surface drives the majority of purchase decisions on Amazon. The Detail Page team builds that experience, along with the platform that lets hundreds of partner teams across Amazon ship features to the page safely and quickly. We are reinventing how the page is built, moving to a modern federated architecture and making AI agents a first-class part of how we design, test and ship software.  
  
As an SDE II, you will own the design and delivery of significant features and services on one of Amazon's highest-traffic pages, where every millisecond of latency and every point of availability matters to customers. You will work on real distributed-systems problems at a scale few places can offer, see your code reach customers worldwide within days, and help shape the technical direction of a page that nearly every Amazon shopper sees. If you love building for customers at massive scale and want your work to matter on day one, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build and own features and services end to end, from requirements and design through launch and operations.
* Build for scale, writing high-quality, well-tested code that is fast, reliable and safe to deploy on a tier-1 customer surface.
* Improve latency, availability and operational health, and take part in on-call, especially through peak events like Prime Day.
* Partner with Product, UX and partner teams across Amazon to turn ambiguous ideas into shipped, measurable customer experiences, and use experiments to prove impact.
* Contribute to the evolution of the Detail Page architecture, and use AI-native tools and agents to speed up development, testing and operations.
* Review designs and code, mentor junior engineers, and help raise the engineering bar across the team.

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
