Joining Maersk will embark you on a transformational journey with great opportunities for career development within a global organization. As a Senior OSS Engineer, you will design, engineer and run our capabilities for the Operational Support Systems (OSS) and Tools stack for network and perimeter products and platforms that enable highly distributed global business for site, fleet, asset and IoT connectivity, required to deliver against our strategy. You will be exposed to a wide and challenging range of needs and opportunities requiring you to engage closely with stakeholders across all levels within Maersk as you mature and evolve our OSS capabilities for Network OSS to become world class.


**The Brief**

A globally focused shipping and transportation organisation is continuing to drive an ambitious and complex change and transformational programme to deliver a service of excellence for its customers and clients worldwide. The Global CTIO has a mandate from the Maersk board to lead the Technology transformation of Maersk which will enable the Maersk business strategy to become the global integrator of container logistics through digitising the Maersk business processes and customer engagement.


The Technology Function is fundamental to enable the company’s transformation and in response to this demand, our in\-house technological capability is growing exponentially. We are recruiting world class talent to ensure that the technology services are modernised to enable Maersk to become a logistics integrator leveraging a competitive advantage through technology.


**Why this job matters?** 

The Network OSS Engineering function is essential to our transformation, it is a central team within Network Architecture \& Engineering, responsible for the delivery of product roadmaps, technical vision and quality across Fulfilment and Assurance that underpin our network and perimeter capabilities and products.


Reporting to the Senior OSS Engineering Manager you will serve as a Senior OSS Engineer, ensuring that our systems and tools for the network OSS realise business value. Your role is responsible for technical design and delivery of solutions across the network OSS applications landscape from monitoring to analytics driven AIOps. All built to industry leading standards and running seamlessly across various cloud and on\-prem platforms, allowing frictionless and seamless operations of our network and perimeter platforms.


It has a critical role to play as we continue to develop our long\-term multi\-technology and multi\-product network and perimeter capabilities, connecting our asset, sites and people on land and at sea. Delivering best in class software and tooling that not only meet the need of our business today but will be a differentiator, enabling our colleagues and partners with technology solutions that are a catalyst for productivity and innovation.


**Scope**

All data networks provided to Maersk across Core, Edge and Cloud locations (offices, warehouses, terminals, vessels, data centres, cloud etc), and the perimeter services that protect and enable them including but not limited to:


* Wireless Transport: Satellite \| 4G/LTE \| 5G
* IoT Networking Solutions: Industrial Wi\-Fi
* WAN: Internet \| IP/MPLS \| Next\-Gen/SD WAN
* LAN: DC Networking \| SDN \| Fixed \& Wireless
* Perimeter: Load balancers \| NG Firewalls \| Security Service Edge

**Specific Job Requirements**

The role holder shall possess a solid understanding of DevOps tooling, GitOps, CI/CD, config management, Jenkins, build pipelines and source control systems and have a working knowledge of cloud infrastructure services: compute, storage, networking, hybrid connectivity, monitoring/logging, security and IAM.


Collaborate with stakeholders and Business Analysts to gather, document and understand requirements. Articulate functional and non\-functional requirements to business and technical stakeholders.


Product mindset and passion about building for internal stakeholders and external customers.


Work with product owners to prioritize features for ongoing sprints and implement features based on service line demand, industry trends, known defects, and issues.


To be a successful technologist at Maersk, you must be passionate about building, enabling and sustaining our business, as well as inspiring and developing our people. Further, in this role you will:


* Be a world class expert in the OSS domain, implementing the defined architectural roadmap for Network tooling for the Maersk Group.
* Support delivery and program management with estimations and planning.
* Validate all the Non\-Functional requirements and provide inputs to the applications team on capacity exercise.
* Practice TDD and follow best practices.
* Produce high\-quality, clean and performant code.
* Implement and publish APIs for ecosystem clients to consume platform services in a consistent way.
* Adopt a product mindset and passion about building for internal and external ecosystem.

What I'll be doing – your accountabilities?


**Software Engineering** – Build and integrate applications in the OSS ecosystem. Engineering of the software tools to drive Fulfilment and Assurance OSS capability to underpin all networking and perimeter services across Core, Edge and Cloud. To be considered for this opportunity the candidate needs to have following technical qualifications:


* Expertise in building/troubleshooting and debugging containerized applications using Kubernetes using microservices concepts like observability and scalability.
* Excellent experience and knowledge of Java 17\+. Well versed with Spring boot.
* TDD with Unit Testing (such as Junit or Mockito) and Integration Testing.
* Strong experience with Python, API development and testing tools such as Postman, and automation scripting, with the ability to develop production\-ready services, integrations and proofs of concept for observability, AIOps and agentic AI use cases.
* Hands\-on experience with microservices, container and cloud technologies, ingress controllers, API gateways, PromQL and LogQL.
* SRE Exposure an advantage. Experience defining service KPIs, SLIs and SLOs using open\-source observability tooling such as Prometheus, Mimir, Grafana, Loki and ELK, together with instrumentation, telemetry and log analytics.
* Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL, Streaming (Kafka) and large\-scale batch processing
* Experience with frontend technologies like react/angular etc. is desirable
* Solid experience in DevOps tooling, GitOps, CI/CD, config management, build pipelines and source control systems
* Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs and integrating platforms through webhooks and event\-driven interfaces.
* Experience monitoring application performance, resolving production issues and operating services using SRE practices.
* Comfortable working in agile methodologies (ideally Scrum)

description:

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Your Role**

**The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in COBOL\-based legacy systems and hands\-on experience developing enterprise Java applications. This role will focus on analyzing, converting, and modernizing mainframe applications from COBOL to Java while ensuring business functionality, performance, and data integrity are maintained.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**The candidate will collaborate with architects, business analysts, modernization specialists, and testing teams to deliver scalable, maintainable, and cloud\-ready solutions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Analyze existing COBOL, JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2, and batch applications to understand business processes and technical dependencies.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Convert and refactor legacy COBOL code into modern Java\-based applications.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Translate business logic from mainframe systems into Java microservices and enterprise applications.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Design, develop, test, and deploy Java applications using modern frameworks and design patterns.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Participate in application modernization and digital transformation initiatives.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work closely with business users and SMEs to validate functionality and ensure business continuity.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify opportunities to optimize converted code rather than performing straightforward code translation.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop integration solutions between modern Java applications and legacy systems when required.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Create technical documentation, mapping documents, and conversion guidelines.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production deployment activities.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Troubleshoot and resolve issues arising during migration and post\-migration support.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  



Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well\-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications.You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non\-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a Senior Project Manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of project manager roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.  



  

**Who You Are**

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  

  



**Required skills and experience**
----------------------------------

**Experience**
--------------

* **5\-10 years of software development experience using Java language.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **2\+ years of Mainframe development experience.**
--------------------------------------------------
* **Hands\-on experience in COBOL\-to\-Java transformation or application modernization projects.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience analyzing large\-scale legacy applications and translating business logic into modern architectures.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

**Basic knowledge**
-------------------

* **COBOL**
---------
* **JCL**
-------
* **CICS**
--------
* **VSAM**
--------
* **DB2**
-------
* **IMS**
-------
* **Mainframe batch processing**
------------------------------
* **z/OS environment**
--------------------

**Java Technologies**
---------------------

* **Java 8/11/17\+**
------------------
* **Spring Boot**
---------------
* **Spring Framework**
--------------------
* **REST APIs**
-------------
* **Microservices Architecture**
------------------------------

**Cloud \& DevOps (Preferred)**
-------------------------------

* **Azure, AWS, or GCP**
----------------------
* **Docker**
----------
* **Kubernetes**
--------------
* **Git**
-------
* **Jenkins/Azure DevOps**
------------------------
* **CI/CD pipelines**
-------------------

**Preferred skills and experience**
-----------------------------------

* **Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.**
* **Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.**

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Principal Software Engineer (Java & Agentic AI)
description:
*Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats.* *Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. They are constrained by speed, clarity, and confidence. Securonix was built to close that gap. Our mission is to enable security teams to decide and act faster across the entire threat lifecycle.*

  

*The Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is the industry’s first platform powered by agentic AI and designed with a human\-in\-the\-loop philosophy. It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real\-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team.*

  

*Built cloud\-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real\-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. The result is a CyberOps experience that scales as threats evolve.*

  

*Securonix is recognized as a six\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and a Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights. The company has been featured by leading publications including WIRED, Dark Reading, and Fortune for its innovation and leadership in security operations. Organizations rely on the platform for always\-available data, rapid search and investigation, continuously updated threat content, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response experience.*

  

*Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s leading enterprise software investors, Securonix benefits from deep operational expertise and a long\-term commitment to innovation and growth. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale the platform, accelerate product execution, and support customers as their security needs evolve.*

  

*With more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. Our ecosystem of partners and managed security service providers extends that reach, helping organizations deploy and operate with confidence wherever they do business. What drives us is how we work.*

  

* *We win as one team. We operate with trust, respect, and shared accountability.*
* *We are customer driven. Innovation is guided by real security challenges and measurable outcomes.*
* *We act with agility. Change is constant, and we stay aligned on purpose while adapting fast.*

  

  

*That focus is how Securonix helps organizations move from reactive security to proactive, autonomous operations.*

  

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Principal Software Developer to lead our software development initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining advanced cybersecurity solutions. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable software that meets the highest standards of quality and performance.

 **Responsibilities:**

  

* Lead the design and development of complex software solutions for cybersecurity applications.
* Oversee and mentor a team of software developers, providing technical guidance and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with product managers, security analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Develop and maintain high\-quality code, ensuring adherence to best practices and coding standards.
* Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends in cybersecurity, integrating new tools and techniques into development processes as appropriate.
* Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, ensuring timely delivery of fixes and updates.
* Participate in the architecture and design of scalable and secure software systems.
* Contribute to the development of technical documentation, including design specifications, user guides, and API documentation.

  


**Required Skills:**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on cybersecurity solutions.
* Proven experience in a leadership role, managing and mentoring software development teams.
* Expertise in Java and Microservices Architecture
* Deep understanding of software development methodologies, including Agile and DevOps practices.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to think critically and strategically.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile development environments
* Experience with Java build tools, such as Maven or Gradle
* Good Knowledge on AI Tools \& Agent Integration Experience.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD development lifecycle. Hands\-on experience with GIT version control (Github/Bitbucket/GitLab).
* Experience with Java build tools, such as Maven or Gradle
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and JSON
* Experience with testing frameworks and libraries, such as JUnit, Mockito, or TestNG
* Knowledge of microservices architecture and containerization technologies, such as Docker or Kubernetes
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
* Good problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Experience working in Agile development environments
* Willingness to upskill in Laravel/PHP, IaC, SaaS Environment concepts and queue\-based architecture.

title: Reporting Application Developer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Power BI \& Reporting Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and data models for business and executive audiences.
* Build DAX measures, calculated columns, and KPI logic; implement Row\-Level Security (RLS) and report governance policies.
* Publish and manage reports via Power BI Service, including workspace management, scheduled refresh, and deployment pipelines.
* Develop SSRS paginated reports for operational or regulatory use cases requiring pixel\-perfect formatting.

**Data Platform Awareness \& SQL Development**

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B\+ business and one of the fastest\-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.  

  

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.  

  

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off\-the\-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.  

  

We're an AI\-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and own software end to end — working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
* Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
* Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
* Own operational excellence for what you build — monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
* Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.

  

A day in the life  

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday\-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.  

  

About the team  

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast\-moving group solving open\-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Senior SCALA Developer
description:
About This Role
**4 to 8 years of experience**  

**Skills: SCALA**

**Overview**
------------


The client uses the Scala Digital Signage platform in a highly customized manner. While Scala's networking, player\-management, publishing, and status capabilities are generally used as designed, most of the content displayed on screen is generated programmatically. Scala's native content\-authoring tools provide the presentation shell, while custom Python software controls much of the actual content, behavior, event processing, and external\-system interaction.


An engineer supporting this environment must first understand how to design, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot an enterprise\-scale digital signage system. This includes recognizing normal production behavior, identifying conditions that require intervention, and diagnosing issues across the signage platform, players, networking, content, data sources, and display hardware.


The engineer must understand Scala Content Manager and its use of FrameSets, Screen Regions, Playlists, Channels, Scheduling, and Content to organize and publish presentations. They must also understand Scala's content\-creation environment, content deployment and troubleshooting, metadata\-driven configuration, and the mechanisms used to execute Python applications within Scala content.


Because the majority of the client's dynamic content is generated programmatically, advanced Python software\-development skills are essential. The current implementation uses an object\-oriented, class\-based architecture designed to support multiple content variations while sharing a common application platform.


A major portion of the environment has been modernized from tightly coupled, content\-specific Python applications into a reusable software architecture. Shared functionality such as event handling, network communication, configuration, logging, data processing, and common runtime services is implemented in reusable Python libraries. Individual signage applications primarily define content\-specific behavior while relying on the shared framework for the underlying infrastructure. This substantially improves maintainability, consistency, reliability, and the ability to develop new signage applications without duplicating large amounts of code.


The environment also requires network\-level Python development, including socket\-based communication used to access the Vision system backend and associated APIs. This role may also involve integrating specialized hardware and device drivers into the Scala environment. Candidates should therefore have experience designing, packaging, deploying, and supporting production Python applications and the tooling and automation required to maintain them.


**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------


* Develop, maintain, and enhance the client's Scala Digital Signage applications and supporting Python software.
* Design and maintain reusable Python libraries and application frameworks used across multiple signage solutions.
* Integrate signage applications with external systems, APIs, data sources, databases, and specialized sensors or hardware.
* Develop and support event\-processing, socket\-based communication, and network\-integration logic.
* Support Scala Content Manager, Scala Player, content deployment, configuration, publishing, and production operations.
* Diagnose production issues across application code, Scala components, players, networking, external data sources, sensors, and display hardware.
* Design new signage solutions while preserving compatibility with the existing client architecture.
* Work directly with client business and technical stakeholders to translate operational requirements into production solutions.
* Provide technical guidance for deployment, troubleshooting, support, and future expansion of the digital signage environment.

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Strong Python software\-development and software\-architecture experience are essential. Candidates must be capable of designing and maintaining reusable libraries and production applications rather than simply modifying existing scripts.
* Experience with enterprise digital signage, Scala Digital Signage, networked applications, APIs, event\-driven systems, socket programming, hardware integration, distributed\-system troubleshooting, and Windows\-based production environments.
* Because the client's implementation is highly customized, the role requires an engineer capable of understanding and troubleshooting the system as an integrated whole rather than treating Scala, Python, networking, content, player infrastructure, and external systems as separate disciplines.

The engineer will leverage AI/ML knowledge to uplift test automation, develop new test plans, and build productivity\-enhancing tools, ensuring superior wireless network reliability, latency, performance, and customer outcomes.
  
  

**In this role:**  

* Lead technology design, planning, and deployment of wireless solutions, including small to mid\-size or moderately complex systems, ensuring reliability, availability, latency, resilience, and performance targets are met across current\-generation and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 environments.
* Collaborate with customers to plan, design, configure, and validate Cisco wireless technologies, including Wi\-Fi standards through Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn), Layer 2 protocols, WLAN technologies, and 802\.1X security types.
* Write new test automation scripts and uplift existing test scripts using Python to enhance wireless technology testing frameworks and improve automation efficiency.
* Utilize AI/ML techniques to uplift test automation frameworks, develop new test plans tailored to wireless and Wi\-Fi 8 reliability requirements, and build tools that improve productivity and streamline testing and deployment processes.
* Assist with integration and implementation of tools, systems, and service assurance related to wireless networks, including continuous monitoring, telemetry analysis, and alerting in test and production environments for latency, packet loss, roaming, interference, and reliability conditions.
* Support presales by translating business requirements into technical wireless solution designs and creating customer collateral, documentation, and knowledge transfer materials.
* Drive customer technology transitions and influence solution architectures and services in wireless networking, including readiness planning for Wi\-Fi 8 and Ultra High Reliability capabilities.
* Comply with company policies and utilize relevant tools to support Professional Services strategies and goals.
* Act as an individual contributor and mentor within the team, providing guidance and support to peers and engineering interns.
* Lead corrective actions, including root cause analysis and process improvements on escaped defects for specific product features.
* Implement automation frameworks and execute test cases and plans for projects with multiple features, including Wi\-Fi 8 functional, interoperability, performance, reliability, and regression validation.
* Report issues and findings with root cause analysis and potential software solutions; advocate for quality improvements and strategic changes.
* Oversee creation and storage of test plans and documentation; translate dashboard metrics into consumable documentation such as release notes, bug reports, and test results.
* Collaborate with other engineering groups to document test cases and apply best practices for document review.
* Develop productive working relationships with peer stakeholders within and across teams.
* Work independently with guidance from leadership to determine the best approach to accomplish work and act as a resource for less experienced colleagues.


**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Deep domain\-based engineering and configuration knowledge of Cisco wireless technologies, with knowledge of current Wi\-Fi generations and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn) concepts.
* Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi standards, including Ultra High Reliability objectives, deterministic and tail\-latency behavior, packet\-loss reduction, roaming continuity, overlapping\-BSS performance, multi\-AP coordination concepts, coexistence, and backward compatibility.
* Strong expertise in AI/ML applications for test automation and productivity improvements.
* Experience in writing comprehensive test plans and building automation tools for wireless functional, interoperability, roaming, latency, packet\-loss, reliability, and performance validation.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills specific to wireless networks, including interference, congestion, roaming, latency, packet loss, and multi\-AP deployment scenarios.
* Excellent communication and customer engagement abilities.
* Experience in solution design activities.
* Ability to create and deliver technical documentation and training materials.


**Key technologies:**  

* Wi\-Fi Standards: Knowledge of Wi\-Fi generations, including Wi\-Fi 6/6E, Wi\-Fi 7, and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability). Understanding the evolution of these standards and their security, reliability, latency, power\-efficiency, coexistence, and performance objectives is essential.
* Wi\-Fi 8 / IEEE 802\.11bn: Familiarity with the emerging Ultra High Reliability amendment and its focus on WLAN reliability, latency, throughput, roaming continuity, power efficiency, peer\-to\-peer operation, coexistence, and overlapping\-BSS performance.
* Layer 2 Protocols: Familiarity with Layer 2 security policies such as WLAN, Static WEP, WPA/WPA2, WPA3, and especially 802\.1X authentication. Knowledge of encryption types like TKIP, AES, CCMP, and GCMP is important.
* WLAN Technologies: Expertise in Cisco wireless solutions, including configuration of WLAN security, use of Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, and deployment of secure WLANs with features such as Fast Secure Roaming (802\.11r), AAA integration with RADIUS and Cisco ISE, multi\-AP architectures, and telemetry\-driven assurance. Familiarity with Wi\-Fi 8 goals for improved reliability, latency, roaming resilience, and operation across overlapping BSS environments is desirable.
* 802\.1X Security Types: Deep understanding of 802\.1X authentication mechanisms including EAP types such as PEAP, EAP\-TLS, LEAP, and EAP\-FAST. Knowledge of how 802\.1X integrates with AAA servers (e.g., Cisco ISE) for centralized policy management, and how it supports secure network access and segmentation.
* Python programming for developing and uplifting test automation scripts, enhancing wireless technology testing frameworks and productivity.
* AI/ML Knowledge: Proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to improve wireless performance and operational efficiency. The role includes uplifting test automation, generating wireless test plans, building productivity tools, and validating Wi\-Fi 8 reliability objectives.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Software engineer - Python Validation
description:
**Company Description**  

Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.


Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry\-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.


Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

 **Job Description**  

Join SanDisk's Storage Validation Engineering team and help deliver high\-quality software solutions for validating next\-generation flash storage products.


In this role, you will develop AI\-assisted Python automation solutions, analyze product and protocol requirements, execute validation on storage devices, investigate complex failures, and contribute to release qualification. You will work closely with software, firmware, validation, and release teams across India, Israel, and the United States.


This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy Python development, AI\-assisted engineering, system\-level debugging, Linux and Windows environments, and working close to hardware.


Responsibilities

* Understand product requirements, technical designs, and storage protocol specifications.
* Create comprehensive validation strategies including functional, negative, integration, stress, recovery, and regression scenarios.
* Plan, design, develop, review, and maintain automated validation solutions using Python and AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Validate storage features, software enhancements, and bug fixes on physical storage devices.
* Execute sanity, functional, integration, performance, and regression test campaigns.
* Analyze logs, reproduce failures, and isolate issues across test frameworks, host software, firmware, operating systems, and device layers.
* Report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, configurations, and technical findings.
* Verify fixes and provide evidence\-based quality sign\-off.
* Contribute qualified tests to automated sanity and regression suites.
* Collaborate with globally distributed development, validation, and release teams.
* Improve test automation, diagnostics, reliability, and engineering productivity.
* Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test design, coding, debugging, data analysis, and documentation activities.

  

**Qualifications**  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in software engineering, validation, system testing, quality assurance, or test automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python with hands\-on experience developing automated test solutions.
* Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining automated test frameworks.
* Good understanding of software testing methodologies, defect lifecycle management, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience working in Linux and Windows environments.
* Working knowledge of Git and GitHub development workflows.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, drive tasks to completion, and take ownership of validation activities.


Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with SSDs, flash storage, firmware, drivers, embedded systems, or system software.
* Knowledge of storage protocols such as NVMe, SCSI, or ATA.
* Experience with Python test frameworks, log analysis, and data\-driven testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with GitHub, Jira, Agile, Scrum, and Continuous Integration workflows.
* Working knowledge of C or C\+\+.
* Exposure to large\-scale automation environments and test infrastructure development.
* Experience using AI tools to improve software development, testing, or engineering productivity.


What We Look For

* Strong problem\-solving and debugging abilities.
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
* Curiosity to understand complex interactions between software, firmware, operating systems, and hardware.
* Ownership mindset from requirement analysis through validation sign\-off.
* Proactive mindset with a high level of accountability.
* Assertive communicator who can clearly and confidently express technical viewpoints while respecting others.
* Ability to challenge assumptions and make data\-driven decisions.
* Continuous learning attitude with interest in automation, AI\-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies.
* Strong collaboration skills across globally distributed teams.
* Confidence to take initiative, drive improvements, and deliver results

  

**Additional Information**  

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.


Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us atjobs.accommodations@sandisk.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

description:

This position offers strong technical ownership across Bootloader, communication, diagnostics, and AUTOSAR BSW layers, with direct influence on architecture decisions, Software Integration Strategy, quality, and customer success. 	+ 5\+ years of work experience in automotive BSW development.
	+ 3\+ years of work experience with AUTOSAR software architect and software integrator.

* Creation of the complete software and delivery to the project team as well as software release documentation.
* Specification and execution of software integration tests (SWE5\) including documentation

* Debugging and analyzing integration problems. This position will require close collaboration with Software project manager, lead software engineers, software architect, software test engineer and other departments to complete software development engineering and release.
* Support the development/maintenance of and adhere to the common software architecture. Ensure documented traceability from requirements through test cases meeting Automotive SPICE development process requirements.
* Implement and shape CI/CD future, with elements that will enable totally new possibilities and ways of working.
* Performing AutoSAR System configuration (SWC compositions like Component instances, connectors), optimize AUTOSAR based SW architecture in multicore environment.
* Lead enhancement of the controls and module/component architectures alongside strategic roadmap with cutting\-edge technology advancements and innovative solutions
* Works closely with customers, Start centre, Experts, Technical Leads to gain understanding of Customer requirements, and define SW architecture and high\-level designs/solutions to meet those needs.
* Assist in debugging through established problem\-solving techniques and debug on bench
* Mentor, influence, and coach team members to enhance engineering skills and achieve shared goals

**What we are looking for**:

* Strong knowledge of AutoSAR tool chain and sound working experience in Makefile development and setting up software build environment based on a C/C\+\+ compiler, linker to generate various target\-based products files from make and linker utility scripts.
* Build management of tasks from various developers using software configuration and change management tools such as JIRA, Polarion, BitBucket and Gitlab.
* Experience in integrating OEM application libraries (SWCs) is desirable. Experienced in using ASAP2 tools, A2L files.
* Strong expertise in Build Automation and working with tool\-chain for Continuous Integration \& Continuous delivery (such as Jenkins) as well as scripting for automated testing.
* Strong experience with **AUTOSAR architecture**, Configuration \& implementation of **BSW modules** for multiple SWCs, (DCM, DEM, CAN, CANIF, SPI, PDUR, MEMIF, NM, EEP, etc,) Bootloader, Cybersecurity, IO hardware abstraction (FEE, Crypto) and MCAL development through various tools from Vector such as DaVinci, ETAS ISOLAR, EB Tresos etc.

* Must have BSW software development experience in configuration of BSW components, Bootloader stack, Communication Stack, Diagnostic stack, Memory stack, Network management including CAN, LIN, Flexray, Ethernet, and UDS protocols, Memory Stack, OS, ECUM, BSWM, WDG, NVM etc, Instrumentation development using XCP, XETK, UDS
* Solid Hands\-on experience in Vector DaVinci tool chain, EBTresos and ETAS ISOLAR
* Must have experienced with 32bit Infineon TC 3xx microcontroller
* Exemplary expertise in Embedded SW development using C language, debugging for embedded multithreaded and multi core/CPU software environment.
* Strong ability to comprehend microcontroller hardware and associated schematics
* Experience in configuration \& Change management tools such as Plastic SCM, BitBucket, Gitlab, JIRA, Design tools such as EA, Unit testing tools such as TPT/CANTATA/VectorCAST/RTRT, Serial Comm testing tool such as CANoe/CANalyzer/NeoVI Fire, Cross compilers and debuggers like Lauterbach, Tasking.

* Team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Collaborative style with the ability to communicate clearly on technical issues.

title: Senior Tech Lead - AUTOSAR
description:
- **Senior Tech Lead \- AUTOSAR**

Help shape the future of mobility.


Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv’s passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high\-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error.


**Your Role**


	* Design, develop, and maintain embedded software solutions for automotive applications, leveraging expertise in embedded systems and real\-time operating systems (RTOS)
	* Implement automotive communication protocols and integrate software modules with microcontroller architectures to ensure seamless operation within vehicle systems
	* Integrate embedded software development activities into the automotive product development process, following established procedures and standards such as AUTOSAR and ASPICE
	* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define requirements, develop software architectures, and deliver high\-quality embedded software solutions in alignment with project objectives
	* Lead testing and debugging efforts for embedded software components, utilizing tools like Vector CANalyzer and CANoe to analyze communication protocols and verify system behavior
	* Manage embedded software requirements using tools like DOORS, ensuring traceability and alignment with project goals and customer needs
	* Document software design specifications, test plans, and validation reports to support the development and verification of embedded software solutions
	* Utilize version control systems such as Git and collaboration platforms like JIRA and Gerrit to manage software repositories and facilitate team collaboration
	* Ensure compliance with automotive product development processes and standards such as ASPICE, adhering to established guidelines and procedures throughout the software development lifecycle
	* Conduct code reviews, perform static analysis, and contribute to quality assurance activities to validate the integrity and safety of embedded software implementations**Your Background**

**Key ingredients for succeeding in this role are your:**


	* B.E. / B. Tech / M.E. / M. Tech in any specialization with an experience of 8\-15 years
	* Proficient in C and Microcontroller(S32, Aurix, Renesas), Experience working on Embedded/Autosar SW development
	* Analyze, interpret and clarify customer Autosar requirements
	* Deep expertise in more than two AUTOSAR BSW stack/MCAL modules\- com stack(CAN, Ethernet),Memory Stack, Diagnostic Stack, Cybersecurity Stack ,OS, Watchdog ,MCAL
	* Experience in CDD \& RTE, Experience on Vector/Mentor Autosar Tools
	* Experience on Autosar Multicore architecture. Understanding of 16/32\-bit microcontrollers
	* Experience with min one microcontroller architectures: Renesas RH family or TRICOR or PowerPC architecture
	* Expertise with development tolls: CANalyzer, debugger, oscilloscopes
	* Understanding and working experience on ASPICE and AGILE methodologies.
	* Functional Safety, Cyber Security**Why join us?**


	* You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.
	* You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.
	* You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.**Your Benefits at Aptiv:**


	* Flexible working hours;
	* Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development);
	* Life and accident insurance;
	* Sodexo cards for food and beverages;
	* Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;
	* EAP Employee Assistance;
	* Access to fitness clubs (T\&C apply);
	* Creche facility for working parents;Apply today, and together let’s change tomorrow!

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility \& high\-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi\-tiered, low\-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning\-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non\-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.  

  

The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop full\-stack solutions for Post Add to Cart and Cart services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi\-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data\-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

  

A day in the life  

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full\-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning\-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long\-term health.  

  

About the team  

We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Knowledge of CE data model, entities, and security framework.

**Tools \& Frameworks**

* Experience with Azure services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Functions, API Management).
* Skilled in integration frameworks and ETL tools for CE data migration.
* Proficiency in GitHub, Azure DevOps pipelines, and environment management.

**Considerations for Top Candidates**

* **Plug****‑****in Development Mastery** – Advanced ability to design and implement custom plug‑ins in C\# for complex business logic across Sales and Field Service.
* **JavaScript/TypeScript Expertise** – Skilled in customizing CE forms, ribbons, and UI components using modern scripting frameworks.
* **Field Service Technical Depth** – Strong knowledge of resource scheduling, work orders, service tasks, and mobile app customization for Field Service scenarios.
* **Sales Process Customization** – Ability to tailor lead, opportunity, and pipeline management processes with custom workflows and automation.
* **Power Platform Integration** – Hands‑on experience embedding Power Apps, Power BI dashboards, and Power Pages into CE solutions.
* **Testing \& Quality Assurance** – Skilled in writing unit tests for plug‑ins, automated UI tests, and regression testing for CE customizations.
* **Data Migration \& ETL** – Experience with tools like KingswaySoft, Scribe, or custom ETL pipelines for migrating CE data securely and efficiently.
* **API \& Web Resource Development** – Ability to build and manage custom APIs, web resources, and secure authentication flows for CE integrations.
* **Offline \& Mobile Optimization** – Expertise in configuring CE for mobile/offline scenarios, ensuring performance and usability for field engineers.
* **Upgrade \& Release Readiness** – Ability to validate customizations against Microsoft CE updates, apply patches, and ensure upgrade‑safe delivery.
* **Monitoring \& Diagnostics** – Skilled in using Application Insights, plug‑in trace logs, and telemetry to monitor CE performance and troubleshoot issues.
* **Reusable Frameworks** – Experience creating reusable libraries, templates, and accelerators to standardize CE development across projects.

Preferred exposure to **Leapwork**, Azure App Testing, **Playwright**, with accepted proficiency in JMeter, Ranorex, Selenium, or equivalent platforms to ensure quality and reliability of Sales and Field Service customizations.

description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. * Independently drives features from design through deployment.
* Builds reusable and scalable solutions that can support multiple business teams.
* Improves developer productivity through automation and engineering best practices.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Travel
description:
**About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**  

You’ll be part of the Travel integrations team, helping to define the future of corporate travel through the Rippling Platform’s integrated solutions. As part of Rippling’s Spend Suite—which also includes corporate cards, expense management, procurement, and bill pay—the Travel team is integral to our all\-in\-one solution for managing corporate spending.

  

Our customers value the seamless integration of corporate cards, expense management, and accounting automation, with travel management as the next frontier. Our mission is to build the best travel management platform for employees, finance teams, and travel managers alike.

 **What you will do:**

* Craft exceptional platform solutions that will benefit multiple teams to create a seamless user experience.
* Be hands\-on in technical architecture and be the liaison between between product leadership, engineering leadership, and technical workstreams
* Tackle complex engineering challenges, leveraging your expertise to devise ingenious solutions that push the boundaries of what is possible.
* Assume clear ownership of your projects, empowering you to make impactful decisions and drive their successful implementation.
* Play a pivotal role in leading and mentoring highly talented engineers across Travel Org.
* Immerse yourself in one of Rippling's newest and most influential products, becoming a true authority and contributing to its ongoing development.

 **What you will need:**

* **Experience**: 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record in backend development and distributed systems.
* **Architecture**: Proven ability to design large\-scale, fault\-tolerant systems from scratch. You understand the trade\-offs between consistency and availability and know when "eventual consistency" is not enough.
* **High Agency**: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't wait for a ticket to be assigned; you identify the business problem, scope the technical solution, and execute.
* **Domain Agility**: You have the intellectual curiosity to master the complex domain of treasury and money movement in a matter of days, even if you don't have a background in it.
* **Tech Stack**: Deep proficiency in a modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, etc.) plus experience with complex data modeling (SQL/NoSQL)
* **Communication:** Ability to convey technical concepts to both engineering and non\-engineering audiences effectively.

title: Software Engineer 2
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Full Stack AI Engineer
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

JLL REMS (Real Estate Management Services) is building next\-generation AI\-powered solutions to transform how our clients interact with and derive insights from property management data. We are seeking a talented Full Stack AI Engineer who combines deep AI expertise with full\-stack development capabilities to join our team.
  
As a Full Stack AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy end\-to\-end GenAI solutions that enable users to retrieve knowledge, analyze information through intuitive interfaces. You will be responsible for building intelligent backend systems that translate natural language into actionable queries, as well as creating user\-facing interfaces that deliver AI\-powered insights, filtered dashboards, and summaries in multiple languages.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**AI development:**  

Research and develop state\-of\-the\-art GenAI\-based solutions for property management applications.
  
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines using LLMs to efficiently utilize property management data from data warehouses and semantic indexes.
  
Implement AI based techniques to extract valuable insights and patterns from data, enabling actionable recommendations and predictions.
  
Design and develop agentic AI systems and implement Model Context Protocols (MCPs) for enhanced AI capabilities.
  
Develop and fine\-tune GenAI wirkflows for complex decision\-making scenarios.
  
  

**Full Stack Development:**  

Develop and implement robust web applications using React, Python, Django, and the Django REST Framework.
  
Design and develop efficient, scalable backend applications and APIs that integrate seamlessly with AI models.
  
Create responsive and intuitive front\-end interfaces using React / NextJS, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
  
Implement secure coding practices and adhere to industry best practices across the full stack.
  
  

**Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps:**  

Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for scalable cloud deployments.
  
Deploy and manage AI services on cloud platforms, including Azure Search Service and OpenSearch.
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and other automation tools.
  
Ensure scalability, performance, and reliability through regular testing, debugging, and optimization.
  
Implement containerization using Docker and orchestration for microservices architectures.
  
  

**Collaboration \& Delivery:**  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including BI engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements and define project scope.
  
Translate business requirements into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  
Provide technical guidance and support to teams in integrating and utilizing AI\-powered solutions effectively.
  
Conduct code reviews and address bugs, performance issues, and technical debt.
  
Work effectively in an Agile/Scrum environment to ensure timely and successful delivery.
  
  

**Continuous Innovation:**  

Keep up to date with the latest advancements in GenAI technologies, LLMs, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Continuously improve software development processes and practices.
  
Stay current with emerging cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and full\-stack development trends.
  
  

**To apply you need to be:**  

Experience \& Education
  
  

**Required:**  

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field.
  
3\+ years of proven experience as an AI Engineer, Full Stack Developer, or similar role.
  
Strong proficiency in Python and relevant AI libraries and frameworks (LangChain, Langgraph etc.).
  
Demonstrated experience developing GenAI\-based solutions and tools using LLMs.
  
In\-depth knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, including language models, RAG pipelines, and text generation algorithms.
  
Strong proficiency in full\-stack development with React / NextJS, Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
  
**Experience with front\-end technologies:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern React patterns.
  
Strong knowledge of SQL and database technologies (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  
Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  
Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  
Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS or Azure) and their AI services.
  
Familiarity with Azure Search Service and/or OpenSearch for semantic search implementations.
  
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and distributed computing architectures.
  
Experience working with large\-scale datasets and implementing data processing pipelines.
  
Strong understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and best practices.
  
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycle.
  
  

**Preferred:**  

Experience developing agentic AI systems and implementing Model Context Protocols (MCPs).
  
Familiarity with vector databases and semantic indexing technologies.
  
Experience with API gateway design and microservices architectures.
  
Knowledge of security best practices for AI systems and data privacy compliance.
  
Experience with monitoring, observability, and performance optimization tools like DataDog.
  
Skills \& Competencies
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and innovative environment.
  
Excellent problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  
Self\-starter with the ability to quickly learn, adapt, and conduct POCs as the GenAI landscape evolves.
  
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for non\-technical stakeholders.
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
  
Passion for learning and staying updated with rapidly evolving AI technologies and industry trends.
  
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  
  

**What's in it for you:**  

The opportunity to work at a rapid\-growth company and industry leader in commercial real estate services.
  
Flexible, high\-energy work environment and culture that encourages innovation.
  
Work on cutting\-edge GenAI technologies and shape the future of property management solutions.
  
Collaborative team environment with opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  
Exposure to the latest advancements in AI, cloud infrastructure, and full\-stack development.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
